program calc_serr_demo
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64, sp=>real32
  implicit none

  integer, parameter :: nx = 2, ny = 2
  integer :: i, j
  real(sp) :: sx_in(nx,nx)
  real(sp) :: se_in(ny,ny)
  real(sp) :: sm_out(nx,nx), sn_out(nx,nx), st_out(nx,nx)
  real(dp) :: dd_in(nx,ny), aa_in(nx,nx)

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Representative data (hard‑coded)
  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  sx_in = reshape([1.0_sp, 0.2_sp, 0.2_sp, 1.0_sp], [nx,nx])
  se_in = reshape([0.5_sp, 0.1_sp, 0.1_sp, 0.5_sp], [ny,ny])
  dd_in = reshape([0.3_dp, 0.1_dp, 0.2_dp, 0.4_dp], [nx,ny])
  aa_in = reshape([1.0_dp, 0.0_dp, 0.0_dp, 1.0_dp], [nx,nx])   ! identity kernel

  call calc_serr(nx, ny, sx_in, se_in, aa_in, dd_in, &
                 st_out, sn_out, sm_out)

  print *, '--- SM (measurement covariance) ---'
  do i = 1, nx
     print *, (sm_out(i,j), j=1,nx)
  end do
  print *, '--- SN (smoothing covariance) ----'
  do i = 1, nx
     print *, (sn_out(i,j), j=1,nx)
  end do
  print *, '--- ST (total covariance) --------'
  do i = 1, nx
     print *, (st_out(i,j), j=1,nx)
  end do

contains

  subroutine calc_serr(nx, ny, sx_in, se_in, aa_in, dd_in, &
                       st_out, sn_out, sm_out)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in)  :: nx, ny
    real(sp), intent(in) :: sx_in(nx,nx), se_in(ny,ny)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: aa_in(nx,nx), dd_in(nx,ny)
    real(sp), intent(out):: st_out(nx,nx), sn_out(nx,nx), sm_out(nx,nx)

    integer :: i, j, n
    real(dp), allocatable :: dd(:,:), dt(:,:), se(:,:), a(:,:), b(:,:), c(:,:)
    real(dp), allocatable :: sm(:,:), sn(:,:), st(:,:)

    n = max(nx, ny)   ! all temporary square matrices are sized to the larger dimension
    allocate(dd(n,n), dt(n,n), se(n,n), a(n,n), b(n,n), c(n,n))
    allocate(sm(n,n), sn(n,n), st(n,n))

    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Load dd and its transpose dt (both n×n, zero‑padding if needed)
    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    dd = 0.0_dp; dt = 0.0_dp
    do i = 1, nx
       do j = 1, ny
          dd(i,j) = dd_in(i,j)
          dt(j,i) = dd_in(i,j)
       end do
    end do

    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Load measurement covariance se (ny×ny) into the n×n array
    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    se = 0.0_dp
    do i = 1, ny
       do j = 1, ny
          se(i,j) = se_in(i,j)
       end do
    end do

    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! sm = dd * se * dt   (all operations performed in double precision)
    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    call matmul_dp(dd, se, a)   ! a = dd * se
    call matmul_dp(a, dt, sm)  ! sm = a * dt

    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! b = sx_in  (converted to double precision)
    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    b = 0.0_dp
    do i = 1, nx
       do j = 1, nx
          b(i,j) = real(sx_in(i,j), dp)
       end do
    end do

    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! a = aa_in - I   (identity subtracted on the diagonal)
    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    a = aa_in
    do i = 1, nx
       a(i,i) = a(i,i) - 1.0_dp
    end do

    ! c = a * b
    call matmul_dp(a, b, c)

    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! a = transpose(aa_in) - I
    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    a = transpose(aa_in)
    do i = 1, nx
       a(i,i) = a(i,i) - 1.0_dp
    end do

    ! sn = c * a
    call matmul_dp(c, a, sn)

    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! st = sm + sn
    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    call matadd_dp(sm, sn, st)

    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Transfer results back to single precision output arrays
    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    do i = 1, nx
       do j = 1, nx
          sm_out(i,j) = real(sm(i,j), sp)
          sn_out(i,j) = real(sn(i,j), sp)
          st_out(i,j) = real(st(i,j), sp)
       end do
    end do

    deallocate(dd, dt, se, a, b, c, sm, sn, st)
  end subroutine calc_serr

  ! Generic double‑precision matrix multiplication (A·B=C)
  !===================================================================

    implicit none
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: A(:,:), B(:,:)

    integer :: i, j, k, n, p, m
    n = size(A,1)
    p = size(A,2)
    m = size(B,2)
    C = 0.0_dp
    do i = 1, n
       do j = 1, m
          do k = 1, p

          end do
       end do
    end do
  end subroutine matmul_dp

  !===================================================================
  ! Double‑precision matrix addition (A+B=C)
  !===================================================================
  subroutine matadd_dp(A, B, C)
    implicit none
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: A(:,:), B(:,:)

    b1 = 0.0_dp

    case (2)

    real(rk), intent(inout) :: w(n)
    integer, intent(out) :: nullty, ifault

             l = l + i

          icol = nrow
          jcol = nn
          mdiag = nn
          do

                x = 0.0d0
             end if
             k = nrow

                l = l - 1
                if (mdiag < l) then

                end if
             end do

             if (icol <= irow) exit

             jcol = jcol - 1
          end do
       end if
       ndiag = ndiag - irow
       irow = irow - 1
       if (irow <= 0) exit

    real(wp), intent(in) :: tspan(2)
    real(wp), intent(in) :: y0(m)

    real(wp) :: ym(m)

         sum = 0.0_dp
         do j = 1, i-1

    integer(dp),      intent(out)   :: mxdvd
    integer(dp),      intent(out)   :: nguess

    !----------------------------------------------------------

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------

                     XNEBOR, YNEBOR, AIRS, DTHAUT)

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   !  Output results
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   print *, 'DTHAUT (local space step) values:'
   print '(4F12.6)', DTHAUT

   subroutine compute_hloc(NPOIN, NSEG, NPTFR, NUBO, NBOR, VNOCL, &
                           XNEBOR, YNEBOR, AIRS, DTHAUT)
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in) :: NPOIN, NSEG, NPTFR
      integer, intent(in) :: NUBO(2, *)
      integer, intent(in) :: NBOR(*)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: VNOCL(3, *)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: XNEBOR(*), YNEBOR(*)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: AIRS(NPOIN)
      real(dp), intent(out) :: DTHAUT(NPOIN)

      integer :: I, K, NSG
      integer :: NUBO1, NUBO2
      real(dp) :: VNX, VNY, VNL

      ! Initialise output array
      do I = 1, NPOIN
         DTHAUT(I) = 0.0_dp
      end do

      do NSG = 1, NSEG
         NUBO1 = NUBO(1, NSG)
         NUBO2 = NUBO(2, NSG)

         DTHAUT(NUBO2) = DTHAUT(NUBO2) + VNOCL(3, NSG)

      end do

      ! Final division by cell area to obtain the local space step
      do I = 1, NPOIN
         DTHAUT(I) = AIRS(I) / DTHAUT(I)
      end do

   end subroutine compute_hloc

end program hloc_main

!=====================================================================
! Demonstration of the legacy MOMSRC routine rewritten in modern Fortran.
! All data are hard‑coded; the program simply exercises the routine.

module moms_mod
  implicit none
  private
  public :: momsrc

contains

  subroutine momsrc(u, v, w, dt, gx, gy, gz, ic1, ic2, ic1u, iswirL, &
                    dx, wn, xc, half, small)
    implicit none
    integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)
    integer, intent(in) :: ic1, ic2, ic1u, iswirL
    real(dp), intent(in) :: gx, gy, gz, half, small
    real(dp), dimension(:), intent(inout) :: u, v, w
    real(dp), dimension(:), intent(in)    :: dt, dx, wn, xc

    integer :: ic
    real(dp) :: swrl

    !--- Simple momentum update ---------------------------------------
    do ic = ic1, ic2
       u(ic) = u(ic) + dt(ic) * gx
       v(ic) = v(ic) + dt(ic) * gy
       w(ic) = w(ic) + dt(ic) * gz
    end do

    !--- Optional swirl contribution ---------------------------------
    if (iswirL == 1) then
       do ic = ic1u, ic2
          ! (DX(IC)*WN(IC+1) + DX(IC+1)*WN(IC)) / (DX(IC) + DX(IC+1))
          swrl = (dx(ic) * wn(ic+1) + dx(ic+1) * wn(ic)) / &
                 (dx(ic) + dx(ic+1))
          u(ic) = u(ic) + dt(ic) * swrl * swrl / &
                  max(xc(ic) + half * dx(ic), small)
       end do
    end if

  end subroutine momsrc

end module moms_mod

      implicit none

      p = start
      do
         q = LPTR(p)
         cnt = cnt + 1
         p = q
         if (p == start) exit
      end do
   end function count_neighbors

      cum_rf = 0.0_dp
      cum_rd = 0.0_dp

   stsol_rd(ihru) = 15.0_dp

   rtfr = 0.0_dp

   subroutine rootfr()
      ! Distributes dead root mass through the soil profile.
      implicit none
      !--- Local variables ------------------------------------------------
      real(dp) :: sol_thick(max_layers)   ! thickness of each soil layer
      real(dp) :: cum_rd, cum_d, cum_rf
      real(dp) :: x1, x2, xx1, xx2, xx
      integer  :: k, l, jj
      !--- Parameters of the Normalized Root Density Function ------------
      real(dp), parameter :: a = 1.15_dp
      real(dp), parameter :: b = 11.7_dp
      real(dp), parameter :: c = 0.022_dp
      real(dp), parameter :: d = 0.12029_dp   ! integral of the distribution

      jj = ihru

      l = 0
      k = 0
      cum_d  = 0.0_dp
      cum_rf = 0.0_dp
      cum_rd = 0.0_dp
      sol_thick = 0.0_dp
      rtfr       = 0.0_dp

      do l = 1, sol_nly(jj)
         if (l == 1) then
            sol_thick(l) = sol_z(l, jj)
         else
            sol_thick(l) = sol_z(l, jj) - sol_z(l-1, jj)
         end if

         cum_d = cum_d + sol_thick(l)
         if (cum_d > stsol_rd(jj)) then
            cum_rd = stsol_rd(jj)
         else
            cum_rd = cum_d
         end if

         x1 = (cum_rd - sol_thick(l)) / stsol_rd(jj)
         x2 = cum_rd / stsol_rd(jj)

         xx1 = -b * x1
         if (xx1 > 20.0_dp) xx1 = 20.0_dp
         xx2 = -b * x2
         if (xx2 > 20.0_dp) xx2 = 20.0_dp

         rtfr(l) = (a/b * (exp(xx1) - exp(xx2)) + c * (x2 - x1)) / d

         xx = cum_rf
         cum_rf = cum_rf + rtfr(l)
         if (cum_rf > 1.0_dp) then
            rtfr(l) = 1.0_dp - xx
            cum_rf = 1.0_dp
         end if

         k = l
         if (cum_rd >= stsol_rd(jj)) exit
      end do

      ! Ensure that cumulative fractional root distribution = 1
      do l = 1, sol_nly(jj)
         rtfr(l) = rtfr(l) / cum_rf
         if (l == k) exit
      end do

   end subroutine rootfr

program cube_monte_carlo_demo

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Demonstration of the cube01 subroutines and functions originally
  ! provided by John Burkardt.  The program computes the exact integral
  ! of a monomial over the unit cube, generates a few random sample
  ! points, evaluates the monomial at those points, and prints a simple
  ! Monte‑Carlo estimate of the integral.
  !--------------------------------------------------------------------

  integer, parameter :: rk = kind(1.0d0)   ! double precision kind
  integer, parameter :: m  = 3            ! spatial dimension

  integer            :: e(m)
  real(rk)           :: exact_integral
  integer            :: n
  real(rk), allocatable :: x(:,:)
  real(rk), allocatable :: value(:)
  real(rk)           :: mc_estimate
  integer            :: i

  call timestamp()

  !--- Choose a monomial X^e1 * Y^e2 * Z^e3 --------------------------
  e = (/ 1, 2, 3 /)   ! example exponents, all non‑negative

  call cube01_monomial_integral(e, exact_integral)
  print *, 'Exact integral of X^', e(1), ' * Y^', e(2), ' * Z^', e(3), &
           ' over unit cube =', exact_integral

  !--- Monte‑Carlo sampling ------------------------------------------
  n = 100000   ! number of random points (hard‑coded, no input)
  allocate(x(m,n))
  allocate(value(n))

  call cube01_sample(n, x)
  call monomial_value(m, n, e, x, value)

  allocate(x(m,n))

  mc_estimate = sum(value) / real(n, rk) * cube01_volume()
  print *, 'Monte‑Carlo estimate with', n, 'samples =', mc_estimate

  deallocate(value)

  subroutine cube01_monomial_integral ( e, integral )
    implicit none
    integer, parameter :: rk = kind(1.0d0)
    integer, parameter :: m = 3
    integer, intent(in)  :: e(m)
    real(rk), intent(out) :: integral
    integer :: i

    if ( any ( e(1:m) < 0 ) ) then
      write ( *, '(a)' ) ' '
      write ( *, '(a)' ) 'CUBE01_MONOMIAL_INTEGRAL - Fatal error!'
      write ( *, '(a)' ) '  All exponents must be nonnegative.'
      stop 1
    end if

    integral = 1.0_rk
    do i = 1, m
      integral = integral / real ( e(i) + 1, kind = rk )
    end do
  end subroutine cube01_monomial_integral

  subroutine cube01_sample ( n, x )
    implicit none
    integer, parameter :: rk = kind(1.0d0)

    !---------------------------------------------------------------

   ! Hard‑coded demonstration of the original QCVJAD routine.

   ! It operated on a flat real array with interleaved real/imag parts
   ! and allowed arbitrary element increments (I, J, K).  Here we keep
   ! the scientific content but use native Fortran complex arrays and
   ! explicit increments expressed in complex‑element units.
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------

   incA = 1                     ! increment for A (in complex elements)
   incB = 1                     ! increment for B (in complex elements)
   incC = 1                     ! increment for C (in complex elements)

   allocate(A(N*incA))

      A(i) = cmplx(dble(i), dble(i*10), dp)          !  (real=i, imag=10*i)
      B(i) = cmplx(dble(i*2), dble(i*20), dp)        !  (real=2*i, imag=20*i)
   end do

   ! Call the hard‑coded routine that mimics QCVJAD.
   call qcvjad(A, incA, B, incB, C, incC, N)

   print *, 'Vector B (real, imag):'
   do i = 1, N
      print *, i, real(B(i)), aimag(B(i))
   end do

   do i = 1, N
      print *, i, real(C(i)), aimag(C(i))
   end do

      complex(dp), intent(in)  :: B(*)

  real(dp), parameter :: PARJ22 = 1.0_dp         ! optional scaling factor
  real(dp), parameter :: PARU2  = 2.0_dp*acos(-1.0_dp)  ! 2*pi

  integer, parameter :: MSTJ91 = 0   ! =1 would apply PARJ22 scaling
  integer, parameter :: MSTJ13 = 1   ! <=0 would force PT = 0 for KFLA=0

  integer :: KFL
  real(dp) :: PX, PY

  ! Example call – you may change KFL to test other flavours

  call LUPTDI_HIJING(KFL, PX, PY)

  print *, 'Result for KFL =', KFL
  print *, '   PX =', PX, '  PY =', PY

contains

  !================================================================
  ! Subroutine: LUPTDI_HIJING
  ! Purpose  : Generate a transverse momentum vector (PX,PY)
  !            according to a Gaussian distribution using a
  !            uniform random number generator (RLU_HIJING).
  !================================================================
  subroutine LUPTDI_HIJING(KFL, PX, PY)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in)  :: KFL
    real(dp), intent(out) :: PX, PY

    integer :: KFLA
    real(dp) :: PT, PHI
    real(dp) :: rnd

    ! absolute flavour code
    KFLA = abs(KFL)

    !--- generate a uniform random number in (0,1] -----------------
    rnd = RLU_HIJING(0)
    ! protect against log(0) – enforce a lower bound
    rnd = max(1.0e-10_dp, rnd)

    !--- Gaussian transverse momentum (Rayleigh distribution) -----
    PT = PARJ21 * sqrt(-log(rnd))
    if (MSTJ91 == 1) PT = PARJ22 * PT
    if (KFLA == 0 .and. MSTJ13 <= 0) PT = 0.0_dp

    !--- azimuthal angle ------------------------------------------
    PHI = PARU2 * RLU_HIJING(0)

    !--- Cartesian components --------------------------------------
    PX = PT * cos(PHI)
    PY = PT * sin(PHI)

  end subroutine LUPTDI_HIJING

  !================================================================
  ! Function: RLU_HIJING
  ! Purpose : Return a uniform random number in the interval (0,1).
  !           The dummy integer argument is kept for compatibility
  !           with the original signature.
  !================================================================
  function RLU_HIJING(dummy) result(rnd)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: dummy
    real(dp) :: rnd
    real(dp) :: u
    call random_number(u)
    ! The original routine never returns exactly zero; we shift

    if (u == 0.0_dp) then
       rnd = 1.0e-12_dp
    else
       rnd = u
    end if
  end function RLU_HIJING

       x2 = xlow + (real(i, dp) - 1.0_dp)*dx

       k = irr(i,jcol)
       yreg = ylow + real(jcol, dp)*dy

          if (poly(kside+2,1,k) == -11.0_dp) then

          end if
          x1 = poly(kside,1,k)
          y1 = poly(kside,2,k)
          x2 = poly(kside+1,1,k)
          y2 = poly(kside+1,2,k)
          if (x1 == x2) cycle   ! not a y‑face
          if (y1 /= y2) then

          end if

       xface = 0.0_dp
       yface = 0.0_dp
       missing = .true.

   real(dp), dimension(20) :: thgev  ! output thresholds (GeV)

   ! Initialise the stubbed data
   ! ---------------------------------------------------------------
   npart = 0                     ! not used by dsrdthr
   mass = 0.0_dp                 ! clear the array
   mass(kw) = 150.0_dp           ! example: W mass > 100 GeV
   mass(kz) = 80.0_dp            ! example: Z mass < 100 GeV
   mass(kt) = 200.0_dp           ! example: top mass > 100 GeV

   ! Provide a simple set of reference masses (GeV). Only the first element
   ! is consulted by dsrdthr, the rest are placeholders.
   mgev = 0.0_dp
   mgev(1) = 100.0_dp            ! reference threshold (GeV)

   ! Call the routine that computes the thresholds
   call dsrdthr(npart, mgev, nth, thgev)

   ! Output the results
   print *, 'Number of thresholds (nth) =', nth
   if (nth > 0) then

      real(dp), intent(out) :: thgev(20)

      ! association from the enclosing program.

      ! ... ww‑threshold
      if (mass(kw) > mgev(1)) then
         nth = nth + 1
         thgev(nth) = 2.0_dp * mass(kw)
      end if

         nth = nth + 1

         nth = nth + 1
         thgev(nth) = 2.0_dp * mass(kt)
      end if

      ! Note: co‑annihilation thresholds are added elsewhere in the original code.
   end subroutine dsrdthr

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  integer :: K, L, LS

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Initialise data with simple representative values
  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  call initialise_arrays()

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Perform the horizontal diffusive flux calculation (core algorithm)
  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  do K = 1, KC
     do L = 2, LA
        LS = LSC(L)
        FUHU(L,K) = FUHU(L,K) + 0.5_dp * SUB(L) * DYU(L) * HU(L) * &
                     (AH(L,K) + AH(L-1,K)) * (CON1(L-1,K) - CON1(L,K)) * DXIU(L)
        FVHU(L,K) = FVHU(L,K) + 0.5_dp * SVB(L) * DXV(L) * HV(L) * &
                     (AH(L,K) + AH(LS,K)) * (CON1(LS,K) - CON1(L,K)) * DYIV(L)
     end do
  end do

  ! Output a subset of the results for verification
  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  print *, 'Sample results after CALDIFF computation:'
  do K = 1, KC
     print *, 'K =', K, 'FUHU(2:LA, K):', FUHU(2:LA,K)
     print *, 'K =', K, 'FVHU(2:LA, K):', FVHU(2:LA,K)
  end do

  subroutine initialise_arrays()
    ! Initialise all arrays with deterministic values so that the program
    ! can be compiled and run without external input.
    integer :: i, j

    ! Simple linear patterns for illustration
    do i = 1, LCM
       SUB(i)  = 1.0_dp + 0.1_dp*i
       SVB(i)  = 1.0_dp + 0.05_dp*i
       DYU(i)  = 10.0_dp
       DXV(i)  = 10.0_dp
       HU(i)   = 5.0_dp
       HV(i)   = 5.0_dp
       DXIU(i) = 0.01_dp
       DYIV(i) = 0.01_dp
       LSC(i)  = max(i-1,1)   ! neighbour index (simple westward neighbor)
    end do

    do j = 1, KCM
       do i = 1, LCM
          AH(i,j)    = 0.001_dp * i * j
          CON1(i,j)  = 1.0_dp + 0.2_dp*i + 0.1_dp*j
          FUHU(i,j)  = 0.0_dp

    end do

    real(dp), intent(out) :: GAM(N), CH(N), BETA(N), ADW

    real(dp) :: PI, TDES, PDES, DVDMIN, TMIN, DVD, VT2, VD, TC
    real(dp) :: EPSR3, VVIS, PMIN, VP3, DVDA, DVD0, RES, RES_DVD
    real(dp) :: DEL, ADV, PC, ZETA, T, P, ETA, G, XI, DXI, XX
    real(dp) :: ARG, EK, F, FMOD, DOL, RIX1, RIX2, RJX1, RJX2
    real(dp) :: RI1, RI2, RJ1, RJ2, DISCR, PHI, WSQ, W
    integer :: I, ITER_INT

    PI = 3.14159265_dp
    TDES = TDES1
    PDES = PDES1

    if (TDES1 /= 0.0_dp) then
      ! ----- thrust prescribed -----
      DVDMIN = -0.50_dp*VEL
      TMIN   = RHO*PI*RAD**2*2.0_dp*(DVDMIN**2 + VEL*DVDMIN)
      if (TDES < TMIN) then
        print *, 'Limiting windmill thrust to Betz limit:', TMIN

      end do

      PMIN   = RHO*PI*RAD**2*2.0_dp*(DVDMIN**3 + (2.0_dp*VEL+VVIS)*DVDMIN**2 + VEL*(VEL+VVIS)*DVDMIN)

      if (PDES1 == 0.0_dp .or. PDES < PMIN) then
        print *, 'Limiting windmill power to Betz limit:', PMIN
        PDES = 0.99_dp*PMIN
        DVD  = 0.90_dp*DVDMIN
      else
        VP3  = PDES/(0.5_dp*RHO*PI*RAD**2)
        DVDA = abs(VP3)**(1.0_dp/3.0_dp)
        DVD  = sign(DVDA, VP3)
        DVD  = max(DVD, DVDMIN + 0.1_dp*DVD0)
      end if

        DEL = -RES/RES_DVD
        if (DVD == DVDMIN .and. DEL < 0.0_dp) then
          print *, '? Windmill power exceeds Betz limit:', PMIN
          exit
        end if
        DVD = DVD + DEL
        if (abs(DEL/DVD0) < 1.0e-5_dp) exit
        DVD = max(DVD, DVDMIN)
      end do
      if (abs(DEL/DVD0) >= 1.0e-5_dp) then
        print *, '***  Vd convergence failed.  dVd =', DEL
      end if
      VD = VEL + DVD
      PC = PDES/(0.5_dp*RHO*VD**3*PI*RAD**2)
    end if

    ADV = VEL/(OMG*RAD)
    ADW = VD/(OMG*RAD)
    print *, 'Initialization: blades =', BLDS, 'ADV =', ADV, 'ADW =', ADW

    RI1 = 0.0_dp; RI2 = 0.0_dp; RJ1 = 0.0_dp; RJ2 = 0.0_dp
    do I = 1, N
      XI   = R(I)/RAD
      DXI  = DR(I)/RAD
      XX   = XI/ADW
      ARG  = min(20.0_dp, 0.5_dp*BLDS*(1.0_dp - XI)/ADW)
      EK   = exp(-ARG)
      F    = atan2(sqrt(1.0_dp - EK*EK), EK)*2.0_dp/PI
      FMOD = F*sqrt(1.0_dp + (4.0_dp*ADW/(PI*BLDS*XI))**2)
      G    = FMOD*XX*XX/(1.0_dp + XX*XX)
      DOL  = CD(I)/CL(I)
      RIX1 = 4.0_dp*XI*G*(1.0_dp - DOL/XX)
      RIX2 = 2.0_dp*XI*G*(1.0_dp - DOL/XX)/(1.0_dp + XX*XX)
      RJX1 = 4.0_dp*XI*G*(1.0_dp + DOL*XX)
      RJX2 = 2.0_dp*XI*G*(1.0_dp + DOL*XX)*XX*XX/(1.0_dp + XX*XX)
      RI1 = RI1 + RIX1*DXI
      RI2 = RI2 + RIX2*DXI
      RJ1 = RJ1 + RJX1*DXI
      RJ2 = RJ2 + RJX2*DXI
      GAM(I) = G
    end do
    print *, 'Integrals after radial loop: RI1 RI2 RJ1 RJ2 =', RI1, RI2, RJ1, RJ2

    if (TDES1 /= 0.0_dp) then
      ! ----- thrust case -----
      DISCR = 1.0_dp - 4.0_dp*TC*RI2/RI1**2
      if (DISCR < 0.0_dp) then
        print *, 'Setting thrust to minimum'
        DISCR = 0.0_dp
        TC    = 0.25_dp*RI1**2/RI2
      end if
      ZETA = 0.5_dp*RI1/RI2*(1.0_dp - sqrt(DISCR))
      PC   = RJ1*ZETA + RJ2*ZETA**2
    else
      ! ----- power case -----
      DISCR = 1.0_dp + 4.0_dp*PC*RJ2/RJ1**2
      if (DISCR < 0.0_dp .or. PDES1 == 0.0_dp) then
        print *, 'Setting power to minimum'
        DISCR = 0.0_dp
        PC    = -0.25_dp*RJ1**2/RJ2
      end if
      ZETA = 0.5_dp*RJ1/RJ2*(sqrt(DISCR) - 1.0_dp)
      TC   = RI1*ZETA - RI2*ZETA**2
    end if

    ETA = TC/PC*VEL/VD
    T   = 0.5_dp*RHO*VD**2*PI*RAD**2*TC
    P   = 0.5_dp*RHO*VD**3*PI*RAD**2*PC
    print *, 'Performance: ZETA =', ZETA, 'ETA =', ETA, 'Thrust =', T, 'Power =', P

    do I = 1, N
      G    = GAM(I)
      PHI  = atan2(VEL + 0.5_dp*ZETA*VD, OMG*R(I))
      WSQ  = VEL**2 + (OMG*R(I))**2 - (VD*0.5_dp*ZETA*cos(PHI))**2
      W    = sqrt(WSQ)
      BETA(I) = PHI + (CL(I)-CL0(I))/DCLDA(I)
      GAM(I)  = G*(2.0_dp*PI/BLDS)*ZETA*VD**2/OMG
      CH(I)   = 2.0_dp*GAM(I)/(W*CL(I))
    end do

  end subroutine tpdes

end program tpdessim

module tddft_mod
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
  implicit none
contains
  subroutine tddft_s2(tda, nfc, nocc, nmo, nfv, nov, &
                      x1, x2, y1, y2, corr, s2)
    use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
    implicit none

    logical, intent(in)                :: tda
    integer, intent(in), dimension(2)  :: nfc, nocc, nmo, nfv, nov
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: x1(:), x2(:), y1(:), y2(:), corr(:)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: s2

    ! Local variables
    real(dp) :: na, nb
    integer  :: ja1, ka1, ja2, ka2, jb2, kb2, jb1, jb3, ja3, kb1
    integer  :: la1, la2, lb1, lb2
    real(dp) :: s2tol
    real(dp) :: rc1, rc2
    real(dp) :: xa1, xa2, ya1, ya2
    real(dp) :: xb1, xb2, yb1, yb2

    !------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Preliminaries
    !------------------------------------------------------------
    na = real(nocc(1) - nfc(1), dp)
    nb = real(nocc(2) - nfc(2), dp)
    s2tol = 1.0e-5_dp

    s2 = na - (na - nb) / 2.0_dp + ((na - nb) / 2.0_dp)**2

    !=================================================================
    ! == alpha excitation ket ==
    !=================================================================
    la1 = 0
    do ja1 = nfc(1) + 1, nocc(1)
      do ka1 = nocc(1) + 1, nmo(1) - nfv(1)
        la1 = la1 + 1
        xa1 = x1(la1)
        ya1 = 0.0_dp
        if (.not. tda) ya1 = y1(la1)
        if (abs(xa1 + ya1) > s2tol) then
          ! a alpha and j beta exchange
          do jb1 = nfc(2) + 1, nocc(2)
            ! alpha excitation bra
            la2 = 0
            do ja2 = nfc(1) + 1, nocc(1)
              do ka2 = nocc(1) + 1, nmo(1) - nfv(1)
                la2 = la2 + 1
                if (ja1 == ja2) then
                  xa2 = x1(la2)
                  ya2 = 0.0_dp
                  if (.not. tda) ya2 = y1(la2)
                  rc1 = corr((jb1 - 1) * nmo(1) + ka2)
                  rc2 = corr((jb1 - 1) * nmo(1) + ka1)
                  s2 = s2 - (xa2 - ya2) * (xa1 + ya1) * rc1 * rc2
                end if
              end do
            end do
            ! beta excitation bra
            lb2 = 0
            do jb2 = nfc(2) + 1, nocc(2)
              do kb2 = nocc(2) + 1, nmo(2) - nfv(2)
                lb2 = lb2 + 1
                if (jb1 == jb2) then
                  xb2 = x2(lb2)
                  yb2 = 0.0_dp
                  if (.not. tda) yb2 = y2(lb2)
                  rc1 = corr((jb2 - 1) * nmo(1) + ja1)
                  rc2 = corr((kb2 - 1) * nmo(1) + ka1)
                  s2 = s2 - (xb2 - yb2) * (xa1 + ya1) * rc1 * rc2
                end if
              end do
            end do
          end do
          ! i alpha and j beta exchange (same alpha excitation)
          do ja3 = nfc(1) + 1, nocc(1)
            if (ja3 /= ja1) then
              do jb1 = nfc(2) + 1, nocc(2)
                rc1 = corr((jb1 - 1) * nmo(1) + ja3)
                s2 = s2 - (xa1 - ya1) * (xa1 + ya1) * rc1 * rc1
              end do
            end if
          end do
        end if
      end do
    end do

    ! == beta excitation ket ==
    !=================================================================

    do jb1 = nfc(2) + 1, nocc(2)
      do kb1 = nocc(2) + 1, nmo(2) - nfv(2)

        xb1 = x2(lb1)
        yb1 = 0.0_dp

            do jb2 = nfc(2) + 1, nocc(2)
              do kb2 = nocc(2) + 1, nmo(2) - nfv(2)
                lb2 = lb2 + 1
                if (jb1 == jb2) then
                  xb2 = x2(lb2)
                  yb2 = 0.0_dp
                  if (.not. tda) yb2 = y2(lb2)
                  rc1 = corr((kb1 - 1) * nmo(1) + ja1)
                  rc2 = corr((kb2 - 1) * nmo(1) + ja1)
                  s2 = s2 - (xb2 - yb2) * (xb1 + yb1) * rc1 * rc2
                end if
              end do
            end do
            ! alpha excitation bra
            la2 = 0
            do ja2 = nfc(1) + 1, nocc(1)
              do ka2 = nocc(1) + 1, nmo(1) - nfv(1)
                la2 = la2 + 1
                if (ja1 == ja2) then
                  xa2 = x1(la2)
                  ya2 = 0.0_dp
                  if (.not. tda) ya2 = y1(la2)
                  rc1 = corr((jb1 - 1) * nmo(1) + ja2)
                  rc2 = corr((kb1 - 1) * nmo(1) + ka2)
                  s2 = s2 - (xa2 - ya2) * (xb1 + yb1) * rc1 * rc2
                end if
              end do
            end do
          end do
          ! i alpha and j beta exchange (same beta excitation)
          do jb3 = nfc(2) + 1, nocc(2)
            if (jb3 /= jb1) then
              do ja1 = nfc(1) + 1, nocc(1)
                rc1 = corr((jb3 - 1) * nmo(1) + ja1)
                s2 = s2 - (xb1 - yb1) * (xb1 + yb1) * rc1 * rc1
              end do
            end if
          end do
        end if

  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
  use tddft_mod
  implicit none

  logical                :: tda
  integer, dimension(2)  :: nfc, nocc, nmo, nfv, nov
  real(dp), allocatable  :: x1(:), x2(:), y1(:), y2(:), corr(:)
  real(dp)               :: s2
  integer                :: i

  !------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Example data – small system so that loops execute a few times.
  !------------------------------------------------------------
  tda = .false.
  nfc = [0, 0]
  nocc = [2, 2]
  nmo  = [3, 3]
  nfv  = [0, 0]
  nov  = [0, 0]   ! not used in the routine but kept for compatibility

  ! Sizes of excitation vectors (alpha and beta)
  allocate(x1(2), x2(2), y1(2), y2(2), corr(20))

  x1 = [0.1_dp, 0.2_dp]
  y1 = [0.05_dp, 0.05_dp]
  x2 = [0.15_dp, 0.25_dp]
  y2 = [0.07_dp, 0.07_dp]

  end do

  call tddft_s2(tda, nfc, nocc, nmo, nfv, nov, &
                x1, x2, y1, y2, corr, s2)

    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: n

    do i = 1, n
      call random_number(u)

      sum_u = sum(u)
      x(:,i) = u / sum_u   ! barycentric coordinates, automatically satisfy sum=1

    do i = 1, n

    end do

    integer, intent(in) :: e(3)
    real(rk), intent(out) :: exact
    integer :: i, total

      real(dp) :: ps(nopes,3)
      real(dp) :: dd

      ! Compute side vectors of the quadrilateral (ps)
      !-------------------------------------------------------------
      do i = 1, 3
         do j = 1, nopes-1
            ps(j,i) = col(i,j+1) - col(i,j)
         end do
         ps(nopes,i) = col(i,1) - col(i,nopes)
      end do

      !-------------------------------------------------------------
      ! Mean normal to the quadrilateral (provided by xn)
      !-------------------------------------------------------------
      do i = 1, 3
         straight(4*nopes + i) = xn(i)
      end do

      !-------------------------------------------------------------
      ! Cross product ps(j,:) x xn  (normalised)
      !-------------------------------------------------------------
      do j = 1, nopes

  subroutine zungr2(M,N,K,A,LDA,TAU,WORK,INFO)
    integer, intent(in) :: M,N,K,LDA
    complex(dp), intent(inout) :: A(LDA,*)
    complex(dp), intent(in) :: TAU(*)
    complex(dp), intent(inout) :: WORK(*)
    integer, intent(out) :: INFO
    integer :: I, II, J, L
    complex(dp), parameter :: ONE = (1.0_dp,0.0_dp), ZERO = (0.0_dp,0.0_dp)

    ! ---- argument checks -------------------------------------------------
    INFO = 0
    if (M < 0) then
       INFO = -1
    else if (N < M) then
       INFO = -2
    else if (K < 0 .or. K > M) then
       INFO = -3
    else if (LDA < max(1,M)) then
       INFO = -5
    end if
    if (INFO /= 0) then
       call xerbla('ZUNGR2', -INFO)
       return
    end if
    if (M <= 0) return

    ! ---- initialise rows 1:m‑k to rows of the identity matrix ------------
    if (K < M) then
       do J = 1, N
          do L = 1, M-K
             A(L,J) = ZERO
          end do
          if (J > N-M .and. J <= N-K) then
             A(M-N+J,J) = ONE
          end if
       end do
    end if

    ! ---- main loop over elementary reflectors ---------------------------
    do I = 1, K
       II = M - K + I
       call zlacgv(N-M+II-1, A(II,1), LDA)
       A(II, N-M+II) = ONE
       call zlarf('Right', II-1, N-M+II, A(II,1), LDA, dconjg(TAU(I)), A, LDA, WORK)
       call zscal(N-M+II-1, -TAU(I), A(II,1), LDA)
       call zlacgv(N-M+II-1, A(II,1), LDA)
       A(II, N-M+II) = ONE - dconjg(TAU(I))
       do L = N-M+II+1, N
          A(II,L) = ZERO
       end do
    end do

  subroutine zlacgv(N, X, INCX)
    integer, intent(in) :: N, INCX
    complex(dp), intent(inout) :: X(*)
    integer :: i, ix
    do i = 1, N
       ix = 1 + (i-1)*INCX
       X(ix) = conjg(X(ix))
    end do
  end subroutine zlacgv

  subroutine zscal(N, ALPHA, X, INCX)
    integer, intent(in) :: N, INCX
    complex(dp), intent(in) :: ALPHA
    complex(dp), intent(inout) :: X(*)
    integer :: i, ix
    do i = 1, N
       ix = 1 + (i-1)*INCX
       X(ix) = ALPHA * X(ix)
    end do
  end subroutine zscal

  subroutine zlarf(SIDE, M, N, V, INCV, TAU, C, LDC, WORK)
    character(*), intent(in) :: SIDE
    integer, intent(in) :: M, N, INCV, LDC
    complex(dp), intent(in) :: V(*), TAU
    complex(dp), intent(inout) :: C(LDC,*), WORK(*)
    integer :: i, j
    if (TAU == (0.0_dp,0.0_dp)) return
    if (trim(SIDE) == 'Right' .or. trim(SIDE) == 'right') then
       ! w = C * v
       do i = 1, M
          WORK(i) = (0.0_dp,0.0_dp)
          do j = 1, N
             WORK(i) = WORK(i) + C(i,j) * V(1 + (j-1)*INCV)
          end do
       end do
       ! C = C - w * (TAU * v^H)
       do i = 1, M
          do j = 1, N
             C(i,j) = C(i,j) - WORK(i) * TAU * conjg(V(1 + (j-1)*INCV))
          end do
       end do
    else
       ! Left‑side application not needed for this test
    end if
  end subroutine zlarf

program calper_demo
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64
  implicit none
  integer :: nout, shorto
  real(dp) :: cvect(3), perpve(3), pervpn(3)

  nout = 6
  shorto = 0
  cvect = [0.0_dp, 0.0_dp, 1.0_dp]   ! unit vector along z

  call calper(nout, shorto, cvect, perpve, pervpn)

contains

  subroutine calper(NOUT, SHORTO, CVECT, PERPVE, PERPVN)
    integer, intent(in) :: NOUT
    integer, intent(in) :: SHORTO
    real(dp), intent(in) :: CVECT(3)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: PERPVE(3), PERPVN(3)
    real(dp) :: CDOTP

    ! Determine an initial East vector
    if (abs(CVECT(2)) < 1.0e-6_dp .and. abs(CVECT(3)) < 1.0e-6_dp) then
       PERPVE = [0.0_dp, 1.0_dp, 0.0_dp]
    else
       PERPVE = [1.0_dp, 0.0_dp, 0.0_dp]
    end if

    ! Remove component parallel to CVECT
    CDOTP = dot_product(CVECT, PERPVE)
    PERPVE = PERPVE - CDOTP*CVECT

    ! Normalize to unit length
    call normalize_vector(PERPVE)

    ! Compute north vector as cross product (PERPVE x CVECT)
    call cross_product(PERPVE, CVECT, PERPVN)

    ! Output if requested
    if (SHORTO < 2) then
       write(NOUT,'(A)') '  Some routines (e.g. conn) need vectors normal to cvect: '
       write(NOUT,'(A,3F8.3)') '     EAST Zero degrees angle is along vector ', PERPVE
       write(NOUT,'(A,3F8.3)') '     NORTH  90 degrees angle is along vector ', PERPVN
    end if
  end subroutine calper

  function dot_product(a,b) result(res)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: a(3), b(3)
    real(dp) :: res
    res = a(1)*b(1) + a(2)*b(2) + a(3)*b(3)

  nout = 6

  call calper(nout, shorto, cvect, perpve, pervpn)

  subroutine calper(NOUT, SHORTO, CVECT, PERPVE, PERPVN)
    integer, intent(in) :: NOUT
    integer, intent(in) :: SHORTO
    real(dp), intent(in) :: CVECT(3)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: PERPVE(3), PERPVN(3)
    real(dp) :: CDOTP

    ! Determine an initial East vector
    if (abs(CVECT(2)) < 1.0e-6_dp .and. abs(CVECT(3)) < 1.0e-6_dp) then
       PERPVE = [0.0_dp, 1.0_dp, 0.0_dp]
    else
       PERPVE = [1.0_dp, 0.0_dp, 0.0_dp]
    end if

    ! Remove component parallel to CVECT
    CDOTP = dot_product(CVECT, PERPVE)
    PERPVE = PERPVE - CDOTP*CVECT

    ! Normalize to unit length
    call normalize_vector(PERPVE)

    ! Compute north vector as cross product (PERPVE x CVECT)
    call cross_product(PERPVE, CVECT, PERPVN)

!=====================================================================
! Stand‑alone Fortran 90 program reproducing the TSDIGT subroutine.
! It uses hard‑coded example values and local replacements for the
! external routines RANNOR (Gaussian random numbers) and RNDM (uniform).
!=====================================================================
program tsdigt_demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   implicit none

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Parameters and test inputs (representative small values)
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   integer, parameter :: nchan = 3
   integer :: KCHAN          ! channel type: 1=wire, 2=pad, 3=trig
   integer :: IADC1, NLADC   ! first bin and number of bins
   integer :: ITMADC = 0     ! bank offset (hard‑coded to 0 for demo)
   integer :: NTPBIT = 10    ! number of FADC bits
   real(dp) :: TSIGMX = 1.0_dp        ! max shaping signal (Volts)
   real(dp) :: SDIDEF = 0.01_dp       ! differential non‑linearity level
   real(dp) :: SGADEF = 0.05_dp       ! sigma for gain variation
   real(dp) :: SPEDEF = 0.02_dp       ! sigma for pedestal variation
   real(dp) :: PEDDEF = 0.1_dp        ! pedestal (Volts)

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Working arrays (size chosen to be comfortably large for demo)
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   integer, dimension(2000) :: IW          ! integer ADC output bank
   real(dp), dimension(2000) :: RW         ! double‑precision signal bank
   real(dp), allocatable :: rndm(:)        ! uniform random numbers

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Local variables
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   integer :: I, IBK, MAXDIG
   real(dp) :: SDIFF, RDIFNL, RGAVR, RPDVR
   logical :: LGPVR, LDFNL

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Initialise test case
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   KCHAN = 1            ! wire channel (change to 2 for pads, 3 for trig)
   IADC1 = 0
   NLADC = 10           ! ten time buckets for the demo

   ! Compute derived constants
   MAXDIG = 2**NTPBIT - 1
   SDIFF  = SDIDEF * TSIGMX / real(MAXDIG, dp)

   LGPVR = (SGADEF /= 0.0_dp .or. SPEDEF /= 0.0_dp)
   LDFNL = (SDIDEF /= 0.0_dp)

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Random numbers for gain and pedestal variations (Gaussian)
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   call rannor(RGAVR, RPDVR)
   if (KCHAN == 2) then
      RGAVR = RGAVR * 0.5_dp
      RPDVR = RPDVR * 0.5_dp
   end if
   if (.not. LGPVR) then
      RGAVR = 0.0_dp
      RPDVR = 0.0_dp
   end if

   ! Differential non‑linearity factor for this channel
   if (LDFNL) then
      if (KCHAN == 2) then
         RDIFNL = SDIFF * 0.5_dp
      else
         RDIFNL = SDIFF
      end if
   else
      RDIFNL = 0.0_dp
   end if

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Uniform random numbers for the differential non‑linearity term
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   allocate(IW(10))
   call random_number(rndm)   ! values in [0,1)

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Initialise the shaped analog signal (simple linear ramp for demo)
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   do I = 1, NLADC
      RW(ITMADC + I) = real(I, dp) * 0.05_dp   ! arbitrary signal shape
   end do

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Main digitisation loop – faithfully follows the original logic
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   do I = 1, NLADC
      IBK = IADC1 + I

      ! Gain variation (same for whole pulse)
      RW(ITMADC + IBK) = RW(ITMADC + IBK) * (1.0_dp + SGADEF * RGAVR)

      ! Add pedestal and its variation
      RW(ITMADC + IBK) = RW(ITMADC + IBK) + PEDDEF
      RW(ITMADC + IBK) = RW(ITMADC + IBK) + RPDVR * SPEDEF

      ! Differential non‑linearity (changes each bucket)
      if (LDFNL) then
         RW(ITMADC + IBK) = RW(ITMADC + IBK) + &
              (rndm(I) - 0.5_dp) * RDIFNL * RW(ITMADC + IBK)
      end if

      ! Digitise, clipping to the ADC range
      IW(ITMADC + IBK) = int( max( real(MAXDIG, dp) * RW(ITMADC + IBK) / TSIGMX, 0.0_dp) )
      if (IW(ITMADC + IBK) < 0)      IW(ITMADC + IBK) = 0
      if (IW(ITMADC + IBK) > MAXDIG) IW(ITMADC + IBK) = MAXDIG
   end do

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Output the resulting ADC values
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   print *, 'Digitised ADC values (KCHAN =', KCHAN, ') :'
   print '(100I5)', IW(ITMADC + 1 : ITMADC + NLADC)

contains

   !=================================================================
   ! RANNOR – generate two independent standard normal deviates.
   ! Simple Box‑Muller implementation using intrinsic random_number.
   !=================================================================
   subroutine rannor(g1, g2)
      real(dp), intent(out) :: g1, g2
      real(dp) :: u1, u2, s
      call random_number(u1)
      call random_number(u2)
      if (u1 <= 0.0_dp) u1 = epsilon(1.0_dp)
      s = sqrt(-2.0_dp * log(u1))
      g1 = s * cos(2.0_dp * acos(-1.0_dp) * u2)
      g2 = s * sin(2.0_dp * acos(-1.0_dp) * u2)
   end subroutine rannor

end program tsdigt_demo

         end if
      end do

      integer,  intent(in)  :: n

    real(dp), intent(out) :: res
    integer :: i, ix, iy
    res = 0.0_dp
    ix = 1
    iy = 1
    do i = 1, N
       res = res + X(ix) * Y(iy)
       ix = ix + INCX
       iy = iy + INCY
    end do

  subroutine daxpy(N, A, X, INCX, Y, INCY)
    integer, intent(in) :: N, INCX, INCY
    real(dp), intent(in) :: A
    real(dp), intent(in) :: X(*)
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: Y(*)
    integer :: i, ix, iy
    ix = 1
    iy = 1
    do i = 1, N
       Y(iy) = Y(iy) + A * X(ix)
       ix = ix + INCX
       iy = iy + INCY
    end do

    integer, intent(in) :: N, INCX

    sum = 0.0_dp
    ix = 1
    do i = 1, N

       ix = ix + INCX
    end do

    real(dp), intent(inout) :: X(*)

    else

       ALPHA = beta

          do i = 1, N-1

    smin = sqrt( max( (f2 + h2 - term) / 2.0_dp, 0.0_dp ) )

  end subroutine dlas2

   !> derivative dY/dalpha.

   !>  N = 2/sqrt(pi)

   !>      Y = fac * sin(k*alpha) / sin(2*alpha)
   !>  where  k = 2*m+2  and  fac = 2*N.
   !>  The derivative follows from the quotient rule.
   !>  Near the singular points alpha = 0 and alpha = pi/2 the limit
   !>  is taken analytically (L'Hôpital).
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine mang(yang, dyang, a, nrmalf, pi2, fac, m)
      implicit none

         cos2a = cos(2.0_dp * a)   ! will be +1 (alpha≈0) or -1 (alpha≈pi/2)
         coska = cos(k * a)
         ! Limit of Y from L'Hôpital: Y -> fac * k * cos(k*a) / (2*cos(2*a))
         yang = fac * k * coska / (2.0_dp * cos2a)

program drgset_demo
   implicit none
   ! Kind parameters
   integer, parameter :: dp = selected_real_kind(15,307)

   !----------------------------------------------------------
   ! Problem size (small representative values)
   !----------------------------------------------------------
   integer, parameter :: imax = 4
   integer, parameter :: jmax = 4

   ! Input parameters (hard‑coded example values)
   !----------------------------------------------------------
   real(dp) :: adrag = 0.1_dp          ! base drag coefficient
   real(dp) :: drgf  = 2.0_dp          ! drag factor
   integer  :: kmxdrg = 3             ! depth threshold
   integer  :: jeb    = 1             ! equatorial band half‑width

   !----------------------------------------------------------
   ! Model arrays (simple synthetic data)
   !----------------------------------------------------------
   integer, dimension(0:imax+1,0:jmax+1) :: k1
   real(dp), dimension(2,0:imax+1,0:jmax+1) :: drag

   integer :: i, j

   ! Initialise the depth indicator k1 with a simple pattern
   do j = 0, jmax+1
      do i = 0, imax+1
         k1(i,j) = mod(i + j, 5)   ! values 0‑4, some will exceed kmxdrg
      end do
   end do

   ! Call the core routine
   call drgset(adrag, drgf, kmxdrg, jeb, k1, drag, imax, jmax)

   ! Print a few results for verification
   print *, '--- Drag array (component 1) ---'
   do j = 1, jmax
      write(*,'(100(f8.4,1x))') (drag(1,i,j), i=1,imax)
   end do
   print *, '--- Drag array (component 2) ---'
   do j = 1, jmax
      write(*,'(100(f8.4,1x))') (drag(2,i,j), i=1,imax+1)
   end do

contains

   subroutine drgset(adrag, drgf, kmxdrg, jeb, k1, drag, imax, jmax)
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in) :: imax, jmax, kmxdrg, jeb
      real(dp), intent(in) :: adrag, drgf
      integer, intent(in), dimension(0:imax+1,0:jmax+1) :: k1
      real(dp), intent(out), dimension(2,0:imax+1,0:jmax+1) :: drag

      real(dp), dimension(0:imax-1,0:jmax-1) :: tmpdrg
      integer :: i, j, i1, i1p, j1
      integer :: kloc2, kloc4

      !------------------------------------------------------
      ! calculate drag at psi points (temporary variable)
      !------------------------------------------------------
      do j = 0, jmax
         do i = 0, imax
            kloc2 = max(k1(i,j), k1(i+1,j), k1(i,j+1), k1(i+1,j+1))
            kloc4 = k1(i,j)
            do j1 = max(0, j-1), min(jmax+1, j+2)
               do i1 = i-1, i+2
                  i1p = 1 + mod(imax + i1 - 1, imax)
                  kloc4 = max(kloc4, k1(i1p, j1))
               end do
            end do
            if (kloc2 > kmxdrg .or. abs(j - jmax/2) <= jeb) then
               tmpdrg(i,j) = adrag * drgf * drgf
            else if (kloc4 > kmxdrg .or. abs(j - jmax/2) == jeb+1) then
               tmpdrg(i,j) = adrag * drgf
            else
               tmpdrg(i,j) = adrag
            end if
         end do
      end do

      !------------------------------------------------------
      ! interpolate to velocity points
      !------------------------------------------------------
      do j = 1, jmax
         do i = 1, imax
            drag(1,i,j) = 0.5_dp * (tmpdrg(i,j) + tmpdrg(i,j-1))
            drag(2,i,j) = 0.5_dp * (tmpdrg(i,j) + tmpdrg(i-1,j))
         end do
      end do

      !------------------------------------------------------
      ! boundary conditions (periodic in i‑direction for component 2)
      !------------------------------------------------------
      do j = 1, jmax
         drag(2,imax+1,j) = drag(2,1,j)
      end do

   end subroutine drgset

end program drgset_demo

  !===================================================================
  real(dp) function SSXLAM(s, m1sq, m2sq) result(lam)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: s, m1sq, m2sq

program insol_demo
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
  implicit none

  !----------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Kind parameters and physical constants (double precision)
  !----------------------------------------------------------------
  real(dp), parameter :: pi      = 3.14159265358979323844_dp
  real(dp), parameter :: parfrac = 0.4_dp          ! photosynthetically active fraction
  real(dp), parameter :: solar   = 1360.0_dp       ! solar constant [W m^-2]
  real(dp), parameter :: albedo  = 0.60_dp        ! planetary albedo

  !----------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Input variables – hard‑coded representative values
  !----------------------------------------------------------------
  real(dp) :: boxtime   ! current time (e.g. days since start of simulation)
  real(dp) :: sinayr    ! length of the year (days)
  real(dp) :: boxlat    ! latitude in degrees (will be converted to radians)
  real(dp) :: sfac      ! output: solar radiation factor

  ! Example values (feel free to modify for testing)
  boxtime = 100.0_dp          ! day 100 of the simulation
  sinayr  = 365.0_dp          ! one Earth year
  boxlat  = 45.0_dp           ! 45° north latitude

  call insol(boxtime, sinayr, boxlat, sfac)

  print *, 'Input:'
  print *, '  boxtime =', boxtime
  print *, '  sinayr  =', sinayr
  print *, '  boxlat  =', boxlat, '(degrees)'
  print *, 'Result:'
  print *, '  sfac    =', sfac

contains

  !================================================================
  ! Subroutine INSOL – converted to free‑form Fortran 90
  !================================================================
  subroutine insol(boxtime, sinayr, boxlat, sfac)
    implicit none
    real(dp), intent(in)    :: boxtime   ! simulation time (same units as sinayr)
    real(dp), intent(in)    :: sinayr    ! length of the year (same units as boxtime)
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: boxlat    ! latitude in degrees – overwritten with radians
    real(dp), intent(out)   :: sfac      ! output factor (W m^-2, limited lower bound)

    ! Local variables
    real(dp) :: dayfrac, yday, delta, sun, dayhrs, cosz, frac, fluxi

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 1. Fraction of the year that has elapsed (radians)
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    dayfrac = mod(boxtime, sinayr) / sinayr          ! fraction of year [0,1)
    yday    = 2.0_dp * pi * dayfrac                 ! convert to angle [rad]

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 2. Solar declination (Fourier series – Paltridge & Parson)
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    delta = 0.006918_dp                                 &
          - 0.399912_dp * cos(yday)                    &
          + 0.070257_dp * sin(yday)                    &
          - 0.006758_dp * cos(2.0_dp * yday)           &
          + 0.000907_dp * sin(2.0_dp * yday)           &
          - 0.002697_dp * cos(3.0_dp * yday)           &
          + 0.001480_dp * sin(3.0_dp * yday)

    !--------------------------------------------------------------

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    boxlat = boxlat * (pi / 180.0_dp)

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    sun = max(-0.999_dp, min( &
          -sin(delta) / cos(delta) * sin(boxlat) / cos(boxlat) , 0.999_dp))

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 5. Day length (in radians) and mean cosine of solar zenith angle
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    dayhrs = abs(acos(sun))
    cosz   = sin(delta) * sin(boxlat) + &
             (cos(delta) * cos(boxlat) * sin(dayhrs) / dayhrs)
    cosz   = max(cosz, 5.0e-3_dp)      ! avoid division by zero / tiny values

    ! 6. Fraction of the day that is daylight
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    frac = dayhrs / pi

    !--------------------------------------------------------------

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    fluxi = solar * (1.0_dp - albedo) * cosz * frac * parfrac

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 8. Final factor – enforce a small positive lower bound
    !--------------------------------------------------------------

module fifo_mod
  implicit none

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Type representing a node in the queue.
  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  type :: fifo_node
     integer                     :: datum = 0
     type(fifo_node), pointer    :: next  => null()
     logical                     :: valid = .false.
  end type fifo_node

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Type representing the queue head (contains pointers to first and
  ! last nodes).
  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  type :: fifo_head
     type(fifo_node), pointer :: head => null()
     type(fifo_node), pointer :: tail => null()
  end type fifo_head

contains

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Initialise an empty queue.
  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  subroutine new_fifo(h)
    type(fifo_head), intent(out) :: h
    nullify(h%head)
    nullify(h%tail)
  end subroutine new_fifo

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Enqueue a node onto the queue.
  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  subroutine fifo_enqueue(h, n)
    type(fifo_head), intent(inout)           :: h
    type(fifo_node), intent(inout), target   :: n

    if (associated(h%tail)) then
       h%tail%next => n
       h%tail => n
    else
       h%tail => n
       h%head => n
    end if
    nullify(n%next)
  end subroutine fifo_enqueue

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Dequeue a node from the queue. The returned node has its VALID flag
  ! set to .true. if a node was extracted, otherwise .false.
  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  subroutine fifo_dequeue(h, n)
    type(fifo_head), intent(inout)           :: h
    type(fifo_node), intent(out), target     :: n

    if (associated(h%head)) then
       n = h%head               ! copy the node contents
       if (associated(n%next)) then
          h%head => n%next
       else
          nullify(h%head)
          nullify(h%tail)
       end if
       n%valid = .true.
    else
       n%valid = .false.
    end if
    nullify(n%next)
  end subroutine fifo_dequeue

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Return .true. if the queue is empty, .false. otherwise.
  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  logical function fifo_isempty(h)
    type(fifo_head), intent(in) :: h
    if (associated(h%head)) then
       fifo_isempty = .false.
    else
       fifo_isempty = .true.
    end if
  end function fifo_isempty

  ds  = 0.1_dp

    implicit none

    call map2polar(xd, yd, zd, l, th)

    res = kappa * sin(lp)**2 * cos(th)**2 * cos(pi * t / Tfinal) - &

  !=================================================================
  subroutine map2polar(x, y, z, lambda, th)
    implicit none
    integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: x, y, z
    real(dp), intent(out) :: lambda, th
    real(dp) :: r

    th = asin(z / r)
    lambda = atan2(y, x)

  end subroutine map2polar

  end do

   else
      print *, 'CGESV returned INFO =', info
   end if

contains

   subroutine cgesv(N, NRHS, A, LDA, IPIV, B, LDB, INFO)
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in) :: N, NRHS, LDA, LDB
      complex(cp), intent(inout) :: A(LDA, *), B(LDB, *)
      integer, intent(out) :: IPIV(*), INFO

      INFO = 0
      if (N < 0) then
         INFO = -1
      else if (NRHS < 0) then
         INFO = -2
      else if (LDA < max(1, N)) then
         INFO = -4
      else if (LDB < max(1, N)) then
         INFO = -7
      end if
      if (INFO /= 0) then
         print *, 'Argument error in CGESV, INFO =', INFO
         return
      end if

      call cgetrf(N, N, A, LDA, IPIV, INFO)
      if (INFO == 0) then
         call cgetrs('N', N, NRHS, A, LDA, IPIV, B, LDB, INFO)
      end if
   end subroutine cgesv

   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine cgetrf(M, N, A, LDA, IPIV, INFO)
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in) :: M, N, LDA
      complex(cp), intent(inout) :: A(LDA, *)
      integer, intent(out) :: IPIV(*), INFO
      integer :: i, j, piv, k
      complex(cp) :: temp
      real(cp) :: maxval, curval

      INFO = 0
      do i = 1, min(M, N)
         ! Find pivot row
         maxval = 0.0_cp
         piv = i
         do k = i, M
            curval = abs(A(k,i))
            if (curval > maxval) then
               maxval = curval
               piv = k
            end if
         end do
         IPIV(i) = piv

         if (maxval == 0.0_cp) then
            INFO = i
            return
         end if

         ! Row interchange if needed
         if (piv /= i) then
            do j = 1, N
               temp = A(i,j)
               A(i,j) = A(piv,j)
               A(piv,j) = temp
            end do
         end if

         ! Compute multipliers and eliminate
         if (i < M) then
            do k = i+1, M
               A(k,i) = A(k,i) / A(i,i)
            end do
            do j = i+1, N
               do k = i+1, M
                  A(k,j) = A(k,j) - A(k,i) * A(i,j)
               end do
            end do
         end if
      end do
   end subroutine cgetrf

   subroutine cgetrs(TRANS, N, NRHS, A, LDA, IPIV, B, LDB, INFO)
      implicit none
      character(len=*), intent(in) :: TRANS
      integer, intent(in) :: N, NRHS, LDA, LDB
      complex(cp), intent(in) :: A(LDA, *)
      integer, intent(in) :: IPIV(*)
      complex(cp), intent(inout) :: B(LDB, *)
      integer, intent(out) :: INFO
      integer :: i, j, k
      complex(cp) :: sum

      INFO = 0
      if (TRANS /= 'N' .and. TRANS /= 'n') then
         print *, 'Only No‑transpose case is implemented in CGETRS.'
         INFO = -1
         return
      end if

      ! Apply row interchanges to B according to IPIV
      do i = 1, N
         if (IPIV(i) /= i) then
            do j = 1, NRHS
               sum = B(i,j)
               B(i,j) = B(IPIV(i),j)
               B(IPIV(i),j) = sum
            end do
         end if
      end do

      ! Solve L*y = B  (forward substitution, L has unit diagonal)
      do i = 1, N
         do j = 1, NRHS
            sum = B(i,j)
            do k = 1, i-1
               sum = sum - A(i,k) * B(k,j)
            end do
            B(i,j) = sum   ! L has 1 on diagonal, so division not needed
         end do
      end do

      ! Solve U*x = y  (back substitution)
      do i = N, 1, -1
         do j = 1, NRHS
            sum = B(i,j)
            do k = i+1, N
               sum = sum - A(i,k) * B(k,j)
            end do
            if (A(i,i) == (0.0_cp,0.0_cp)) then
               INFO = i
               return
            end if
            B(i,j) = sum / A(i,i)
         end do
      end do
   end subroutine cgetrs

   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine print_complex_matrix(MAT, rows, cols)
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in) :: rows, cols

         write(*,'( *(F12.6,SP,F12.6,"i") )') (real(MAT(i,j)), aimag(MAT(i,j)), j=1,cols)
      end do
   end subroutine print_complex_matrix

end program demo_cgesv

   !===================================================================
   subroutine dlarnv(idist, iseed, n, x)
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in)    :: idist
      integer, intent(inout) :: iseed(4)
      integer, intent(in)    :: n
      real(DP), intent(out)  :: x(*)

      integer :: iv, il, il2, i
      real(DP) :: u(LV)

      do iv = 1, n, LV/2
         il = min(LV/2, n - iv + 1)

         else
            il2 = il
         end if

         ! Generate il2 uniform (0,1) numbers in U(1:il2)
         call dlaruv(iseed, il2, u)

         select case (idist)
         case (1)   ! uniform (0,1)
            do i = 1, il

program collq_test
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   implicit none

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   !  Parameters – tiny test mesh
   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   integer, parameter :: jdim = 3, kdim = 3, idim = 3
   integer, parameter :: jj2 = 2, kk2 = 2, ii2 = 2
   integer, parameter :: nbuf = 5, ibufdim = 10, nummem = 2

                    tursavf,tursavc, nbl, nou, bou, nbuf, ibufdim, nummem)
      use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
      implicit none

      integer, intent(in) :: jdim,kdim,idim,jj2,kk2,ii2
      integer, intent(in) :: nbl, nbuf, ibufdim, nummem
      integer, intent(inout) :: nou(nbuf)
      character(len=120), intent(inout) :: bou(ibufdim,nbuf)

      real(dp), intent(in)  :: q(jdim,kdim,idim,5)
      real(dp), intent(out) :: qq(jj2,kk2,ii2,5)

      real(dp), intent(in)  :: res(jdim,kdim,idim-1,5)

      real(dp), intent(in)  :: tursavf(jdim,kdim,idim,nummem)

      integer :: ii, jj, kk, j, k

      ! they need no declaration here.

         write(bou(nou(1),1),*)

      j1 = kdim - 1
      k1 = idim - 1

      !-----------------------------------------------------------------

            qr(:,:,i,l) = 0.0_dp
         end do
      end do

                                      + qw(j+1,k,i,n)  + qw(j+1,k,i+1,n) &
                                      + qw(j,k+1,i,n)  + qw(j,k+1,i+1,n) &
                                      + qw(j+1,k+1,i,n)+ qw(j+1,k+1,i+1,n)) / &
                                      volc(jj,kk,ii)
                     qr(jj,kk,ii,n) = (res(j,k,i,n)    + res(j,k,i+1,n) &
                                      + res(j+1,k,i,n) + res(j+1,k,i+1,n) &
                                      + res(j,k+1,i,n) + res(j,k+1,i+1,n) &
                                      + res(j+1,k+1,i,n)+ res(j+1,k+1,i+1,n))

                         (ivisc(2) > 1 .and. n == 1) .or. &

                                                      + vistf(j+1,k,i)   + vistf(j+1,k,i+1) &
                                                      + vistf(j,k+1,i)   + vistf(j,k+1,i+1) &
                                                      + vistf(j+1,k+1,i) + vistf(j+1,k+1,i+1))
                     end if

               end do
            end do

            !-----------------------------------------------------------------

            i = 1
            kk = 0
            do k = 1, kdim-1, 2
               kk = kk + 1
               jj = 0
               do j = 1, jdim-1, 2
                  jj = jj + 1
                  qq(jj,kk,ii,n) = (qw(j,k,i,n)    + qw(j+1,k,i,n) &
                                   + qw(j,k+1,i,n)  + qw(j+1,k+1,i,n)) / &
                                   volc(jj,kk,ii)
                  qr(jj,kk,ii,n) = (res(j,k,i,n)    + res(j+1,k,i,n) &

                      (ivisc(3) > 1 .and. n == 1)) then

                                                   + vistf(j,k+1,i) + vistf(j+1,k+1,i))
                  end if
               end do
            end do
         end if

      !-----------------------------------------------------------------

                  end do

               kk = 0
               do k = 1, kdim-1, 2
                  kk = kk + 1
                  jj = 0
                  do j = 1, jdim-1, 2
                     jj = jj + 1
                     tursavc(jj,kk,ii,n) = 0.25_dp * (tursavf(j,k,i,n) + tursavf(j+1,k,i,n) &
                                                      + tursavf(j,k+1,i,n) + tursavf(j+1,k+1,i,n))
                  end do
               end do
            end if
         end do
      end if

   end subroutine collq

   !=================================================================

  integer, parameter :: mw = 2

  ! Global data (normally from includes / common blocks)
  real(dp) :: utr(nl,lw) = 0.0_dp
  real(dp) :: ur(lw,nl) = 0.0_dp
  real(dp) :: temr(lw,mw,nl) = 0.0_dp
  real(dp) :: ter(lw,mw,nl) = 0.0_dp
  real(dp) :: temi(lw,mw,nl) = 0.0_dp
  real(dp) :: tei(lw,mw,nl) = 0.0_dp
  real(dp) :: prr(1,1) = 1.0_dp
  real(dp), parameter :: sq2 = sqrt(2.0_dp)
  logical :: chenflag = .true.
  character(len=50) :: exptyp = 'INITIAL_EXPERIMENT_TYPE_CHEN_NOT_SET               '
  character(len=50) :: header2 = '                                                  '
  character(len=5)  :: lsm_type = 'nsib '
  real(dp) :: pbar
  integer :: i   ! loop index used in the main program

  print *, '--- Before zerogi call with ind = 1 ---'
  call zerogi(1, exptyp)
  print *, 'utr after ind=1:'
  do i = 1, nl
    print *, utr(i,:)
  end do
  print *, 'ur after ind=1:'
  do i = 1, lw
    print *, ur(i,:)
  end do
  print *, 'header2:', header2
  print *, 'exptyp :', exptyp

  print *, '--- Calling zerogi with ind = 2 ---'
  call zerogi(2, exptyp)
  print *, 'utr after ind=2:'
  do i = 1, nl
    print *, utr(i,:)
  end do
  print *, 'ur after ind=2:'
  do i = 1, lw
    print *, ur(i,:)
  end do
  print *, 'header2 after ind=2:', header2
  print *, 'exptyp  after ind=2:', exptyp
  print *, 'pbar =', pbar

contains

  subroutine zerogi(ind, exptyp)
    integer, intent(in) :: ind
    character(len=*), intent(inout) :: exptyp
    integer :: ll, k, mm

    if (ind /= 1) goto 20

    ! **** IND = 1 ONLY : BEFORE PHYS LOOP ****
    do ll = 1, lw
      do k = 1, nl
        utr(k, ll) = 0.0_dp
      end do
    end do
    return

20  continue
    ! **** IND = 2 ONLY : BEFORE DYNM LOOP ****
    do k = 1, nl
      do ll = 1, lw
        ur(ll, k) = utr(k, ll)
      end do
    end do

    if (chenflag .and. exptyp(42:45) /= 'CHEN') then
      do k = 1, nl
        do mm = 1, mw
          do ll = 1, lw
            temr(ll, mm, k) = ter(ll, mm, k)
            temi(ll, mm, k) = tei(ll, mm, k)
          end do
        end do
      end do
      exptyp(42:45) = 'CHEN'
      print *, 'zerogi: Finished initializing CHEN temperature variable'
    end if

    if (lsm_type == 'nsib ' .and. header2(38:42) /= 'SOIL9') then
      header2(38:42) = 'SOIL9'
      print *, 'New NSIB 9 soil types initialized in surfa.'
    end if

    if (lsm_type == 'nsib ' .and. header2(44:48) /= 'SNALB') then
      header2(44:48) = 'SNALB'
      print *, 'New NSIB snow albedo data initialized in surfset.'
    end if

    if (lsm_type == 'nsib ' .and. header2(50:50) /= 'M') then
      header2(50:50) = 'M'
      print *, 'New NSIB soil moisture, temperature and snow data initialized in surfa.'
      print *, 'NB: Model needs 2 years to equilibrate for this scheme.'
    end if

    pbar = prr(1,1) / sq2

    return
  end subroutine zerogi

end program zerogi_demo

! Test program for ZSYMM (complex*16 symmetric matrix‑matrix multiply)
! Fixed version that compiles with modern Fortran.

program test_zsymm
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
  implicit none

  integer, parameter :: m = 2, n = 2
  character(len=1) :: side, uplo
  complex(dp) :: alpha, beta
  integer :: lda, ldb, ldc
  complex(dp), allocatable :: a(:,:), b(:,:), c(:,:)

  ! -------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Hard‑coded example parameters
  side = 'L'          ! compute C = alpha*A*B + beta*C
  uplo = 'U'          ! upper triangle of A is referenced
  alpha = (1.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
  beta  = (0.0_dp, 0.0_dp)

  lda = m
  ldb = m
  ldc = m

  allocate(a(lda,m))   ! A is m×m when SIDE='L'
  allocate(b(ldb,n))   ! B is m×n
  allocate(c(ldc,n))   ! C is m×n

  ! Symmetric matrix A (upper triangle stored, lower ignored)
  a = (0.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
  a(1,1) = (1.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
  a(1,2) = (2.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
  a(2,2) = (3.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
  ! (lower part not referenced when UPLO='U')

  ! General matrix B
  b = reshape([ (4.0_dp,0.0_dp), (5.0_dp,0.0_dp), &
                (6.0_dp,0.0_dp), (7.0_dp,0.0_dp) ], shape(b))

  ! Initialise C (zero – beta is also zero, so the initial value does not matter)
  c = (0.0_dp, 0.0_dp)

  call zsymm(side, uplo, m, n, alpha, a, lda, b, ldb, beta, c, ldc)

  print *, 'Resulting matrix C:'
  call print_matrix(c, m, n)

contains

  subroutine print_matrix(mat, rows, cols)
    complex(dp), intent(in) :: mat(:,:)
    integer, intent(in)    :: rows, cols
    integer :: i, j
    do i = 1, rows
      write(*,'(100(1x,ES12.5,1x,ES12.5))') (real(mat(i,j)), aimag(mat(i,j)), j=1,cols)
    end do
  end subroutine print_matrix

  subroutine xerbla(rout, info)
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: rout
    integer,          intent(in) :: info
    print *, '*** XERBLA called from ', trim(rout), ': INFO =', info
  end subroutine xerbla

  subroutine zsymm(side, uplo, m, n, alpha, a, lda, b, ldb, beta, c, ldc)
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: side, uplo
    integer, intent(in)          :: m, n, lda, ldb, ldc
    complex(dp), intent(in)      :: alpha, beta
    complex(dp), intent(in)      :: a(lda,*), b(ldb,*)
    complex(dp), intent(inout)   :: c(ldc,*)

    side = 'R'
    complex(dp), parameter :: one  = (1.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
    complex(dp), parameter :: zero = (0.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
    complex(dp) :: temp1, temp2
    integer :: i, j, k, nrowa, info
    logical :: left, is_upper

    ! -----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Determine the orientation of A and whether the stored triangle is
    ! the upper one.  The original LSAME routine is replaced by simple
    ! case‑insensitive tests.
    left     = (side == 'L' .or. side == 'l')
    is_upper = (uplo == 'U' .or. uplo == 'u')

    if (left) then
      nrowa = m
    else
      nrowa = n
    end if

    ! -----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Very small argument‑checking block – enough for this demo.
    info = 0
    if (.not. (left .or. side == 'R' .or. side == 'r')) then
      info = 1
    else if (.not. (is_upper .or. uplo == 'L' .or. uplo == 'l')) then
      info = 2
    else if (m < 0) then
      info = 3
    else if (n < 0) then
      info = 4
    else if (lda < max(1, nrowa)) then
      info = 7
    else if (ldb < max(1, m)) then
      info = 9
    else if (ldc < max(1, m)) then
      info = 12
    end if
    if (info /= 0) then
      call xerbla('ZSYMM', info)
      return
    end if

    ! Quick return
    if (m == 0 .or. n == 0 .or. (alpha == zero .and. beta == one)) return

    ! If alpha == 0, scale C by beta (or zero it)
    if (alpha == zero) then
      if (beta == zero) then
        do j = 1, n
          do i = 1, m
            c(i,j) = zero
          end do
        end do
      else
        do j = 1, n
          do i = 1, m
            c(i,j) = beta * c(i,j)
          end do
        end do
      end if
      return
    end if

    if (left) then
      ! C := alpha*A*B + beta*C
      if (is_upper) then
        do j = 1, n
          do i = 1, m
            temp1 = alpha * b(i,j)
            temp2 = zero
            do k = 1, i-1
              c(k,j) = c(k,j) + temp1 * a(k,i)
              temp2 = temp2 + b(k,j) * a(k,i)
            end do
            if (beta == zero) then
              c(i,j) = temp1 * a(i,i) + alpha * temp2
            else
              c(i,j) = beta * c(i,j) + temp1 * a(i,i) + alpha * temp2
            end if
          end do
        end do
      else
        do j = 1, n
          do i = m, 1, -1
            temp1 = alpha * b(i,j)

    end do
  end subroutine print_matrix

  subroutine xerbla(rout, info)
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: rout
    integer,          intent(in) :: info

  end subroutine xerbla

          end if

          end do
        end do

          CRDIO(2) = PROJ(2)

          if (IPEMSG == 0) write(IPELUN,2060)
2060      format(/' ERROR PJ20SP' /' POINT PROJECTS INTO INFINITY')
          IERR = 205
          return
       end if
    end if

    ! Inverse (INDIC = 1) ------------------------------------------------
    if (INDIC == 1) then
       PROJ(1) = COORD(1)
       PROJ(2) = COORD(2)
       IERR = 0
       X = PROJ(1) - X0
       Y = PROJ(2) - Y0
       VS = X * COSALF - Y * SINALF
       US = Y * COSALF + X * SINALF

  !===================================================================
  ! Function: ADJLSP – adjust longitude to the range [-PI, PI]
  !===================================================================
  real(dp) function adjlsp(lon)
    implicit none
    real(dp), intent(in) :: lon
    real(dp) :: tmp
    tmp = lon
    do while (tmp > PI)
       tmp = tmp - 2.0_dp * PI
    end do
    do while (tmp < -PI)
       tmp = tmp + 2.0_dp * PI
    end do
    adjlsp = tmp
  end function adjlsp

  !===================================================================
  ! Function: TSFNSP – compute the t‑parameter for the ellipsoid
  !===================================================================
  real(dp) function tsfnsP(e, phi, sinphi)
    implicit none
    real(dp), intent(in) :: e, phi, sinphi
    real(dp) :: e_sin, part
    if (e == 0.0_dp) then
       tsfnsP = tan(PI/4.0_dp - phi/2.0_dp)
    else
       e_sin = e * sinphi
       part = ((1.0_dp - e_sin) / (1.0_dp + e_sin))**(e/2.0_dp)
       tsfnsP = tan(PI/4.0_dp - phi/2.0_dp) / part
    end if
  end function tsfnsP

  !===================================================================
  ! Function: PHI2SP – iterative solution for latitude from t‑parameter
  !===================================================================
  real(dp) function phi2sp(e, ts)
    implicit none
    real(dp), intent(in) :: e, ts
    integer :: i
    real(dp) :: phi, phi_old, esinphi, term
    ! Initial approximation (sphere)
    phi = PI/2.0_dp - 2.0_dp * atan(ts)
    do i = 1, 5
       esinphi = e * sin(phi)
       term    = ((1.0_dp - esinphi) / (1.0_dp + esinphi))**(e/2.0_dp)
       phi_old = phi
       phi = PI/2.0_dp - 2.0_dp * atan(ts * term)
       if (abs(phi - phi_old) < 1.0e-12_dp) exit
    end do
    phi2sp = phi
  end function phi2sp

! Fortran 90 free‑form program that reproduces the SH_COMM subroutine
! Original subroutine removes text between matching ':' characters and
! preserves line‑feed characters (ASCII < 32). This program hard‑codes an
! example SHEF bulletin, calls the routine, and prints the cleaned text.

program sh_comm_demo
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)
   integer, parameter :: maxlen = 200
   character(len=maxlen) :: report
   integer :: lenr, iret

   ! -------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Example input containing two comment fields delimited by ':' and a
   ! line‑feed character (ASCII 10). The line‑feed is treated as a record
   ! separator and is always kept.
   ! -------------------------------------------------------------------
   report = 'ABCD:THIS IS A COMMENT:EFG H I' // char(10) // &
            & 'JKL:ANOTHER COMMENT:MNOP QRST' // repeat(' ', maxlen- &
            & len('ABCD:THIS IS A COMMENT:EFG H I'//char(10)//'JKL:ANOTHER COMMENT:MNOP QRST'))
   lenr = len_trim(report)               ! actual length without trailing blanks

   call sh_comm(report, lenr, iret)

   print *, 'iret =', iret
   print *, 'Processed report (length =', lenr, '):'
   print '(A)', report(1:lenr)

contains

   subroutine sh_comm(report, lenr, iret)
      implicit none
      character(len=*), intent(inout) :: report
      integer, intent(inout) :: lenr
      integer, intent(out) :: iret
      logical :: off
      integer :: i, j

      iret = 0
      off  = .false.
      j    = 0

      do i = 1, lenr
         if ( report(i:i) == ':' .and. off ) then
            off = .false.
         else if ( report(i:i) == ':' .and. .not. off ) then
            off = .true.
         else if ( report(i:i) < ' ' ) then   ! line‑feed or other control char
            j = j + 1
            report(j:j) = report(i:i)
            off = .false.
         else
            if ( .not. off ) then
               j = j + 1
               report(j:j) = report(i:i)
            end if
         end if
      end do

      lenr == j
      if ( lenr == 0 ) iret = 1

  INTEGER :: N, i

  REAL(dp), ALLOCATABLE :: B(:), C(:), D(:)

  SUBROUTINE SPLEEN(N, X, Y, B, C, D)
    IMPLICIT NONE
    INTEGER, INTENT(IN) :: N
    REAL(dp), INTENT(IN) :: X(N), Y(N)
    REAL(dp), INTENT(OUT) :: B(N), C(N), D(N)

    INTEGER :: NM1, IB, I
    REAL(dp) :: T

    NM1 = N - 1
    IF (N .LT. 2) RETURN
    IF (N .LT. 3) THEN
       CALL SMALL_N(N, X, Y, B, C, D)
       RETURN
    END IF

    !--- Set up tridiagonal system ------------------------------------
    ! B = diagonal, D = off‑diagonal, C = right‑hand side

    D(1) = X(2) - X(1)
    C(2) = (Y(2) - Y(1)) / D(1)
    DO I = 2, NM1
       D(I) = X(I+1) - X(I)
       B(I) = 2.0_dp * (D(I-1) + D(I))
       C(I+1) = (Y(I+1) - Y(I)) / D(I)
       C(I)   = C(I+1) - C(I)
    END DO

    !--- End conditions (third derivatives at X(1) and X(N)) -----------
    B(1) = -D(1)
    B(N) = 2.0_dp * D(N-1)
    C(1) = 0.0_dp
    C(N) = 0.0_dp

    IF (N == 3) THEN
       ! For N = 3 the extra calculations are omitted (original GO TO 15)
    ELSE
       C(1) = C(3) / (X(4) - X(2)) - C(2) / (X(3) - X(1))
       C(1) = C(1) * D(1)**2 / (X(4) - X(1))
       C(N) = -(Y(N) - Y(N-1)) / D(N-1)
    END IF

    !--- Forward elimination ------------------------------------------
    DO I = 2, N
       T = D(I-1) / B(I-1)
       B(I) = B(I) - T * D(I-1)
       C(I) = C(I) - T * C(I-1)
    END DO

    !--- Back substitution --------------------------------------------
    C(N) = C(N) / B(N)
    DO IB = 1, NM1
       I = N - IB
       C(I) = (C(I) - D(I) * C(I+1)) / B(I)
    END DO

    B(N) = (Y(N) - Y(NM1)) / D(NM1) + D(NM1) * (C(NM1) + 2.0_dp * C(N))
    DO I = 1, NM1

       D(I) = (C(I+1) - C(I)) / D(I)
       C(I) = 3.0_dp * C(I)
    END DO
    C(N) = 3.0_dp * C(N)
    D(N) = D(N-1)

  END SUBROUTINE SPLEEN

    IMPLICIT NONE
    INTEGER, INTENT(IN) :: N
    REAL(dp), INTENT(IN) :: X(N), Y(N)
    REAL(dp), INTENT(OUT) :: B(N), C(N), D(N)
    REAL(dp) :: denom

    B(1) = (Y(2) - Y(1)) / denom
    C(1) = 0.0_dp
    D(1) = 0.0_dp
    B(2) = B(1)
    C(2) = 0.0_dp
    D(2) = 0.0_dp
  END SUBROUTINE SMALL_N

       CALL SMALL_N(N, X, Y, B, C, D)
       RETURN
    END IF

    !--- Set up tridiagonal system ------------------------------------
    ! B = diagonal, D = off‑diagonal, C = right‑hand side

    D(1) = X(2) - X(1)
    C(2) = (Y(2) - Y(1)) / D(1)
    DO I = 2, NM1
       D(I) = X(I+1) - X(I)
       B(I) = 2.0_dp * (D(I-1) + D(I))
       C(I+1) = (Y(I+1) - Y(I)) / D(I)
       C(I)   = C(I+1) - C(I)
    END DO

    !--- End conditions (third derivatives at X(1) and X(N)) -----------
    B(1) = -D(1)
    B(N) = 2.0_dp * D(N-1)
    C(1) = 0.0_dp
    C(N) = 0.0_dp

    IF (N == 3) THEN
       ! For N = 3 the extra calculations are omitted (original GO TO 15)
    ELSE
       C(1) = C(3) / (X(4) - X(2)) - C(2) / (X(3) - X(1))
       C(1) = C(1) * D(1)**2 / (X(4) - X(1))
       C(N) = -(Y(N) - Y(N-1)) / D(N-1)
    END IF

    !--- Forward elimination ------------------------------------------
    DO I = 2, N
       T = D(I-1) / B(I-1)
       B(I) = B(I) - T * D(I-1)
       C(I) = C(I) - T * C(I-1)
    END DO

    !--- Back substitution --------------------------------------------
    C(N) = C(N) / B(N)
    DO IB = 1, NM1
       I = N - IB
       C(I) = (C(I) - D(I) * C(I+1)) / B(I)
    END DO

    !--- Compute polynomial coefficients -------------------------------
    B(N) = (Y(N) - Y(NM1)) / D(NM1) + D(NM1) * (C(NM1) + 2.0_dp * C(N))
    DO I = 1, NM1
       B(I) = (Y(I+1) - Y(I)) / D(I) - D(I) * (C(I+1) + 2.0_dp * C(I))
       D(I) = (C(I+1) - C(I)) / D(I)
       C(I) = 3.0_dp * C(I)
    END DO
    C(N) = 3.0_dp * C(N)
    D(N) = D(N-1)

  END SUBROUTINE SPLEEN

  ! Helper for the N < 3 case (mirrors the original label 50 block)
  SUBROUTINE SMALL_N(N, X, Y, B, C, D)
    IMPLICIT NONE
    INTEGER, INTENT(IN) :: N
    REAL(dp), INTENT(IN) :: X(N), Y(N)
    REAL(dp), INTENT(OUT) :: B(N), C(N), D(N)
    REAL(dp) :: denom

    denom = X(2) - X(1)
    B(1) = (Y(2) - Y(1)) / denom
    C(1) = 0.0_dp
    D(1) = 0.0_dp
    B(2) = B(1)
    C(2) = 0.0_dp
    D(2) = 0.0_dp
  END SUBROUTINE SMALL_N

END PROGRAM spline_demo

program wrlist_demo
  implicit none

  ! Sample data: a list of integers that will be expressed as ranges
  integer, dimension(10) :: listz = [1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 10, 11, 12, 13, 20]
  integer :: nlistz
