   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   implicit none

   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Parameters (representative small test case)
   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   integer, parameter :: ijm = 3   ! horizontal points
   integer, parameter :: lm  = 4   ! vertical levels
   real(dp), parameter :: undef = -1.0e30_dp   ! undefined sentinel

   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Test data
   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   real(dp) :: qinp(ijm,lm)
   real(dp) :: pkz (ijm,lm)
   real(dp) :: pksrf(ijm)
   real(dp) :: pktop, pk
   logical  :: pInc
   real(dp) :: qprs(ijm)

   integer :: i, k

   ! Initialize test quantities (arbitrary but consistent values)
   do i = 1, ijm
      do k = 1, lm
         qinp(i,k) = 10.0_dp * i + real(k,dp)               ! e.g. 11,12,13,...
         pkz(i,k)  = 1000.0_dp - 100.0_dp * (k-1) - 10.0_dp * i   ! decreasing pressure
      end do
      pksrf(i) = 1010.0_dp                     ! surface pressure (higher than all pkz)
   end do

   pktop = 500.0_dp      ! pressure above the topmost level
   pk    = 750.0_dp      ! target pressure at which we want the interpolated quantity
   pInc  = .false.       ! In this test the pressure decreases with level index

   ! Call the routine
   call diagnostics_interp_p2p( qprs, qinp, pkz, pksrf, pktop, pk, undef, pInc, ijm, lm )

   ! Print results
   print *, 'Interpolated quantity qprs at pressure =', pk
   do i = 1, ijm
      print *, ' point', i, ':', qprs(i)
   end do

contains

   subroutine diagnostics_interp_p2p( qprs, qinp, pkz, pksrf, pktop, pk, undef, pInc, ijm, lm )
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in) :: ijm, lm
      real(dp), intent(out) :: qprs(ijm)
      real(dp), intent(in)  :: qinp(ijm,lm)
      real(dp), intent(in)  :: pkz(ijm,lm)
      real(dp), intent(in)  :: pksrf(ijm)
      real(dp), intent(in)  :: pktop, pk, undef
      logical,  intent(in)  :: pInc

      integer :: i, L
      real(dp) :: pkmin, pkmax, temp

      ! Initialize output to UNDEFINED
      do i = 1, ijm
         qprs(i) = undef
      end do

      if ( pInc ) then
         !-----------------------------------------------------------
         ! Case where pressure increases with level index
         !-----------------------------------------------------------
         do L = 1, lm-1
            pkmin = pkz(1,L)
            pkmax = pkz(1,L+1)
            do i = 2, ijm
               if ( pkz(i,L)   < pkmin ) pkmin = pkz(i,L)
               if ( pkz(i,L+1) > pkmax ) pkmax = pkz(i,L+1)
            end do

            if ( pk <= pkmax .and. pk >= pkmin ) then
               do i = 1, ijm
                  if ( pk >= pkz(i,L) .and. pk <= pkz(i,L+1) ) then
                     temp = ( pk - pkz(i,L) ) / ( pkz(i,L+1) - pkz(i,L) )

                     if ( qinp(i,L)   /= undef .and. qinp(i,L+1) /= undef ) then
                        qprs(i) = qinp(i,L+1)*temp + qinp(i,L)*(1.0_dp - temp)
                     else if ( qinp(i,L+1) /= undef .and. temp >= 0.5_dp ) then
                        qprs(i) = qinp(i,L+1)
                     else if ( qinp(i,L)   /= undef .and. temp <= 0.5_dp ) then
                        qprs(i) = qinp(i,L)
                     end if
                  end if
               end do
            end if
         end do

         ! Extrapolation above the highest input level
         do i = 1, ijm
            if ( pk <= pkz(i,1) .and. pk >= pktop ) then
               temp = ( pk - pkz(i,1) ) / ( pkz(i,2) - pkz(i,1) )
               if ( qinp(i,1) /= undef .and. qinp(i,2) /= undef ) then
                  qprs(i) = qinp(i,2)*temp + qinp(i,1)*(1.0_dp - temp)
               else if ( qinp(i,1) /= undef ) then
                  qprs(i) = qinp(i,1)
               end if
            end if

            ! Extrapolation below the lowest input level
            if ( pk >= pkz(i,lm) .and. pk <= pksrf(i) ) then
               temp = ( pk - pkz(i,lm) ) / ( pkz(i,lm-1) - pkz(i,lm) )
               if ( qinp(i,lm)   /= undef .and. qinp(i,lm-1) /= undef ) then
                  qprs(i) = qinp(i,lm-1)*temp + qinp(i,lm)*(1.0_dp - temp)
               else if ( qinp(i,lm) /= undef ) then
                  qprs(i) = qinp(i,lm)
               end if
            end if
         end do

      else
         !-----------------------------------------------------------
         ! Case where pressure decreases with level index (default)
         !-----------------------------------------------------------
         do L = 1, lm-1
            pkmin = pkz(1,L+1)
            pkmax = pkz(1,L)
            do i = 2, ijm
               if ( pkz(i,L+1) < pkmin ) pkmin = pkz(i,L+1)
               if ( pkz(i,L)   > pkmax ) pkmax = pkz(i,L)
            end do

            if ( pk <= pkmax .and. pk >= pkmin ) then
               do i = 1, ijm
                  if ( pk <= pkz(i,L) .and. pk >= pkz(i,L+1) ) then
                     temp = ( pk - pkz(i,L) ) / ( pkz(i,L+1) - pkz(i,L) )

                     if ( qinp(i,L)   /= undef .and. qinp(i,L+1) /= undef ) then
                        qprs(i) = qinp(i,L+1)*temp + qinp(i,L)*(1.0_dp - temp)
                     else if ( qinp(i,L+1) /= undef .and. temp >= 0.5_dp ) then
                        qprs(i) = qinp(i,L+1)
                     else if ( qinp(i,L)   /= undef .and. temp <= 0.5_dp ) then
                        qprs(i) = qinp(i,L)
                     end if
                  end if
               end do
            end if
         end do

         ! Extrapolation above the highest input level (now at the bottom because pressure decreases)
         do i = 1, ijm
            if ( pk <= pkz(i,lm) .and. pk >= pktop ) then
               temp = ( pk - pkz(i,lm) ) / ( pkz(i,lm-1) - pkz(i,lm) )
               if ( qinp(i,lm)   /= undef .and. qinp(i,lm-1) /= undef ) then
                  qprs(i) = qinp(i,lm-1)*temp + qinp(i,lm)*(1.0_dp - temp)
               else if ( qinp(i,lm) /= undef ) then
                  qprs(i) = qinp(i,lm)
               end if
            end if

            ! Extrapolation below the lowest input level (surface)
            if ( pk >= pkz(i,1) .and. pk <= pksrf(i) ) then
               temp = ( pk - pkz(i,1) ) / ( pkz(i,2) - pkz(i,1) )
               if ( qinp(i,1)   /= undef .and. qinp(i,2) /= undef ) then
                  qprs(i) = qinp(i,2)*temp + qinp(i,1)*(1.0_dp - temp)
               else if ( qinp(i,1) /= undef ) then
                  qprs(i) = qinp(i,1)
               end if
            end if
         end do

      end if

   end subroutine diagnostics_interp_p2p

end program diag_interp_p2p_demo

      out_flow = out_flow + U(imax,j,k) * dy(j) * dz(k)
      in_flow  = in_flow  + U(0,j,k)   * dy(j) * dz(k)
    end do
  end do

  ! Compute correction factor so that total mass inflow‑outflow = 0
  if (sumU /= 0.0_dp) then
    corfac = 1.0_dp - summas / sumU
  else
    corfac = 1.0_dp
  end if

  ! Apply correction to the outflow boundary (i = imax)
  do k = 0, kmax+1
    do j = 0, jmax+1
      if (k <= kmax .and. j <= jmax) then
        U(imax,j,k) = U(imax,j,k) * corfac
      end if
    end do
  end do

  ! ----------------------------------------------------------
  ! Output results for verification
  ! ----------------------------------------------------------
  print *, 'Summas  = ', summas
  print *, 'SumU    = ', sumU
  print *, 'In flow = ', in_flow
  print *, 'Out flow= ', out_flow
  print *, 'Correction factor (corfac) = ', corfac
  print *, 'Corrected U at outlet (first j,k) = ', U(imax,1,1)

end program mascor_demo

  SUBROUTINE slPVEL(PV, DATE, PMASS, JFORMR, &
                    JFORM, EPOCH, ORBINC, ANODE, PERIH, &
                    AORQ, E, AORL, DM, JSTAT)
    IMPLICIT NONE
    REAL(real64), INTENT(IN)  :: PV(6), DATE, PMASS
    INTEGER,      INTENT(IN)  :: JFORMR
    INTEGER,      INTENT(OUT) :: JFORM, JSTAT
    REAL(real64), INTENT(OUT) :: EPOCH, ORBINC, ANODE, PERIH, AORQ, E, AORL, DM

    ! Local variables
    REAL(real64) :: X, Y, Z, XD, YD, ZD, R, V2, V, RDV, GMU
    REAL(real64) :: HX, HY, HZ, HX2PY2, H2, H, OI, BIGOM
    REAL(real64) :: AR, ECC, S, C, AT, U, OM, PL, EL
    REAL(real64) :: GAR3, EM1, EP1, HAT, SHAT, CHAT
    REAL(real64) :: AE, AM, DN, Q, TP, THAT, THHF, F
    INTEGER      :: JF

    ! Validate arguments PMASS and JFORMR.
    IF (PMASS < 0.0_real64) THEN
       JSTAT = -1
       RETURN
    END IF
    IF (JFORMR < 1 .OR. JFORMR > 3) THEN
       JSTAT = -2
       RETURN
    END IF

    JF = JFORMR

    ! Rotate position from equatorial to ecliptic coordinates.
    X = PV(1)
    Y = PV(2)*CE + PV(3)*SE
    Z = -PV(2)*SE + PV(3)*CE

    ! Rotate velocity similarly, scaling to AU/day.
    XD = DAY * PV(4)
    YD = DAY * (PV(5)*CE + PV(6)*SE)
    ZD = DAY * (-PV(5)*SE + PV(6)*CE)

    ! Distance and speed.
    R  = SQRT(X*X + Y*Y + Z*Z)
    V2 = XD*XD + YD*YD + ZD*ZD
    V  = SQRT(V2)

    ! Reject unreasonably small values.
    IF (R < RMIN .OR. V < VMIN) THEN
       JSTAT = -3
       RETURN
    END IF

    ! R dot V.
    RDV = X*XD + Y*YD + Z*ZD

    ! Gravitational parameter.
    GMU = (1.0_real64 + PMASS) * GCON * GCON

    ! Vector angular momentum per unit reduced mass.
    HX = Y*ZD - Z*YD
    HY = Z*XD - X*ZD
    HZ = X*YD - Y*XD

    ! Areal constant.
    HX2PY2 = HX*HX + HY*HY
    H2 = HX2PY2 + HZ*HZ
    H  = SQRT(H2)

    ! Inclination.
    OI = ATAN2(SQRT(HX2PY2), HZ)

    ! Longitude of ascending node.
    IF (HX /= 0.0_real64 .OR. HY /= 0.0_real64) THEN
       BIGOM = ATAN2(HX, -HY)
    ELSE
       BIGOM = 0.0_real64
    END IF

    ! Reciprocal of mean distance etc.
    AR = 2.0_real64 / R - V2 / GMU

    ! Eccentricity.
    ECC = SQRT(MAX(1.0_real64 - AR*H2/GMU, 0.0_real64))

    ! True anomaly.
    S = H * RDV
    C = H2 - R*GMU
    IF (S /= 0.0_real64 .AND. C /= 0.0_real64) THEN
       AT = ATAN2(S, C)
    ELSE
       AT = 0.0_real64
    END IF

    ! Argument of latitude.
    S = SIN(BIGOM)
    C = COS(BIGOM)
    U = ATAN2((-X*S + Y*C)*COS(OI) + Z*SIN(OI), X*C + Y*S)

    ! Argument of perihelion.
    OM = U - AT

    ! Capture near‑parabolic cases.
    IF (ABS(ECC - 1.0_real64) < PARAB) ECC = 1.0_real64

    ! If orbit not elliptical, force element set 3.
    IF (ECC >= 1.0_real64) JF = 3

    ! Auxiliary quantities.
    GAR3 = GMU * AR * AR * AR
    EM1 = ECC - 1.0_real64
    EP1 = ECC + 1.0_real64
    HAT = AT / 2.0_real64
    SHAT = SIN(HAT)
    CHAT = COS(HAT)

    IF (ECC < 1.0_real64) THEN
       ! Elliptic case: eccentric anomaly, mean anomaly, daily motion.
       AE = 2.0_real64 * ATAN2(SQRT(-EM1)*SHAT, SQRT(EP1)*CHAT)
       AM = AE - ECC * SIN(AE)
       DN = SQRT(GAR3)
    END IF

    IF (JF == 1) THEN
       PL = BIGOM + OM
       EL = PL + AM
    END IF

    IF (JF == 3) THEN
       Q = H2 / (GMU * EP1)
       IF (ECC < 1.0_real64) THEN
          TP = DATE - AM / DN
       ELSE
          THAT = SHAT / CHAT
          IF (ECC == 1.0_real64) THEN
             TP = DATE - THAT * (1.0_real64 + THAT*THAT/3.0_real64) * H * H2 / (2.0_real64 * GMU * GMU)
          ELSE
             THHF = SQRT(EM1/EP1) * THAT
             F = LOG(1.0_real64 + THHF) - LOG(1.0_real64 - THHF)
             TP = DATE - (ECC * SINH(F) - F) / SQRT(-GAR3)
          END IF
       END IF
    END IF

    ! Return results.
    JFORM = JF
    ORBINC = OI
    ANODE = slDA2P(BIGOM)
    E = ECC
    IF (JF == 1) THEN
       PERIH = slDA2P(PL)
       AORL = slDA2P(EL)
       DM   = DN
    ELSE
       PERIH = slDA2P(OM)
       IF (JF == 2) AORL = slDA2P(AM)
    END IF
    IF (JF /= 3) THEN
       EPOCH = DATE
       AORQ = 1.0_real64 / AR
    ELSE
       EPOCH = TP
       AORQ = Q
    END IF
    JSTAT = 0

  END SUBROUTINE slPVEL

  !------------------------------------------------------------
  ! slDA2P – normalise angle into the range [0, 2π)
  !------------------------------------------------------------
  FUNCTION slDA2P(ANGLE) RESULT(RES)
    IMPLICIT NONE
    REAL(real64), INTENT(IN) :: ANGLE
    REAL(real64) :: RES
    REAL(real64) :: A
    A = ANGLE - TWOPI * FLOOR(ANGLE / TWOPI)
    IF (A < 0.0_real64) A = A + TWOPI
    RES = A
  END FUNCTION slDA2P

END PROGRAM slPVEL_demo

program dposv_demo

  end if

    real(dp), intent(in) :: mat(rows, cols)
    integer, intent(in) :: rows, cols

    character(len=*), intent(in) :: uplo

    real(dp), intent(inout) :: a(lda,*), b(ldb,*)
    integer, intent(out) :: info
    ! Test the input parameters.
    info = 0
    if (.not. lsame(uplo,'U') .and. .not. lsame(uplo,'L')) then
       info = -1
    else if (n < 0) then
       info = -2
    else if (nrhs < 0) then
       info = -3
    else if (lda < max(1,n)) then
       info = -5
    else if (ldb < max(1,n)) then
       info = -7
    end if
    if (info /= 0) then

    real(dp), intent(inout) :: a(lda,*)
    integer, intent(out) :: info
    integer :: i, j, k
    real(dp) :: sum
    info = 0
    if (n == 0) return
    if (lsame(uplo,'U')) then
       ! Upper‑triangular storage
       do i = 1, n
          do j = 1, i-1
             sum = a(j,i)
             do k = 1, j-1
                sum = sum - a(k,j)*a(k,i)

          sum = a(i,i)
          do k = 1, i-1
             sum = sum - a(k,i)*a(k,i)

      end do

         d(ip) = b(ip)

program bulak_driver
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
  implicit none

  ! Sample problem dimensions (small test case)
  integer, parameter :: N    = 5   ! number of particles
  integer, parameter :: NL   = 3   ! number of charge‑exchange levels
  integer, parameter :: LIMP = 5   ! upper index for POPN (must be >= max(NPQ))
  integer, parameter :: LUP  = 0   ! dummy (not used in this demo)

  integer :: i, j, PQN
  integer :: IQRK(NL), IQRL(NL), LCX(NL), NPQ(NL)
  real(dp) :: CXX(N,NL), CXXP(N,NL), ESG(N,NL)
  real(dp) :: POPK(N)
  real(dp) :: POPN(N,LIMP)
  real(dp) :: RKI(N,NL), RLI(N,NL)

  ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Initialise data with representative (non‑zero) values
  ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  call init_data()

  ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Call the original routine – argument order matches the historic code
  ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  call bulak(N, NL, RKI, IQRK, RLI, IQRL, LUP, CXX, CXXP, NPQ, LCX, ESG, &
              POPK, POPN, LIMP)

  subroutine init_data()
    integer :: i, j
    do j = 1, NL
      IQRK(j) = 1
      IQRL(j) = 1
      LCX(j)  = 1
      NPQ(j)  = j               ! simple mapping – ensures 1 ≤ NPQ ≤ LIMP
    end do
    do i = 1, N
      POPK(i) = 1.0_dp
      do j = 1, NL
        CXX(i,j)  = 1.0_dp * i * j
        CXXP(i,j) = 2.0_dp * i * j
        ESG(i,j)  = 0.5_dp * i + real(j, dp)
        RKI(i,j)  = 0.0_dp
        RLI(i,j)  = 0.0_dp
      end do
      do j = 1, LIMP
        POPN(i,j) = 0.1_dp * i * j
      end do
    end do
  end subroutine init_data

! Fortran 90 free‑form.  The program builds a small test case, calls
! the translated routine and prints the solution.

program bspdb_demo
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)
   integer :: N, M, i, j, col
   real(dp), allocatable :: G(:,:)
   real(dp), allocatable :: B(:)

   !----------------------------------------------------------
   ! Define a tiny positive‑definite matrix L (lower‑triangular)
   ! and store it in the banded format used by the original code.
   ! For this demo we take N = 3, M = 3 (full lower triangle).
   ! L = [ 2 0 0 ;
   !       1 3 0 ;
   !       0 2 1 ]
   !----------------------------------------------------------
   N = 3
   M = 3
   allocate(G(N,M))
   allocate(B(N))

   ! Initialise G with zeros (entries outside the band are zero)
   G = 0.0_dp

   ! Fill the banded storage G(i,j) = L(i, i + j - M)
   ! Diagonal (j = M) stores L(i,i)
   G(1,3) = 2.0_dp               ! L(1,1)
   G(2,2) = 1.0_dp               ! L(2,1)
   G(2,3) = 3.0_dp               ! L(2,2)
   G(3,2) = 2.0_dp               ! L(3,2)
   G(3,3) = 1.0_dp               ! L(3,3)

   ! Right‑hand side vector B (any values are fine for the demo)
   B = (/ 4.0_dp, 5.0_dp, 6.0_dp /)

   print *, "--- Input data ---"
   print *, "N =", N, "  M =", M
   print *, "G (banded storage):"
   do i = 1, N
      write(*,'(3F12.6)') G(i,:)
   end do
   print *, "B (right‑hand side):", B

   call bspdb(G, N, M, B)

   print *, "\n--- Solution X (stored back in B) ---"
   print *, B

contains

   subroutine bspdb(G, N, M, B)
      !------------------------------------------------------
      ! Solve (L*L**T) * X = B where L is supplied in the
      ! banded format G(i,j) = L(i, i+j-M).
      !------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in) :: N, M
      real(dp), intent(in) :: G(:, :)
      real(dp), intent(inout) :: B(:)
      integer :: i, j, col
      real(dp) :: sum
      N = N + 1

      !--- Input checks -------------------------------------------------
      if (N < 1) then
         print *, "ERROR: N < 1 in BSPDB"
         stop 1
      end if
      if (M < 1) then
         print *, "ERROR: M < 1 in BSPDB"
         stop 2
      end if
      do i = 1, N
         if (G(i, M) <= 0.0_dp) then
            print *, "ERROR: singular Cholesky decomposition at row", i
            stop 3
         end if
      end do

      !--- Forward elimination (solve L * y = B) -----------------------
      do i = 1, N
         sum = B(i)
         do col = 1, M-1               ! columns that lie left of the diagonal
            j = i + (col - M)          ! column index in the original matrix
            if (j >= 1 .and. j < i) then
               sum = sum - G(i, col) * B(j)
            end if
         end do
         B(i) = sum / G(i, M)          ! divide by diagonal element L(i,i)
      end do

      !--- Back substitution (solve L**T * x = y) -----------------------
      do i = N, 1, -1
         sum = B(i)
         do j = i+1, min(N, i+M-1)    ! only entries within the band
            col = M + (i - j)         ! column in G that stores L(j,i)
            if (col >= 1 .and. col <= M) then
               sum = sum - G(j, col) * B(j)
            end if
         end do
         B(i) = sum / G(i, M)
      end do

   end subroutine bspdb

end program bspdb_demo

  subroutine checkInput()
    implicit none
    integer :: i, j, k, ij, ji, iThis, iw, mxsds, nsds, ifail
    real(dp) :: oksum, sumang, anglDiff, diffl, tiny_local

    tiny_local = 1.0e-2_dp

    !----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Bounds checking (using the small test values defined above)
    if (nCells > maxCell) then
       write(6, '(1x, A30)') 'nCells > maxCell, Stopped!'
       call zstop(6, nout, 2)
    end if
    if (nWallSegm > maxWall) then
       write(6, '(1x, A30)') 'nWallSegm > maxWall, Stopped!'
       call zstop(6, nout, 2)
    end if
    if (nPlasmReg > maxPlas) then
       write(6, '(1x, A30)') 'nPlasmReg > maxPlas, Stopped!'
       call zstop(6, nout, 2)
    end if

    mxsds = -1
    do i = 1, nCells
       mxsds = max(mxsds, nSides(i))
    end do
    if (mxsds > maxSides) then
       write(6, '(1x, A30)') 'nSides > maxSides, Stopped!'
       call zstop(6, nout, 3)
    end if

    !----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Compatibility with older input files
    if (i_e0 == 0) i_e0 = 2
    if (v0fact == 0.0_dp) v0fact = 2.0_dp
    if (iquad == 0) iquad = 2
    if (nph == 0) nph = 21

    !----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Cannot have constant energy option if reflection model is on
    if ((irefl == 1) .and. (i_e0 == 1)) then
       write(6, '(1x, A30)') 'Cannot have i_e0 = 1 & irefl = 1'
       call zstop(6, nout, 4)
    end if

    !----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Check that the angles of each polygon sum up to (n-2)*pi (degrees)
    ifail = 0
    do i = 1, nCells
       nsds = nSides(i)
       oksum = real(nsds - 2, dp) * 180.0_dp
       sumang = 0.0_dp
       do k = 1, nsds
          sumang = sumang + angle(k,i)
       end do
       anglDiff = abs(sumang - oksum)
       if (anglDiff > tiny_local) then
          ifail = ifail + 1
          write(6,1000) i
       end if
    end do
    if (ifail /= 0) call zstop(6, nout, 1)

    !----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Check for consistency of adjacent sides
    do i = 1, nCells
       do j = 1, nSides(i)
          ij = adjCell(j,i)
          if (iType(ij) > 1) then
             ji = adjCell(1,ij)
             if (ji /= i) then
                write(6,1100) i, j
                ifail = ifail + 1
             end if
          else if (iType(ij) <= 1) then
             iThis = 0
             do k = 1, nSides(ij)
                if (adjCell(k,ij) == i) iThis = k
             end do
             if (iThis == 0) then

       end do
    end do
    if (ifail /= 0) call zstop(6, nout, 1)

    !----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Convert all the angles from degrees to radians
    do i = 1, nCells
       do k = 1, nSides(i)
          angle(k,i) = pi * angle(k,i) / 180.0_dp
       end do
    end do

    !----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Multiply lengths by scale factor (if > 0)
    if (scalFact > 0.0_dp) then
       do i = 1, nCells
          do k = 1, nSides(i)
             lside(k,i) = scalFact * lside(k,i)
          end do
       end do
    end if

    !----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Normalization of external driving forces
    srcNormFact = -1.0e30_dp
    do i = 1, nCells
       srcNormFact = max(srcNormFact, S_ext(i))
    end do
    do iw = 1, nWallSegm
       srcNormFact = max(srcNormFact, max(g_ex(iw), g_ion(iw)))
    end do

    if (srcNormFact > 0.0_dp) then
       do i = 1, nCells
          S_ext(i) = S_ext(i) / srcNormFact
       end do
       do iw = 1, nWallSegm
          g_ex(iw)  = g_ex(iw)  / srcNormFact
          g_ion(iw) = g_ion(iw) / srcNormFact
          if (twall(iw) == 0.0_dp) twall(iw) = 1.0_dp
       end do
    end if

    !----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Set number of the angular flux expansion functions
    if (idp == 0) then
       nExp = 1
    else if (idp == 1) then
       nExp = 3
    end if
    if (inon /= 1) inon = 0
    mExp = nExp + inon
    if (nd0 <= 0) nd0 = 0

    !----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Initialize neutral temperature array
    do i = 1, nCells + nPlasmReg
       do j = 1, nSides(i)
          tneut(i,j) = ionTemp(i)
       end do
    end do

    if (neitr == 0) neitr = 1

    write(6,*) 'CheckInput completed successfully.'
    write(6,*) 'nExp =', nExp, ' mExp =', mExp, ' nd0 =', nd0
    write(6,*) 'Scaled S_ext =', S_ext(1:nCells)
    write(6,*) 'Scaled g_ex =', g_ex(1:nWallSegm)
    write(6,*) 'Scaled g_ion =', g_ion(1:nWallSegm)
    write(6,*) 'twall =', twall(1:nWallSegm)

      case ('Epsilon')
         val = epsilon(1.0_dp)
      case ('Base')

      WRS    = WR
      WIS    = WI

    if (iachar(a) >= iachar('a') .and. iachar(a) <= iachar('z')) a = achar(iachar(a)-32)
    if (iachar(b) >= iachar('a') .and. iachar(b) <= iachar('z')) b = achar(iachar(b)-32)

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------

  end subroutine xerbla

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! SAGEMV – core routine (exact translation of the original code).
  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  subroutine sagemv(trans, m, n, alpha, a, lda, x, incx, beta, y, incy)
    character(len=1), intent(in) :: trans
    integer, intent(in)          :: m, n, lda, incx, incy
    real(kind=sp), intent(in)    :: alpha, beta
    real(kind=sp), intent(in)    :: a(lda, n)
    real(kind=sp), intent(in)    :: x(:)
    real(kind=sp), intent(inout) :: y(:)

    real(kind=sp), parameter :: ONE = 1.0_sp, ZERO = 0.0_sp
    integer :: i, info, ix, iy, j, jx, jy, kx, ky, lenx, leny
    real(kind=sp) :: absx, talpha, temp

    ! Test the input parameters.
    !---------------------------------------------------------------
    info = 0
    if (.not. lsame(trans, 'N') .and. .not. lsame(trans, 'T') .and. .not. lsame(trans, 'C')) then
       info = 1
    else if (m < 0) then
       info = 2
    else if (n < 0) then
       info = 3
    else if (lda < max(1, m)) then
       info = 6
    else if (incx == 0) then
       info = 8
    else if (incy == 0) then
       info = 11
    end if

    if (info /= 0) then
       call xerbla('SAGEMV', info)
       return
    end if

    !---------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Quick return if possible.
    !---------------------------------------------------------------
    if ((m == 0) .or. (n == 0) .or. ((alpha == ZERO) .and. (beta == ONE))) return

    !---------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Set LENX, LENY and the starting points KX, KY.
    !---------------------------------------------------------------
    if (lsame(trans, 'N')) then
       lenx = n
       leny = m
    else
       lenx = m
       leny = n
    end if

    if (incx > 0) then
       kx = 1
    else
       kx = 1 - (lenx - 1) * incx
    end if

    if (incy > 0) then
       ky = 1
    else
       ky = 1 - (leny - 1) * incy
    end if

    !---------------------------------------------------------------
    ! First form y := abs(beta*y).
    !---------------------------------------------------------------
    if (incy == 1) then
       if (beta == ZERO) then
          do i = 1, leny
             y(i) = ZERO
          end do
       else if (beta == ONE) then
          do i = 1, leny
             y(i) = abs(y(i))
          end do
       else
          do i = 1, leny
             y(i) = abs(beta * y(i))
          end do
       end if
    else
       iy = ky
       if (beta == ZERO) then
          do i = 1, leny
             y(iy) = ZERO
             iy = iy + incy
          end do
       else if (beta == ONE) then
          do i = 1, leny
             y(iy) = abs(y(iy))
             iy = iy + incy
          end do
       else
          do i = 1, leny
             y(iy) = abs(beta * y(iy))
             iy = iy + incy
          end do
       end if
    end if

    if (alpha == ZERO) return
    talpha = abs(alpha)

    if (lsame(trans, 'N')) then
       !------------------------------------------------------------
       ! Form y := abs(alpha)*abs(A)*abs(x) + y.
       !------------------------------------------------------------
       jx = kx
       if (incy == 1) then
          do j = 1, n
             absx = abs(x(jx))
             if (absx /= ZERO) then
                temp = talpha * absx
                do i = 1, m
                   y(i) = y(i) + temp * abs(a(i, j))
                end do
             end if
             jx = jx + incx
          end do
       else
          do j = 1, n
             absx = abs(x(jx))
             if (absx /= ZERO) then
                temp = talpha * absx
                iy = ky
                do i = 1, m
                   y(iy) = y(iy) + temp * abs(a(i, j))
                   iy = iy + incy
                end do
             end if
             jx = jx + incx
          end do
       end if
    else
       !------------------------------------------------------------
       ! Form y := abs(alpha)*abs(A')*abs(x) + y.
       !------------------------------------------------------------
       jy = ky
       if (incx == 1) then
          do j = 1, n
             temp = ZERO
             do i = 1, m
                temp = temp + abs(a(i, j) * x(i))
             end do
             y(jy) = y(jy) + talpha * temp
             jy = jy + incy
          end do
       else
          do j = 1, n
             temp = ZERO
             ix = kx
             do i = 1, m
                temp = temp + abs(a(i, j) * x(ix))
                ix = ix + incx
             end do
             y(jy) = y(jy) + talpha * temp
             jy = jy + incy
          end do
       end if
    end if

  end subroutine sagemv

end module sagemv_mod

contains

  subroutine sbllgd(FLON, FLAT, NPAIR, X, Y, ILLGD, ISTAT)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: NPAIR, ILLGD
    integer, intent(out) :: ISTAT
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: FLON(NPAIR), FLAT(NPAIR)
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: X(NPAIR), Y(NPAIR)

    ! Constants (converted from original REAL*8 DATA statements)
    real(dp), parameter :: DEGRAD = 0.01745329_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: EARTHR = 6371.2_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: STLAT   = 60.0_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: STLON   = 105.0_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: RADDEG = 57.2957795_dp

    real(dp) :: XMESH, TLAT, RE, XLAT, WLONG, R
    real(dp) :: GI2, XX, YY, RR, ANG
    integer :: I

    ISTAT = 0
    XMESH = 4.7625_dp
    TLAT  = STLAT * DEGRAD
    RE    = (EARTHR * (1.0_dp + sin(TLAT))) / XMESH

    if (ILLGD == 1) then
       ! -----------------------------------------------------------
       ! Compute grid points from longitude and latitude (forward).
       ! -----------------------------------------------------------
       do I = 1, NPAIR
          X(I) = 0.0_dp
          Y(I) = 0.0_dp
          if (FLAT(I) >= 10.0_dp .and. FLAT(I) <= 80.0_dp .and. &
              FLON(I) >= 40.0_dp .and. FLON(I) <= 180.0_dp) then
             XLAT  = FLAT(I) * DEGRAD
             WLONG = (FLON(I) + 180.0_dp - STLON) * DEGRAD
             R     = (RE * cos(XLAT)) / (1.0_dp + sin(XLAT))
             X(I)  = R * sin(WLONG)
             Y(I)  = R * cos(WLONG)
          else
             ISTAT = -1
          end if
       end do
       do I = 1, NPAIR
          X(I) = X(I) + 401.0_dp
          Y(I) = Y(I) + 1601.0_dp
       end do
    else
       ! -----------------------------------------------------------
       ! Compute longitude and latitude from grid points (inverse).
       ! -----------------------------------------------------------
       GI2 = RE * RE
       do I = 1, NPAIR
          XX = X(I)
          YY = Y(I)
          if (XX >= 1.0_dp .and. XX <= 1161.0_dp .and. &
              YY >= 1.0_dp .and. YY <= 1601.0_dp) then
             XX = XX - 401.0_dp
             YY = YY - 1601.0_dp

                ANG     = atan2(YY, XX) * RADDEG

  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64, sp=>real32
  implicit none
  integer :: npair, illgd, istat, i
  real(dp), allocatable :: flon(:), flat(:), x(:), y(:)

  ! Sample data for forward conversion (longitude/latitude to grid)
  npair = 3
  allocate(flon(npair), flat(npair), x(npair), y(npair))
  flon = [45.0_dp, 100.0_dp, 150.0_dp]
  flat = [30.0_dp, 45.0_dp, 60.0_dp]
  illgd = 1   ! compute grid points from lon/lat
  istat = 0

  call sbllgd(flon, flat, npair, x, y, illgd, istat)

  print *, 'Forward conversion (ILLGD = 1):'
  do i = 1, npair
     print *, '  Point', i, ': X =', x(i), 'Y =', y(i)
  end do
  print *, '  ISTAT =', istat

  ! Reverse conversion test (grid to longitude/latitude)
  illgd = 0   ! compute lon/lat from grid points
  istat = 0
  call sbllgd(flon, flat, npair, x, y, illgd, istat)

  print *, 'Reverse conversion (ILLGD = 0):'
  do i = 1, npair
     print *, '  Point', i, ': FLON =', flon(i), 'FLAT =', flat(i)
  end do
  print *, '  ISTAT =', istat

contains

  subroutine sbllgd(FLON, FLAT, NPAIR, X, Y, ILLGD, ISTAT)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: NPAIR, ILLGD
    integer, intent(out) :: ISTAT
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: FLON(NPAIR), FLAT(NPAIR)
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: X(NPAIR), Y(NPAIR)

    ! Constants (converted from original REAL*8 DATA statements)
    real(dp), parameter :: DEGRAD = 0.01745329_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: EARTHR = 6371.2_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: STLAT   = 60.0_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: STLON   = 105.0_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: RADDEG = 57.2957795_dp

    real(dp) :: XMESH, TLAT, RE, XLAT, WLONG, R
    real(dp) :: GI2, XX, YY, RR, ANG
    integer :: I

    ISTAT = 0
    XMESH = 4.7625_dp
    TLAT  = STLAT * DEGRAD
    RE    = (EARTHR * (1.0_dp + sin(TLAT))) / XMESH

    if (ILLGD == 1) then
       ! -----------------------------------------------------------
       ! Compute grid points from longitude and latitude (forward).
       ! -----------------------------------------------------------
       do I = 1, NPAIR
          X(I) = 0.0_dp
          Y(I) = 0.0_dp
          if (FLAT(I) >= 10.0_dp .and. FLAT(I) <= 80.0_dp .and. &
              FLON(I) >= 40.0_dp .and. FLON(I) <= 180.0_dp) then
             XLAT  = FLAT(I) * DEGRAD
             WLONG = (FLON(I) + 180.0_dp - STLON) * DEGRAD
             R     = (RE * cos(XLAT)) / (1.0_dp + sin(XLAT))
             X(I)  = R * sin(WLONG)
             Y(I)  = R * cos(WLONG)
          else
             ISTAT = -1
          end if
       end do
       do I = 1, NPAIR
          X(I) = X(I) + 401.0_dp
          Y(I) = Y(I) + 1601.0_dp
       end do
    else
       ! -----------------------------------------------------------
       ! Compute longitude and latitude from grid points (inverse).
       ! -----------------------------------------------------------
       GI2 = RE * RE
       do I = 1, NPAIR
          XX = X(I)
          YY = Y(I)
          if (XX >= 1.0_dp .and. XX <= 1161.0_dp .and. &
              YY >= 1.0_dp .and. YY <= 1601.0_dp) then
             XX = XX - 401.0_dp
             YY = YY - 1601.0_dp
             RR = XX*XX + YY*YY
             if (RR /= 0.0_dp) then
                FLAT(I) = asin((GI2 - RR) / (GI2 + RR)) * RADDEG
                ANG     = atan2(YY, XX) * RADDEG
                if (ANG < 0.0_dp) ANG = ANG + 360.0_dp
                FLON(I) = 270.0_dp + STLON - ANG
                if (FLON(I) < 0.0_dp)  FLON(I) = FLON(I) + 360.0_dp
                if (FLON(I) >= 360.0_dp) FLON(I) = FLON(I) - 360.0_dp
             else
                FLON(I) = 0.0_dp
                FLAT(I) = 90.0_dp
             end if
          else
             ISTAT = -1
             FLON(I) = 0.0_dp
             FLAT(I) = 0.0_dp
          end if
       end do
    end if

  end subroutine sbllgd

end program sbllgd_demo

  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)
  integer, parameter :: ix = 10, jy = 5
  real(dp), dimension(ix, jy) :: ap, an, as, ae, aw, su, sp
end module coeff_mod

program test_lisolv
  use coeff_mod
  implicit none
  integer :: is, ie, js, je, it, jt, isn
  real(dp), dimension(:,:), allocatable :: phi

  ! set dimensions from module parameters
  it = ix
  jt = jy

  allocate(phi(it, jt))

  ! Initialize coefficient arrays with simple values
  ap = 4.0_dp
  an = 1.0_dp
  as = 1.0_dp
  ae = 1.0_dp
  aw = 1.0_dp
  su = 0.0_dp
  sp = 0.0_dp

  ! Initialize phi with a simple pattern
  phi = 0.0_dp
  phi(1, :)   = 100.0_dp
  phi(it, :)  = 200.0_dp
  phi(:, 1)   = 150.0_dp
  phi(:, jt)  = 250.0_dp

  ! Set index ranges (avoid boundaries)
  is = 2
  ie = it - 1
  js = 2
  je = jt - 1

  ! First direction: north to south (isn=1)
  isn = 1
  call lisolv(is, ie, js, je, it, jt, phi, isn)

  print *, 'Result after isn=1 (north->south):'
  call print_phi(phi)

  ! Second direction: south to north (isn=2)
  isn = 2
  call lisolv(is, ie, js, je, it, jt, phi, isn)

  print *, 'Result after isn=2 (south->north):'
  call print_phi(phi)

contains

  subroutine lisolv(is, ie, js, je, it, jt, phi, isn)
    use coeff_mod
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: is, ie, js, je, it, jt, isn
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: phi(it, jt)
    integer :: i, j, jsm1, jep1
    real(dp) :: temp
    real(dp), dimension(jy) :: p, q

    if (isn == 1) then
      ! north to south
      jsm1 = js - 1
      do i = is, ie
        p(jsm1) = 0.0_dp
        q(jsm1) = phi(i, jsm1)
        do j = js, je
          temp = ap(i, j) - as(i, j) * p(j - 1) + 1.0e-30_dp
          p(j) = an(i, j) / temp
          q(j) = (aw(i, j) * phi(i - 1, j) + ae(i, j) * phi(i + 1, j) + &
                  as(i, j) * q(j - 1) + su(i, j)) / temp
        end do
        do j = je, js, -1
          phi(i, j) = phi(i, j + 1) * p(j) + q(j)
        end do
      end do

    else if (isn == 2) then
      ! south to north
      jep1 = je + 1
      do i = is, ie
        p(jep1) = 0.0_dp
        q(jep1) = phi(i, jep1)
        do j = je, js, -1
          temp = ap(i, j) - an(i, j) * p(j + 1) + 1.0e-30_dp
          p(j) = as(i, j) / temp
          q(j) = (aw(i, j) * phi(i - 1, j) + ae(i, j) * phi(i + 1, j) + &
                  an(i, j) * q(j + 1) + su(i, j)) / temp
        end do
        do j = js, je
          phi(i, j) = phi(i, j - 1) * p(j) + q(j)
        end do
      end do
    else
      print *, 'WARNING: unknown isn value', isn
    end if

  end subroutine lisolv

  subroutine print_phi(phi)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: phi(:, :)
    integer :: i, j
    do i = 1, size(phi, 1)
      write(*, '(100(f8.2,1x))') (phi(i, j), j = 1, size(phi, 2))
    end do
  end subroutine print_phi

end program test_lisolv

  implicit none

  ! Parameters for a tiny test case
  integer, parameter :: nef = 3
  integer, parameter :: nfacea = 1
  integer, parameter :: nfaceb = 2
  integer, parameter :: nfaces = nfaceb

  ! Local variables
  integer :: i, j
  integer :: ielfa(4, nfaces)
  integer :: ifabou(10)
  integer :: ipnei(nef+1)
  integer :: indexf

  real(dp) :: vfa(0:7, nfaces)
  real(dp) :: vfap(0:7, nfaces)
  real(dp) :: gradvfa(3,3,nfaces)
  real(dp) :: rf(3, nfaces)
  real(dp) :: xxn(3, 10)
  real(dp) :: vel(nef,0:7)
  real(dp) :: xxi(3,10)
  real(dp) :: xle(10)
  real(dp) :: dd

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Initialise test data (simple, deterministic values)
  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! ielfa: (1) left element, (2) right element (negative => boundary),
  !        (3) flag used in the original code, (4) offset for indexing
  ielfa(:,1) = [1, -2, 1, 1]   ! face 1 – boundary (iel2 = -2)
  ielfa(:,2) = [2,  3, 0, 2]   ! face 2 – interior between element 2 and 3

  ! ifabou: boundary condition flags (all zero = no special condition)
  ifabou = 0
  ! For face 1 we set a sliding‑boundary flag (ipointer = -iel2 = 2)
  ifabou(2+5) = -1   ! negative => sliding condition

  ! ipnei: cumulative node numbers per element (simple linear spacing)
  ipnei = [0, 8, 16, 24]

  ! xxn: unit normal vectors (dummy values)
  xxn = 0.0_dp
  xxn(:,1) = [1.0_dp, 0.0_dp, 0.0_dp]
  xxn(:,2) = [0.0_dp, 1.0_dp, 0.0_dp]
  xxn(:,3) = [0.0_dp, 0.0_dp, 1.0_dp]

  ! vel: velocities at element centres (simple linear pattern)
  do i = 1, nef
     do j = 0, 7
        vel(i,j) = 0.1_dp*i + 0.01_dp*j
     end do
  end do

  ! vfap: provisional face velocities (constant for simplicity)
  vfap = 0.5_dp

  ! gradvfa: gradients (constant small values)
  gradvfa = 0.1_dp

  ! rf: distance vectors from element centre to face centre
  rf = 0.2_dp

  ! xxi: auxiliary vectors used for zero‑gradient boundary faces
  xxi = 0.3_dp

  ! xle: characteristic lengths (set to 1.0 for simplicity)
  xle = 1.0_dp

  ! Initialise output array
  vfa = 0.0_dp

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Call the extrapolation routine
  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  call extrapol_vel4(ielfa, vfa, vfap, gradvfa, rf, ifabou, &

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------

  do i = nfacea, nfaceb
     print *, 'Face', i, vfa(:,i)
  end do

  subroutine extrapol_vel4(ielfa, vfa, vfap, gradvfa, rf, ifabou, &
       ipnei, xxn, vel, xxi, xle, nef, nfacea, nfaceb)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: ielfa(4,*), ifabou(*), ipnei(*), nef, nfacea, nfaceb

       iel2 = ielfa(2,i)

                        gradvfa(j,2,i)*rf(2,i) + gradvfa(j,3,i)*rf(3,i)
          end do
       elseif (ielfa(3,i) > 0) then
          ! Boundary face with possible non‑zero gradient
          ipointer = -iel2
          ! --- x direction ---
          if (ifabou(ipointer+1) > 0) then
             vfa(1,i) = vfap(1,i)
          else
             vfa(1,i) = vfap(1,i) + gradvfa(1,1,i)*rf(1,i) + &
                        gradvfa(1,2,i)*rf(2,i) + gradvfa(1,3,i)*rf(3,i)

          if (ifabou(ipointer+2) > 0) then

          end if

          if (ifabou(ipointer+3) > 0) then

          else

                        gradvfa(3,2,i)*rf(2,i) + gradvfa(3,3,i)*rf(3,i)

          ! Sliding‑boundary correction
          if (ifabou(ipointer+5) < 0) then

             end do
          end if

          indexf = ipnei(iel1) + ielfa(4,i)
          do j = 1, 3

                        (gradvfa(j,1,i)*xxi(1,indexf) + &
                         gradvfa(j,2,i)*xxi(2,indexf) + &
                         gradvfa(j,3,i)*xxi(3,indexf)) * xle(indexf)
          end do
       end if
    end do
  end subroutine extrapol_vel4

   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   implicit none
   integer, intent(in)          :: kkoef, nkoef
   complex(dp), intent(in)      :: cal
   complex(dp), intent(in)      :: ca(5)

   real(dp) :: br, bi, cr, ci, dr, di, er, ei, fr, fi, ar
   real(dp) :: r, r1, r2, r3, r4, r0

   br = real(ca(1), dp)
   bi = aimag(ca(1))
   cr = real(ca(2), dp)
   ci = aimag(ca(2))
   dr = real(ca(3), dp)
   di = aimag(ca(3))
   er = real(ca(4), dp)
   ei = aimag(ca(4))
   fr = real(ca(5), dp)
   fi = aimag(ca(5))
   ar = real(cal, dp)

   ! 0) Report the sign of the real part of CAL
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   if (ar > 0.0_dp) then
      write(6,'(3x,"Оcновной режим теряет устойчивость при дельта > 0. ")')
      write(*,'(3x,"Оcновной режим теряет устойчивость при дельта > 0. ")')
   else
      write(6,'(3x,"Оcновной режим теряет устойчивость при дельта < 0. ")')
      write(*,'(3x,"Оcновной режим теряет устойчивость при дельта < 0. ")')
   end if

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! 1) First analysis block
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   r0 = 1.0_dp
   r  = br + cr
   r1 = br - cr
   r2 = r - dr - er + fr
   r3 = r - dr - er - fr
   call fanalis(r, r1, r2, r3, r0, 1)

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   r  = br + dr
   r1 = br - dr
   r2 = r - cr - er + fr
   r3 = r - cr - er - fr
   call fanalis(r, r1, r2, r3, r0, 2)

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! 3) Third analysis block (with discriminant handling)
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   r  = br + er
   r1 = br - er
   r2 = ci + di - bi - ei
   r3 = fr*fr + fi*fi
   r4 = r3 - r2*r2
   i  = 3

      write(*,'(3x,"D=0","режим ",i2)') i
   end if
   r3 = cr + dr - br - er
   r2 = -(r3 + r4)
   r3 = -(r3 - r4)
   call fanalis(r, r1, r2, r3, r0, 3)

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! 4) Fourth analysis block (with discriminant handling)
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   r  = br + cr + dr + er + fr
   r1 = br + cr - dr - er - fr
   r2 = br - cr - dr + er + fr
   r3 = bi - ci - di + ei + fi

   r2 = bi - ci - di + ei - 3.0_dp*fi
   r4 = r3 - r2*r2

      r4 = 0.0_dp
      write(6,'(3x,"D=0","режим ",i2)') i
      write(*,'(3x,"D=0","режим ",i2)') i
   end if
   r2 = -(br - cr + dr - er - fr)
   r3 = -(br - cr - dr + er - 3.0_dp*fr + r4)
   r0 = -(br - cr - dr + er - 3.0_dp*fr - r4)
   call fanalis(r, r1, r2, r3, r0, 4)

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! 5) Fifth analysis block (with discriminant handling)
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   r  = br + cr + dr + er - fr
   r1 = br + cr - dr - er + fr
   r2 = br - cr - dr + er - fr
   r3 = bi - ci - di + ei - fi
   r3 = r2*r2 + r3*r3
   r2 = bi - ci - di + ei + 3.0_dp*fi
   r4 = r3 - r2*r2
   i  = 5
   if (r4 >= 0.0_dp) then
      r4 = sqrt(r4)
   else
      r4 = 0.0_dp
      write(6,'(3x,"D=0","режим ",i2)') i
      write(*,'(3x,"D=0","режим ",i2)') i
   end if
   r2 = -(br - cr + dr - er + fr)
   r3 = -(br - cr - dr + er + 3.0_dp*fr + r4)
   r0 = -(br - cr - dr + er + 3.0_dp*fr - r4)
   call fanalis(r, r1, r2, r3, r0, 5)

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! 6) Sixth analysis block (simple case)
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   r  = br
   r1 = -(br - cr)
   r2 = br - dr
   r3 = br - er
   r0 = 1.0_dp
   call fanalis(r, r1, r2, r3, r0, 6)

end subroutine analise

      !-------------------------------------------------------------------

      real(wp), intent(in) :: THERMAL_COEFFICIENT(0:NPD_THERMAL_COEFF-1)

      real(wp), intent(in) :: T_GROUND(NPD_PROFILE)
      real(wp), intent(out):: PLANCK_SOURCE(NPD_PROFILE,0:NPD_LAYER)
      real(wp), intent(out):: DIFF_PLANCK(NPD_PROFILE,NPD_LAYER)
      real(wp), intent(out):: DIFF_PLANCK_2(NPD_PROFILE,NPD_LAYER)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: T(NPD_PROFILE,0:NPD_LAYER)
      real(wp), intent(out):: PLANCK_GROUND(NPD_PROFILE)
      logical, intent(in)  :: L_IR_SOURCE_QUAD
      integer, intent(in)  :: N_FRAC_ICE_POINT
      integer, intent(in)  :: I_FRAC_ICE_POINT(NPD_PROFILE)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: ICE_FRACTION(NPD_PROFILE)
      real(wp), intent(out):: PLANCK_FREEZE_SEA
      integer, intent(in)  :: NPD_PROFILE, NPD_LAYER, NPD_THERMAL_COEFF

      ! Local variables
      !-------------------------------------------------------------------
      integer :: I, J, L, LG
      real(wp) :: T_RATIO(NPD_PROFILE)
      real(wp) :: T_ICE_G(NPD_PROFILE)
      real(wp) :: PLANCK_GROUND_G(NPD_PROFILE)
      real(wp), parameter :: ZERODEGC = 273.15_wp
      real(wp), parameter :: TFS      = 271.35_wp
      real(wp), parameter :: TM       = 273.15_wp

      !===================================================================
      ! 1) Compute PLANCK_SOURCE at the first level (level 0)
      !===================================================================

         T_RATIO(L) = T_LEVEL(L,0) / T_REF_PLANCK
         PLANCK_SOURCE(L,0) = THERMAL_COEFFICIENT(N_DEG_FIT)
      end do
      do J = N_DEG_FIT-1, 0, -1
         do L = 1, N_PROFILE
            PLANCK_SOURCE(L,0) = PLANCK_SOURCE(L,0) * T_RATIO(L) + THERMAL_COEFFICIENT(J)
         end do
      end do

      !===================================================================
      ! 2) Loop over atmospheric layers
      !===================================================================
      do I = 1, N_LAYER
         !--- evaluate Planck polynomial at the upper level of the layer ---
         do L = 1, N_PROFILE
            T_RATIO(L) = T_LEVEL(L,I) / T_REF_PLANCK
            PLANCK_SOURCE(L,I) = THERMAL_COEFFICIENT(N_DEG_FIT)
         end do
         do J = N_DEG_FIT-1, 0, -1
            do L = 1, N_PROFILE
               PLANCK_SOURCE(L,I) = PLANCK_SOURCE(L,I) * T_RATIO(L) + THERMAL_COEFFICIENT(J)
            end do
         end do
         !--- differences between successive levels ---
         do L = 1, N_PROFILE
            DIFF_PLANCK(L,I) = PLANCK_SOURCE(L,I) - PLANCK_SOURCE(L,I-1)
         end do
      end do

      !===================================================================
      ! 3) Second‑order (quadratic) contribution, if required
      !===================================================================
      if (L_IR_SOURCE_QUAD) then
         do I = 1, N_LAYER
            ! evaluate the polynomial at the layer‑midpoint temperature
            do L = 1, N_PROFILE
               T_RATIO(L) = T(N_PROFILE, I) / T_REF_PLANCK   ! placeholder, will be overwritten
            end do
            ! actual evaluation using the centre temperatures (array T)
            do L = 1, N_PROFILE
               T_RATIO(L) = T(L,I) / T_REF_PLANCK
               DIFF_PLANCK_2(L,I) = THERMAL_COEFFICIENT(N_DEG_FIT)
            end do
            do J = N_DEG_FIT-1, 0, -1
               do L = 1, N_PROFILE
                  DIFF_PLANCK_2(L,I) = DIFF_PLANCK_2(L,I) * T_RATIO(L) + THERMAL_COEFFICIENT(J)
               end do
            end do
            ! combine to obtain the second‑difference form used in the original code
            do L = 1, N_PROFILE
               DIFF_PLANCK_2(L,I) = 2.0_wp * ( PLANCK_SOURCE(L,I) + PLANCK_SOURCE(L,I-1) - 2.0_wp * DIFF_PLANCK_2(L,I) )
            end do
         end do
      end if

      !===================================================================
      ! 4) Surface source (PLANCK_GROUND)
      !===================================================================
      do L = 1, N_PROFILE
         T_RATIO(L) = T_GROUND(L) / T_REF_PLANCK
         PLANCK_GROUND(L) = THERMAL_COEFFICIENT(N_DEG_FIT)
      end do
      do J = N_DEG_FIT-1, 0, -1
         do L = 1, N_PROFILE
            PLANCK_GROUND(L) = PLANCK_GROUND(L) * T_RATIO(L) + THERMAL_COEFFICIENT(J)
         end do
      end do

      !===================================================================
      ! 5) Planck value for a completely frozen sea surface
      !===================================================================
      T_RATIO(1) = TFS / T_REF_PLANCK
      PLANCK_FREEZE_SEA = THERMAL_COEFFICIENT(N_DEG_FIT)
      do J = N_DEG_FIT-1, 0, -1
         PLANCK_FREEZE_SEA = PLANCK_FREEZE_SEA * T_RATIO(1) + THERMAL_COEFFICIENT(J)
      end do

      !===================================================================
      ! 6) Ice temperature for points that have a non‑zero ice fraction
      !===================================================================
      do L = 1, N_FRAC_ICE_POINT
         LG = I_FRAC_ICE_POINT(L)
         T_ICE_G(L) = ( T_GROUND(LG) - TFS * (1.0_wp - ICE_FRACTION(LG)) ) / ICE_FRACTION(LG)
      end do

      !===================================================================
      ! 7) Planck source for the ice‑covered points
      !===================================================================
      do L = 1, N_FRAC_ICE_POINT
         T_RATIO(L) = T_ICE_G(L) / T_REF_PLANCK
         PLANCK_GROUND_G(L) = THERMAL_COEFFICIENT(N_DEG_FIT)
      end do
      do J = N_DEG_FIT-1, 0, -1
         do L = 1, N_FRAC_ICE_POINT
            PLANCK_GROUND_G(L) = PLANCK_GROUND_G(L) * T_RATIO(L) + THERMAL_COEFFICIENT(J)
         end do
      end do

      !===================================================================
      ! 8) Combine ice and open‑water contributions for the surface
      !===================================================================
      do L = 1, N_FRAC_ICE_POINT
         LG = I_FRAC_ICE_POINT(L)
         PLANCK_GROUND(LG) = ICE_FRACTION(LG) * PLANCK_GROUND_G(L) + &
                             PLANCK_FREEZE_SEA * (1.0_wp - ICE_FRACTION(LG))
      end do

    real(dp) :: RRA
    real(dp) :: sort1

    if (N <= 1) return

    IR = N
    do
       if (L > 1) then
          L = L - 1
          RRA = RA(L)
          RRB = RB(L)

          RRB = RB(IR)
          RA(IR) = RA(1)

!=====================================================================
! Subroutine DELAZ – core scientific routine
!=====================================================================
subroutine delaz(elat, elon, slat, slon, del, az, baz, delkm, saz, caz)
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real32
   implicit none
   real(wp), intent(in)  :: elat, elon, slat, slon
   real(wp), intent(out) :: del, az, baz, delkm, saz, caz

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Local variables
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   real(wp) :: rad, e2, re
   real(wp) :: selat, celat, slon_e, clon_e   ! epicenter direction cosines
   real(wp) :: sslat, cslat, slon_s, clon_s   ! station   direction cosines
   real(wp) :: ea, eb, ec, sa, sb, sc        ! direction‑cosine components
   real(wp) :: cdel, fac, sbz, cbz
   real(wp) :: tmp_saz, tmp_caz

   rad = 0.017453292_wp   ! degrees → radians
   e2  = 0.9932315_wp
   re  = 6371.003_wp       ! Earth radius (km)

   ! Direction cosines for epicenter and station
   call dircos(elat, elon, selat, celat, slon_e, clon_e, ea, eb, ec)
   call dircos(slat, slon, sslat, cslat, slon_s, clon_s, sa, sb, sc)

   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Compute great‑circle distance (in radians) using the dot product
   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   cdel = ea*sa + eb*sb + ec*sc

   if (cdel > 0.9396_wp) then
      fac = (ea - sa)**2 + (eb - sb)**2 + (ec - sc)**2
      fac = sqrt(fac) / 2.0_wp
      del = 2.0_wp * asin(fac)
   else if (cdel <= 0.9396_wp .and. cdel >= -0.9396_wp) then
      del = acos(cdel)
   else
      fac = (ea + sa)**2 + (eb + sb)**2 + (ec + sc)**2
      fac = sqrt(fac) / 2.0_wp
      del = 2.0_wp * acos(fac)
   end if

   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Azimuth and back‑azimuth (in radians initially)
   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   if (elat == 90.0_wp .or. slat == -90.0_wp) then
      az  = 180.0_wp * rad
      baz = 0.0_wp
      saz = 0.0_wp
      caz = -1.0_wp
   else if (elat == -90.0_wp .or. slat == 90.0_wp) then
      az  = 0.0_wp
      baz = 180.0_wp * rad
      saz = 0.0_wp
      caz = 1.0_wp
   else
      saz = celat * (cslat * sin(rad*(slon - elon)))
      caz = (sslat - cdel*selat)
      fac = sqrt(saz**2 + caz**2)
      if (fac > 0.0_wp) then
         saz = saz / fac
         caz = caz / fac
         az = atan2(saz, caz)

         sbz = -cslat * (celat * sin(rad*(slon - elon)))
         cbz = (selat - cdel*sslat)
         baz = atan2(sbz, cbz)
      else
         az  = 0.0_wp
         caz = 1.0_wp
         saz = 0.0_wp
         baz = 180.0_wp * rad
      end if
      az  = az / rad   ! convert to degrees
      baz = baz / rad
   end if

   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Convert distance to km and degrees
   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   delkm = del * re
   del   = del / rad   ! now in degrees

   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Normalise azimuths to the range [0,360)
   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   if (az  < 0.0_wp) az  = az  + 360.0_wp
   if (baz < 0.0_wp) baz = baz + 360.0_wp

end subroutine delaz

!=====================================================================
! Subroutine DIRCOS – compute direction‑cosine components of a point
!=====================================================================
subroutine dircos(lat, lon, slat, clat, slon, clon, aa, bb, cc)
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real32
   implicit none
   real(wp), intent(in)  :: lat, lon
   real(wp), intent(out) :: slat, clat, slon, clon
   real(wp), intent(out) :: aa, bb, cc

   real(wp) :: rad, e2, c, s, e4, fac

   rad = 0.017453292_wp
   e2  = 0.99776354_wp   ! (1‑f)^1.5 where f = 1/298.257

   c = cos(rad*lat)
   s = sin(rad*lat)
   e4 = e2**2
   fac = sqrt(e4 + (1.0_wp - e4)*c*c)

   slat = e2 * s / fac
   clat = c / fac
   slon = sin(rad*lon)
   clon = cos(rad*lon)

   aa = clat * clon
   bb = clat * slon
   cc = slat

end subroutine dircos

  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
  implicit none

  integer, parameter :: m = 2, n = 2
  integer, parameter :: mn = m*n
  integer, parameter :: ld1 = mn + 1

  real(dp), dimension(:), allocatable :: pm1
  integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: d1, d2
  real(dp) :: epsr, epsa

  ! Allocate arrays (size sufficient for the example)
  allocate(pm1(13))
  allocate(d1(ld1+1))   ! ld1+1 = 5
  allocate(d2(ld1+1))

  ! Offsets for each polynomial (3 coefficients per polynomial)
  d1 = [1, 4, 7, 10, 13]

  ! Example coefficients for the 4 polynomials (row‑major order)
  pm1 = [ &
    0.5_dp, 0.2_dp, 0.05_dp,        & ! polynomial (1,1)
    0.001_dp, 0.0005_dp, 0.0001_dp,& ! polynomial (2,1)
    1.0_dp, -0.3_dp, 0.04_dp,      & ! polynomial (1,2)
    0.0_dp, 0.0_dp, 0.0_dp,        & ! polynomial (2,2)
    0.0_dp ]                        ! padding to reach size 13

  epsr = 0.1_dp
  epsa = 1.0e-6_dp

  call dmpcle(pm1, d1, m, n, d2, epsr, epsa)

  print *, 'After dmpcle:'
  print *, 'd1 =', d1
  print *, 'pm1 =', pm1

contains

  subroutine dmpcle(pm1, d1, m, n, d2, epsr, epsa)
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: pm1(*)
    integer, intent(inout) :: d1(*), d2(*)
    integer, intent(in)    :: m, n
    real(dp), intent(in)   :: epsr, epsa
    integer :: mn, ld1, k, l, lmin, lmax, ll, count, ivol, l1
    real(dp) :: norm, eps
    logical :: ok

    mn = m * n
    ld1 = mn + 1

    if (mn == 1) then
       lmin = d1(1)
       lmax = d1(2) - 1
       norm = 0.0_dp
       do l = lmin, lmax
          norm = norm + abs(pm1(l))
       end do
       eps = max(epsa, epsr * norm)
       ll = lmax + 1
       count = 0
       ok = .false.
       do k = lmin, lmax
          ll = ll - 1
          if (abs(pm1(ll)) <= eps) then
             pm1(ll) = 0.0_dp
             if (ll == lmax) ok = .true.
             if (ok) count = count + 1
          else
             ok = .false.
          end if
       end do
       d1(2) = d1(2) - count
       if (d1(2) <= d1(1)) d1(2) = d1(1) + 1
       return
    end if

    do k = 1, ld1
       d2(k) = d1(k)
    end do

    do k = 1, mn
       lmin = d2(k)
       lmax = d2(k+1) - 1
       norm = 0.0_dp
       do l = lmin, lmax
          norm = norm + abs(pm1(l))
       end do
       eps = max(epsa, epsr * norm)
       ll = lmax + 1
       count = 0
       ok = .false.
       do l = lmin, lmax
          ll = ll - 1
          if (abs(pm1(ll)) <= eps) then
             if (ll == lmax) ok = .true.
             if (ok) count = count + 1
             pm1(ll) = 0.0_dp
          else
             ok = .false.
          end if
       end do
       d1(k+1) = d1(k) + d2(k+1) - d2(k) - count
       if (d1(k+1) <= d1(k)) d1(k+1) = d1(k) + 1
    end do

    l1 = d1(2)
    do k = 2, mn
       lmin = d2(k)
       ivol = d1(k+1) - d1(k)
       call dcopy(ivol, pm1(lmin), 1, pm1(l1), 1)
       l1 = l1 + ivol
    end do

  end subroutine dmpcle

  subroutine dcopy(n, x, incx, y, incy)
    integer, intent(in) :: n, incx, incy
    real(dp), intent(in) :: x(*)
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: y(*)
    integer :: i, ix, iy
    ix = 1
    iy = 1
    do i = 1, n
       y(iy) = x(ix)
       ix = ix + incx
       iy = iy + incy
    end do
  end subroutine dcopy

end program dmpcle_demo

!=================================================================
! Subroutine: simpsons_rule
! Implements Simpson's rule for numerical integration of a 1‑D
! array of function values.
!=================================================================

SUBROUTINE simpsons_rule(N, DELTA, INPUT_ARRAY, RESULT)
  IMPLICIT NONE
  INTEGER, INTENT(IN) :: N                     ! number of intervals
  REAL(KIND=KIND(1.0D0)), INTENT(IN) :: DELTA   ! spacing of the grid
  REAL(KIND=KIND(1.0D0)), INTENT(IN) :: INPUT_ARRAY(0:N) ! values at grid points
  REAL(KIND=KIND(1.0D0)), INTENT(OUT) :: RESULT ! integral estimate

  INTEGER :: I
  REAL(KIND=KIND(1.0D0)) :: SUM

  SUM = 0.0D0
  DO I = 0, N+1
     IF (I == 0 .OR. I == N) THEN
        SUM = SUM + INPUT_ARRAY(I)
     ELSE IF (MOD(I,2) == 0) THEN
        SUM = SUM + 2.0D0 * INPUT_ARRAY(I)
     ELSE
        SUM = SUM + 4.0D0 * INPUT_ARRAY(I)
     END IF
  END DO

  RESULT = SUM * DELTA / 3.0D0

  RETURN
END SUBROUTINE simpsons_rule

       k2 = kLoc

       theMax(n)  = 0.0_dp

          do n = 1, nSepBnd

                      tileVol (bi,bj,n) = tileVol (bi,bj,n) + tmpVol
                      tileMean(bi,bj,n) = tileMean(bi,bj,n) + tmpVol*tmpVal
                      tileVar (bi,bj,n) = tileVar (bi,bj,n) + tmpVol*tmpVal*tmpVal

       call global_sum_tile_rl( tileMean(1,1,n), theMean(n), myThid )
       call global_sum_tile_rl( tileVar (1,1,n), theVar(n), myThid )
    end do

    do n = 1, nSepBnd
       if ( theVol(n) > 0.0_dp ) then
          theMean(n) = theMean(n) / theVol(n)
          theVar(n)  = theVar(n) / theVol(n)
          theVar(n)  = theVar(n) - theMean(n)*theMean(n)

          call global_max_rl( theMin(n), myThid )
          theMin(n) = -theMin(n)

          call global_max_rl( theMax(n), myThid )
       end if
    end do

    ! ---------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Computes the pressure and height of the freezing level in a
    ! sounding.  The algorithm is a faithful translation of the legacy
    ! fixed‑form subroutine FRZLEV.
    ! ---------------------------------------------------------------
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: elev               ! station elevation (m asl)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: p(:)               ! pressure (mb)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: ht(:)              ! height (ft asl)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: t(:)               ! temperature (K)
    integer, intent(in)   :: nlvls              ! number of levels
    real(dp), intent(out) :: pfrz, hfrz         ! outputs
    integer :: i
    real(dp), parameter :: tfrz = 273.15_dp    ! freezing temperature (K)

    ! Default: scenario 3 – no freezing level found.
    pfrz = p(1)
    hfrz = 0.0_dp

    if (t(1) /= tfrz) then
      do i = 2, nlvls
        if ( (t(i) <= tfrz .and. t(i-1) > tfrz) .or. &
             (t(i) >= tfrz .and. t(i-1) < tfrz) ) then
          ! Linear interpolation in height versus temperature.
          hfrz = interp1(ht(i), ht(i-1), t(i), tfrz, t(i-1))

      pfrz = p(1)
      hfrz = ht(1)

    ! ---------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Linear interpolation: given two points (x0,y0) and (x1,y1), return the
    ! interpolated y at the intermediate abscissa x.
    ! ---------------------------------------------------------------
    real(dp), intent(in) :: y1, y0, x1, x, x0
    real(dp) :: y
    if (x1 == x0) then
      y = y0
    else
      y = y0 + (y1 - y0) * (x - x0) / (x1 - x0)
    end if
  end function interp1

       do i = 1, m
          c(i,j) = r8_uniform_01 ( seed )
       end do
    end do

    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Timing start (CPU_TIME provides wall‑clock time in seconds)
    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    call cpu_time ( time_begin )

    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Matrix multiplication: A(i,j) = sum_k B(i,k) * C(k,j)

    do j = 1, n

    call cpu_time ( time_stop )

    !-----------------------------------------------------------------

    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    ops = l * n * ( 2 * m )
    time_elapsed = time_stop - time_begin
    if ( time_elapsed > 0.0_wp ) then

    else

    end if

  function r8_uniform_01 ( seed ) result ( r )
    implicit none
    integer, intent(inout) :: seed
    real(wp)               :: r
    integer                :: k

    if ( seed == 0 ) then

    if ( seed < 0 ) seed = seed + 2147483647

    r = dble ( seed ) * 4.656612875e-10_wp

!================================================================
! Restored Fortran 90 implementation of the original EMBM "readroff"
! subroutine logic.  The routine calculates the runoff routing matrix
! (iroff, jroff) by following compass‑direction codes stored in k1.
! Only the i‑index is periodic (as in the original code); the j‑index
! is left untouched.  No artificial DEFAULT branch is introduced – the
! control flow mirrors the original IF‑ELSE chain.
!================================================================
program readroff_main
   implicit none

   !--------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Parameters – hard‑coded representative values for a test run
   !--------------------------------------------------------------
   integer, parameter :: imax = 5      ! number of grid points in i‑direction
   integer, parameter :: jmax = 5      ! number of grid points in j‑direction
   integer, parameter :: kmax = 10     ! sea‑level threshold (k <= kmax is sea)
   integer, parameter :: iroe = 91     ! east  (compass direction code)
   integer, parameter :: iros = 92     ! south
   integer, parameter :: irow = 93     ! west
   integer, parameter :: iron = 94     ! north

   !--------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Variable declarations
   !--------------------------------------------------------------
   integer :: i, j, loop
   integer, dimension(imax,jmax) :: k1      ! terrain type / direction map
   integer, dimension(imax,jmax) :: iroff    ! runoff destination i‑index
   integer, dimension(imax,jmax) :: jroff    ! runoff destination j‑index

   !--------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Initialise a small test configuration for k1.
   !   * Values <= kmax represent ocean (no routing needed).
   !   * Values > kmax are direction codes that point to the sea.
   !--------------------------------------------------------------
   k1 = 0
   ! Example pattern: a simple clockwise loop around the centre cell.
   k1(1,1) = iroe   ! from (1,1) go east
   k1(2,1) = iros   ! from (2,1) go south
   k1(2,2) = irow   ! from (2,2) go west
   k1(1,2) = iron   ! from (1,2) go north (will hit a boundary, no wrap)

   print *, 'Calculating runoff routing (hard‑coded test case)'

   !--------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Main routing algorithm – direct translation of the original subroutine.
   !--------------------------------------------------------------
   do j = 1, jmax
      do i = 1, imax
         iroff(i,j) = i
         jroff(i,j) = j
         loop = 0
         do while (k1(iroff(i,j), jroff(i,j)) > kmax)
            select case (k1(iroff(i,j), jroff(i,j)))
            case (iroe)          ! east
               iroff(i,j) = iroff(i,j) + 1
            case (iros)          ! south
               jroff(i,j) = jroff(i,j) - 1
            case (irow)          ! west
               iroff(i,j) = iroff(i,j) - 1
            case (iron)          ! north
               jroff(i,j) = jroff(i,j) + 1
            end select   ! (no DEFAULT – mirrors original IF‑ELSE chain)

            !----------------------------------------------------------
            ! Periodic boundary conditions – only for the i‑index.
            !----------------------------------------------------------
            if (iroff(i,j) == imax + 1) then
               iroff(i,j) = 1
            else if (iroff(i,j) == 0) then
               iroff(i,j) = imax
            end if
            ! (j‑index is *not* wrapped – original behaviour)

            !----------------------------------------------------------
            ! Guard against infinite loops.
            !----------------------------------------------------------
            loop = loop + 1
            if (loop > 100000) then
               print *, 'There is a problem calculating runoff'
               print *, 'Located at k1(', i, ',', j, ')'
               print *, 'k1(', i, ',', j, ') = ', k1(i,j)
               print *, 'iroff(i,j) = ', iroff(i,j)
               print *, 'jroff(i,j) = ', jroff(i,j)
               print *, 'k1(iroff(i,j),jroff(i,j)) = ', k1(iroff(i,j), jroff(i,j))
               print *, '(kmax = ', kmax, ')'
               stop 'problem calculating runoff'
            end if
         end do
      end do
   end do

   print *, 'Runoff routing successfully calculated'

   !--------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Output the resulting routing matrices for verification.
   !--------------------------------------------------------------
   print *, 'iroff matrix (destination i‑indices)'
   do j = 1, jmax
      write(*,'(100(I4,1X))') (iroff(i,j), i = 1, imax)
   end do

   print *, 'jroff matrix (destination j‑indices)'
   do j = 1, jmax
      write(*,'(100(I4,1X))') (jroff(i,j), i = 1, imax)
   end do

end program readroff_main

program SAOi_grads_demo

  implicit none

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Problem dimensions (hard‑coded small example)
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  integer, parameter :: n = 5          ! number of design variables
  integer, parameter :: m = 8          ! number of inequality constraints

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Input data (hard‑coded values for a reproducible demo)
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  real(dp) :: x(n)                     ! design variables
  real(dp) :: gf(n)                    ! gradient of the objective
  real(dp) :: gc(m)                    ! constraint values

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Fixed physical and geometric constants (taken from original code)
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  real(dp), parameter :: E  = 3.0e6_dp   ! Young's modulus
  real(dp), parameter :: Sy = 3.0e4_dp   ! Yield stress
  real(dp), parameter :: Fl = 1.0e4_dp   ! Reference load
  real(dp), parameter :: d  = 0.29_dp
  real(dp), parameter :: h  = 1.0e2_dp   ! Height of the bars

  ! Position of the three bars (fixed for this example)
  real(dp), dimension(3) :: p = (/ -100.0_dp, 0.0_dp, 100.0_dp /)

  ! Local work arrays
  real(dp) :: a(3), l(3), s(3)
  real(dp) :: k11, k12, k22
  real(dp) :: u, v
  real(dp) :: f

  integer :: i

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Initialise design variables (example values)
  !   a(i) = area of bar i   → taken from x(1:3)
  !   u   = horizontal displacement → x(4)
  !   v   = vertical   displacement → x(5)
  !------------------------------------------------------------------

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Extract physical quantities from x
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  do i = 1, huge(0)
     a(i) = x(i)                     ! bar areas
     l(i) = sqrt(p(i)**2 + h**2)    ! bar lengths (independent of x)
  end do

  u = x(4)
  v = x(5)

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Compute stiffness‑related terms (k11, k12, k22)
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  k11 = 0.0_dp
  k12 = 0.0_dp
  k22 = 0.0_dp
  do i = 1, 3
     k11 = k11 + p(i)**2 / l(i)**3
     k12 = k12 - h * p(i) / l(i)**3
     k22 = k22 + Fl / l(i)**3
  end do
  k11 = k11 * E
  k12 = k12 * E
  k22 = k22 * E

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Compute internal forces s(i)
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  do i = 1, 3
     s(i) = E * ( -u * p(i) + h * v ) / l(i)**2
  end do

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Objective function (total weight) and its gradient
  !   f = d * Σ a(i) * l(i)
  !   ∂f/∂a(i) = d * l(i)   (since l(i) does not depend on x)
  !   ∂f/∂u = ∂f/∂v = 0
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  f = d * sum( a(:) * l(:) )
  do i = 1, 3
     gf(i) = d * l(i)
  end do
  gf(4) = 0.0_dp
  gf(5) = 0.0_dp

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Inequality constraints (c) – stored in gc(1:m)
  !   1‑3 : tension limits  ( s(i)/Sy - 1 ) ≤ 0
  !   4‑6 : compression limits ( -s(i)/Sy - 1 ) ≤ 0
  !   7   : equilibrium in x‑direction
  !   8   : equilibrium in y‑direction
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  do i = 1, 3
     gc(i)   = s(i) / Sy - 1.0_dp          ! tension
     gc(i+3) = -s(i) / Sy - 1.0_dp         ! compression
  end do
  gc(7) = k11 * u + k12 * v - Fl            ! ΣFx = 0
  gc(8) = k12 * u + k22 * v                 ! ΣFy = 0

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Output results
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  print *, '=== SAOi Gradients Demo ==='
  print *, 'Design variables x:'
  print *, x
  print *, 'Objective value f =', f
  print *, 'Gradient gf (df/dx):'
  print *, gf
  print *, 'Constraint values gc (should be ≤ 0):'
  print *, gc

end program SAOi_grads_demo

subroutine breitw(x1, mminsq, mmaxsq, rmass, rwidth, msq, wt)
  implicit none
  double precision, intent(in)  :: x1, mminsq, mmaxsq, rmass, rwidth
  double precision, intent(out) :: msq, wt
  double precision :: almin, almax, al, tanal
  double precision, parameter :: pi = 4.0d0*atan(1.0d0)
  logical, parameter :: zerowidth = .false.

  !-----------------------------------------------------------------
  ! If the allowed m^2 range is tiny compared with the resonance mass,
  ! fall back to a simple linear mapping for safety.
  !-----------------------------------------------------------------
  if (mmaxsq .lt. rmass*1.0d-3) then
     msq = mminsq + x1*(mmaxsq - mminsq)
     wt  = mmaxsq - mminsq
     return
  end if

  if (zerowidth) then
     tanal = 0.0d0
     almax = + pi/2.0d0
     almin = - pi/2.0d0
  else
     almin = atan( (mminsq - rmass**2) / (rmass*rwidth) )
     almax = atan( (mmaxsq - rmass**2) / (rmass*rwidth) )
     al    = (almax - almin)*x1 + almin
     tanal = tan(al)
  end if

  msq = rmass**2 + rmass*rwidth*tanal
  wt  = (almax - almin)*rmass*rwidth*(1.0d0 + tanal**2)
end subroutine breitw

program test_relaxmu
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64, int32, output_unit
  implicit none

  !----------------------------------------------------------------

  !----------------------------------------------------------------
  integer, parameter :: npoint = 5          ! small problem size
  integer, parameter :: nitdis = 3          ! maximum sub‑iterations
  real(dp), parameter :: epsdis = 1.0d-3    ! convergence tolerance

  logical :: alemon = .false.

  integer :: lng = 1                       ! language selector (1 = FR, 2 = EN)
  integer(int32) :: lu = output_unit       ! logical unit for messages

  real(dp), dimension(npoint) :: mu, mu2, hmu, hmuanc

  ! Variables returned by RELAXMU
  real(dp) :: ecrhmu, modhmu

  !----------------------------------------------------------------

    integer :: i
    do i = 1, size(mu)
      mu(i)      = 1.0d0 + 0.1d0*i
      mu2(i)     = mu(i) * (1.0d0 + 0.05d0)   ! a slightly perturbed value
      hmu(i)     = 2.0d0 + 0.2d0*i

program zriddr_demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   implicit none

   ! ----------------------------------------------------------
   ! Declarations
   ! ----------------------------------------------------------
   real(dp) :: root, x1, x2, xacc
   real(dp), parameter :: UNUSED = -1.11e30_dp

   ! ----------------------------------------------------------
   ! Test interval and accuracy (hard‑coded)
   ! ----------------------------------------------------------
   x1   = 1.0_dp
   x2   = 2.0_dp
   xacc = 1.0e-12_dp

   ! ----------------------------------------------------------
   ! Call the root‑finder
   ! ----------------------------------------------------------
   root = zriddr(test_func, x1, x2, xacc)

   ! ----------------------------------------------------------
   ! Output result
   ! ----------------------------------------------------------
   if (root == UNUSED) then
      print *, 'Root not found (UNUSED sentinel returned).'
   else
      print '(a,es20.12)', 'Root found: ', root
      print '(a,es20.12)', 'f(root) = ', test_func(root)
   end if

contains

   ! ----------------------------------------------------------
   ! Test function: f(x) = x**3 - x - 2
   ! ----------------------------------------------------------
   function test_func(x) result(f)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: x
      real(dp) :: f
      f = x**3 - x - 2.0_dp
   end function test_func

   ! ----------------------------------------------------------
   ! zriddr – Ridder's method for a root of a function on [x1,x2]
   ! ----------------------------------------------------------
   function zriddr(func, x1, x2, xacc) result(zr)
      ! Arguments
      procedure(real_func) :: func   ! dummy procedure (no INTENT)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: x1, x2, xacc
      real(dp) :: zr

      ! Locals
      integer, parameter :: maxit = 60
      integer :: j
      real(dp) :: fl, fh, fm, fnew, s
      real(dp) :: xl, xh, xm, xnew

      ! Initial function values at the interval ends
      fl = func(x1)
      fh = func(x2)

      if ((fl > 0.0_dp .and. fh < 0.0_dp) .or. (fl < 0.0_dp .and. fh > 0.0_dp)) then
         xl = x1
         xh = x2
         zr = UNUSED
         do j = 1, maxit
            xm = 0.5_dp * (xl + xh)
            fm = func(xm)
            s  = sqrt(fm**2 - fl*fh)
            if (s == 0.0_dp) exit
            xnew = xm + (xm - xl) * (sign(1.0_dp, fl - fh) * fm / s)
            if (abs(xnew - zr) <= xacc) exit
            zr = xnew
            fnew = func(zr)
            if (fnew == 0.0_dp) exit
            if (sign(fm, fnew) /= fm) then
               xl = xm
               fl = fm
               xh = zr
               fh = fnew
            else if (sign(fl, fnew) /= fl) then
               xh = zr
               fh = fnew
            else if (sign(fh, fnew) /= fh) then
               xl = zr
               fl = fnew
            else

            if (abs(xh - xl) <= xacc) exit
         end do

      else if (fh == 0.0_dp) then
         zr = x2
      else
         print *, 'root must be bracketed in zriddr'
         zr = UNUSED
      end if

  end do

  subroutine jacob2(cartd, deriv, detjac, elcod, ielem, mdime, ndime, nnode)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: mdime, ndime, nnode, ielem
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: deriv(mdime, *), elcod(mdime, *)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: cartd(mdime, *), detjac

    real(dp) :: xjaci(2,2), xjacm(2,2)
    real(dp), parameter :: r0 = 0.0_dp
    integer :: idime, jdime, inode

    ! Initialise Jacobian matrix XJACM to zero
    do idime = 1, ndime
       do jdime = 1, ndime
          xjacm(idime,jdime) = r0
          do inode = 1, nnode
             xjacm(idime,jdime) = xjacm(idime,jdime) + &
                  deriv(idime,inode) * elcod(jdime,inode)
          end do
       end do
    end do

    ! Determinant of Jacobian matrix
    detjac = xjacm(1,1)*xjacm(2,2) - xjacm(1,2)*xjacm(2,1)
    if (detjac < r0) then
       write(*,1000) detjac, ielem
    else if (detjac == r0) then
       write(*,1010) ielem
       goto 999
    end if

    ! Inverse of Jacobian matrix
    xjaci(1,1) =  xjacm(2,2) / detjac
    xjaci(2,2) =  xjacm(1,1) / detjac
    xjaci(1,2) = -xjacm(1,2) / detjac
    xjaci(2,1) = -xjacm(2,1) / detjac

    ! Evaluate Cartesian derivatives of shape functions
    do idime = 1, ndime
       do inode = 1, nnode
          cartd(idime,inode) = r0
          do jdime = 1, ndime
             cartd(idime,inode) = cartd(idime,inode) + &
                  xjaci(idime,jdime) * deriv(jdime,inode)
          end do
       end do
    end do

    return

               10x,'of shape functions not computed')

  end subroutine jacob2

end program jacob2_demo

  end do

  do i = 1, n

  end do

  call fork(n, cx, signi)

  do i = 1, n
     print *, i, cx(i)
  end do

  subroutine fork(lx, cx, signi)

    complex(dp), intent(inout) :: cx(lx)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: signi
    integer :: i, j, m, l, istep
    real(dp) :: pi, sc, temp
    complex(dp) :: ctemp, carg, cw

    j = 1

    do i = 1, lx

          cx(j) = cx(i) * sc
          cx(i) = ctemp
       end if

          j = j - m
          m = m / 2
          if (m < 1) exit
       end do
       j = j + m
    end do

    l = 1

          cw = exp(carg)
          do i = m, lx, istep

             cx(i+l) = cx(i) - ctemp
             cx(i)   = cx(i) + ctemp
          end do
       end do

       l = istep
    end do
  end subroutine fork
