! Demonstration of the CGTTS2 routine (LU solve for a tridiagonal matrix)
! The code is self‑contained, uses only ISO_FORTRAN_ENV and no I/O files.

module cgtts2_mod
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   implicit none
contains
   subroutine cgtts2(itrans, n, nrhs, dl, d, du, du2, ipiv, b, ldb)
      integer, intent(in) :: itrans, n, nrhs, ldb
      integer, intent(in) :: ipiv(*)
      complex(dp), intent(in) :: dl(*), d(*), du(*), du2(*)
      complex(dp), intent(inout) :: b(ldb, *)
      integer :: i, j
      complex(dp) :: temp
      intrinsic :: conjg

      if (n == 0 .or. nrhs == 0) return

      select case (itrans)
      case (0)   ! A * X = B
         do j = 1, nrhs
            call solve_l(j)
            call solve_u(j)
         end do
      case (1)   ! A**T * X = B
         do j = 1, nrhs
            call solve_ut(j)
            call solve_lt(j)
         end do
      case (2)   ! A**H * X = B
         do j = 1, nrhs
            call solve_uconj(j)
            call solve_lconj(j)
         end do
      end select

   contains
      subroutine solve_l(col)
         integer, intent(in) :: col
         do i = 1, n-1
            if (ipiv(i) == i) then
               b(i+1, col) = b(i+1, col) - dl(i) * b(i, col)
            else
               temp = b(i, col)
               b(i, col) = b(i+1, col)
               b(i+1, col) = temp - dl(i) * b(i, col)
            end if
         end do
      end subroutine solve_l

      subroutine solve_u(col)
         integer, intent(in) :: col
         b(n, col) = b(n, col) / d(n)
         if (n > 1) then
            b(n-1, col) = (b(n-1, col) - du(n-1) * b(n, col)) / d(n-1)
         end if
         do i = n-2, 1, -1
            b(i, col) = (b(i, col) - du(i) * b(i+1, col) - du2(i) * b(i+2, col)) / d(i)
         end do
      end subroutine solve_u

      subroutine solve_ut(col)
         integer, intent(in) :: col
         b(1, col) = b(1, col) / d(1)
         if (n > 1) then
            b(2, col) = (b(2, col) - du(1) * b(1, col)) / d(2)
         end if
         do i = 3, n
            b(i, col) = (b(i, col) - du(i-1) * b(i-1, col) - du2(i-2) * b(i-2, col)) / d(i)
         end do
      end subroutine solve_ut

      subroutine solve_lt(col)
         integer, intent(in) :: col
         do i = n-1, 1, -1
            if (ipiv(i) == i) then
               b(i, col) = b(i, col) - dl(i) * b(i+1, col)
            else
               temp = b(i+1, col)
               b(i+1, col) = b(i, col) - dl(i) * temp
               b(i, col) = temp
            end if
         end do
      end subroutine solve_lt

      subroutine solve_uconj(col)
         integer, intent(in) :: col
         b(1, col) = b(1, col) / conjg(d(1))
         if (n > 1) then
            b(2, col) = (b(2, col) - conjg(du(1)) * b(1, col)) / conjg(d(2))
         end if
         do i = 3, n
            b(i, col) = (b(i, col) - conjg(du(i-1)) * b(i-1, col) - &
                        conjg(du2(i-2)) * b(i-2, col)) / conjg(d(i))
         end do
      end subroutine solve_uconj

      subroutine solve_lconj(col)
         integer, intent(in) :: col
         do i = n-1, 1, -1
            if (ipiv(i) == i) then
               b(i, col) = b(i, col) - conjg(dl(i)) * b(i+1, col)
            else
               temp = b(i+1, col)
               b(i+1, col) = b(i, col) - conjg(dl(i)) * temp
               b(i, col) = temp
            end if
         end do
      end subroutine solve_lconj

   end subroutine cgtts2
end module cgtts2_mod

program rootfr_demo
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
  implicit none

  integer, parameter :: ihru = 1
  integer, parameter :: nlayer = 5
  integer :: sol_nly(ihru)
  real(dp) :: stsol_rd(ihru)
  real(dp) :: sol_z(nlayer, ihru)
  real(dp) :: rtfr(nlayer)

  ! Initialize representative data
  sol_nly = nlayer
  stsol_rd = 0.30_dp   ! root depth (m)
  sol_z(:,1) = (/ 0.05_dp, 0.15_dp, 0.30_dp, 0.60_dp, 1.00_dp /)  ! cumulative depths

  call rootfr_sub(ihru, sol_nly, stsol_rd, sol_z, rtfr)

  print *, 'Root fraction distribution (rtfr):'
  print *, rtfr
contains

  subroutine rootfr_sub(ihru, sol_nly, stsol_rd, sol_z, rtfr)
    integer, intent(in) :: ihru
    integer, intent(in) :: sol_nly(ihru)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: stsol_rd(ihru)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: sol_z(:,:)          ! assumed‑shape; second dimension is the number of HRUs
    real(dp), intent(out) :: rtfr(:)

    real(dp), parameter :: a = 1.15_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: b = 11.7_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: c = 0.022_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: d = 0.12029_dp

    real(dp) :: sol_thick(size(rtfr))
    real(dp) :: cum_rd, cum_d, cum_rf, x1, x2, xx1, xx2, xx
    integer :: k, l, jj

    jj = ihru

    if (stsol_rd(jj) < 1.0e-6_dp) then
       rtfr(1) = 1.0_dp
       return
    end if

    l = 0
    k = 0
    cum_d = 0.0_dp
    cum_rf = 0.0_dp
    sol_thick = 0.0_dp
    rtfr = 0.0_dp

    do l = 1, sol_nly(jj)
      if (l == 1) then
        sol_thick(l) = sol_z(l, jj)
      else
        sol_thick(l) = sol_z(l, jj) - sol_z(l-1, jj)
      end if

      cum_d = cum_d + sol_thick(l)
      if (cum_d >= stsol_rd(jj)) then
        cum_rd = stsol_rd(jj)
      else
        cum_rd = cum_d
      end if

      x1 = (cum_rd - sol_thick(l)) / stsol_rd(jj)
      x2 = cum_rd / stsol_rd(jj)

      xx1 = -b * x1
      if (xx1 > 20.0_dp) xx1 = 20.0_dp
      xx2 = -b * x2
      if (xx2 > 20.0_dp) xx2 = 20.0_dp

      rtfr(l) = (a/b*(exp(xx1) - exp(xx2)) + c*(x2 - x1)) / d

      xx = cum_rf
      cum_rf = cum_rf + rtfr(l)

      if (cum_rf > 1.0_dp) then
        rtfr(l) = 1.0_dp - xx
        cum_rf = 1.0_dp
      end if

      k = l
      if (cum_rd >= stsol_rd(jj)) exit
    end do

    ! Ensure cumulative fractional root distribution = 1
    do l = 1, sol_nly(jj)
      rtfr(l) = rtfr(l) / cum_rf
      if (l == k) exit
    end do

  end subroutine rootfr_sub

end program rootfr_demo

  real(dp) :: eigth(nth)

       character(len=11) :: 'exponential', 'one', 'coulomb', 'h2-plus' ]

  ! Representative input data

  eigth = [0.5_dp, 1.5_dp]
  lwr = 1
  upr = nth   ! number of "theta" points (same as nth in original code)

  do p = 1, size(potlist)
     ham = 0.0_dp
     call potntl(ham, eigr, eigth, potlist(p), lwr, upr, nr, nth, n)
     print *, 'Potential type: ', trim(potlist(p))
     do i = 1, n
        print '(6F12.6)', ham(i, :)
     end do
  end do

contains

  subroutine potntl(ham, eigr, eigth, pottyp, lwr, upr, nr, nth, n)
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: ham(n, n)
    real(dp), intent(in)    :: eigr(nr)
    real(dp), intent(in)    :: eigth(nth)
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: pottyp
    integer, intent(in) :: lwr, upr, nr, nth, n
    integer :: i, j
    real(dp) :: den1, den2

    count = 0
    if (trim(pottyp) == 'exponential') then
       do i = lwr, upr
          do j = 1, nr
             count = count + 1
             ham(count, count) = ham(count, count) - exp(-eigr(j))
          end do
       end do
    else if (trim(pottyp) == 'one') then
       do i = lwr, upr
          do j = 1, nr
             count = count + 1
             ham(count, count) = ham(count, count) - 1.0_dp
          end do
       end do
    else if (trim(pottyp) == 'coulomb') then
       do i = lwr, upr
          do j = 1, nr
             count = count + 1
             ham(count, count) = ham(count, count) - 1.0_dp / eigr(j)
          end do
       end do
    else if (trim(pottyp) == 'h2-plus') then
       do i = lwr, upr
          do j = 1, nr
             count = count + 1
             den1 = sqrt(eigr(j)*eigr(j) - 2.0_dp*eigr(j)*eigth(i) + 1.0_dp)
             den2 = sqrt(eigr(j)*eigr(j) + 2.0_dp*eigr(j)*eigth(i) + 1.0_dp)
             ham(count, count) = ham(count, count) - 1.0_dp/den1 - 1.0_dp/den2
          end do
       end do
    else
       print *, 'WARNING: unknown potential type ', trim(pottyp)
    end if

    real(dp), intent(in)    :: eigth(nth)

    integer, intent(in) :: lwr, upr, nr, nth, n

  use twpana_data
  implicit none

  !--- Arguments ------------------------------------------------
  integer, intent(in)  :: IT0          ! time of first bucket
  integer, intent(in)  :: NWSMP        ! number of samples
  integer, intent(in)  :: IPH(NWSMP)   ! sample pulse heights
  integer, intent(out) :: ICHG         ! charge estimate
  real(dp), intent(out):: TIM          ! time estimate (double precision)
  integer, intent(out) :: IER          ! error code (0 = OK)

  !--- Local variables -------------------------------------------
  integer :: IS, IMAX, NSAT, ITHR, K
  real(dp):: THR, T1, T2
  integer :: NPRT_save

  ! Preserve the saved diagnostic counter across calls
  NPRT_save = NPRT
  IER = 0

  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  ! 1) Basic sanity checks on the presample and post‑sample edges
  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  if (IPH(NPREWP) > IPH(NPREWP+1)) then
     IER = 2
     return
  end if
  if (IPH(NWSMP-NPSTWP+1) > IPH(NWSMP-NPSTWP)) then
     IER = 2
     return
  end if

  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  ! 2) Find the first decreasing point after the presamples –
  !    this defines the location of the pulse maximum (IMAX).
  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  IMAX = -1
  do IS = NPREWP+2, NWSMP-NPSTWP
     if (IPH(IS) < IPH(IS-1)) then
        IMAX = IS-1
        exit
     end if
  end do
  if (IMAX == -1) then
     IER = 3   ! no maximum found
     return
  end if

  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  ! 3) Check for excessive saturation (value 255) to the left of IMAX
  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  NSAT = 0
  IS = IMAX
  do
     if (IPH(IS) == 255) then
        NSAT = NSAT + 1
        if (NSAT > MXSTWP) then
           IER = 5
           return
        end if
        if (IS == 1) exit
        IS = IS - 1
        cycle
     end if
     exit
  end do

  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  ! 4) Verify that the samples after IMAX are monotonically decreasing
  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  do IS = IMAX+2, NWSMP-NPSTWP
     if (IPH(IS) > IPH(IS-1)) then
        IER = 4
        return
     end if
  end do

  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  ! 5) Compute charge estimate from the three highest samples
  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  if (IPH(IMAX-1) > IPH(IMAX+1)) then
     if (IPH(IMAX-2) > IPH(IMAX+1)) then
        ICHG = IPH(IMAX-2) + IPH(IMAX-1)
     else
        ICHG = IPH(IMAX-1) + IPH(IMAX+1)
     end if
  else
     if (IPH(IMAX+2) > IPH(IMAX-1)) then
        ICHG = IPH(IMAX+2) + IPH(IMAX+1)
     else
        ICHG = IPH(IMAX+1) + IPH(IMAX-1)
     end if

     return
  end if
  if (IPH(NWSMP-NPSTWP+1) >= ITHR) then
     IER = 7
     return
  end if

  ! 8) Find first sample above threshold (ascending side) and
  !    interpolate to obtain the start time T1.
  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  do IS = NPREWP+1, IMAX
     if (IPH(IS) > ITHR) then
        T1 = real(IS-1, dp) + (THR - real(IPH(IS-1), dp)) / &
             (real(IPH(IS), dp) - real(IPH(IS-1), dp))
        exit
     end if
  end do
  if (IS > IMAX) then   ! no sample above threshold found
     if (NPRT_save < MXPRT) then
        NPRT_save = NPRT_save + 1
        write(*,*) 'TWPANA: unphysical pulse shape (no leading edge)'
        write(*,'(20(1X,I3))') (IPH(K), K=1,NWSMP)
     end if
     IER = 8
     return
  end if

  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  ! 9) Find last sample above threshold (descending side) and
  !    interpolate to obtain the end time T2.
  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  do IS = NWSMP-NPSTWP, IMAX, -1
     if (IPH(IS) > ITHR) then
        T2 = real(IS+1, dp) - (THR - real(IPH(IS+1), dp)) / &
             (real(IPH(IS), dp) - real(IPH(IS+1), dp))
        exit
     end if
  end do
  if (IS < IMAX) then   ! no sample above threshold on falling side
     if (NPRT_save < MXPRT) then
        NPRT_save = NPRT_save + 1
        write(*,*) 'TWPANA: unphysical pulse shape (no trailing edge)'
        write(*,'(20(1X,I3))') (IPH(K), K=1,NWSMP)
     end if
     IER = 9
     return
  end if

  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  ! 10) Average start and end times, add offset (IT0-1)
  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  TIM = real(IT0-1, dp) + 0.5_dp*(T1 + T2)
  IER = 0

  ! Store back the updated diagnostic counter
  NPRT = NPRT_save

end subroutine TWPANA

      !-----------------------------------------------------------------

         tn(4) = 1.0_dp

         ta(4) = 1.0_dp
         ta(8) = 1.0_dp

                  an(i) = a1(i)

                  v1(i) = vn(i)
                  a1(i) = an(i)
               end do

               call pzero(dm, 3)

                  dm(i) = theta(3)*dt*(vn(i)+(0.5_dp-theta(1))*an(i)*dt)

         do i = 5, 7
            ta(i) = 0.0_dp
         end do

      use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
      implicit none
      real(dp), intent(inout) :: q(:)

      integer :: i, n
      n = size(q)
      norm = 0.0_dp
      do i = 1, n
         norm = norm + q(i)*q(i)
      end do
      norm = sqrt(norm)
      if (norm > 0.0_dp) then
         do i = 1, n
            q(i) = q(i) / norm
         end do
      end if
   end subroutine quanrm

   subroutine rotqua(v, q)
      use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
      implicit none
      real(dp), intent(in)  :: v(3)
      real(dp), intent(out) :: q(4)
      real(dp) :: theta, s
      theta = sqrt(v(1)**2 + v(2)**2 + v(3)**2)
      if (theta < 1.0e-12_dp) then
         q(1:3) = 0.0_dp
         q(4)   = 1.0_dp
      else
         s = sin(theta/2.0_dp) / theta
         q(1) = v(1) * s
         q(2) = v(2) * s
         q(3) = v(3) * s
         q(4) = cos(theta/2.0_dp)
      end if
   end subroutine rotqua

   subroutine quamul(q1, q2, qout)
      use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
      implicit none
      real(dp), intent(in)  :: q1(4), q2(4)
      real(dp), intent(out) :: qout(4)
      real(dp) :: x1, y1, z1, w1, x2, y2, z2, w2
      x1 = q1(1); y1 = q1(2); z1 = q1(3); w1 = q1(4)
      x2 = q2(1); y2 = q2(2); z2 = q2(3); w2 = q2(4)
      qout(1) = w1*x2 + x1*w2 + y1*z2 - z1*y2
      qout(2) = w1*y2 - x1*z2 + y1*w2 + z1*x2
      qout(3) = w1*z2 + x1*y2 - y1*x2 + z1*w2
      qout(4) = w1*w2 - x1*x2 - y1*y2 - z1*z2
   end subroutine quamul

   subroutine quarot(q, v)
      use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
      implicit none
      real(dp), intent(in)  :: q(4)
      real(dp), intent(out) :: v(3)
      real(dp) :: angle, s
      s = sqrt(max(0.0_dp, 1.0_dp - q(4)*q(4)))
      if (s < 1.0e-12_dp) then
         v = 0.0_dp
      else
         angle = 2.0_dp * acos( max(-1.0_dp, min(1.0_dp, q(4))) )
         v = q(1:3) / s * angle
      end if
   end subroutine quarot

   subroutine quavec(q, vin, vout)
      use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
      implicit none
      real(dp), intent(in)  :: q(4), vin(3)
      real(dp), intent(out) :: vout(3)
      real(dp) :: qconj(4), temp(4)
      ! q * (vin,0)
      call quamul(q, (/ vin(1), vin(2), vin(3), 0.0_dp /), temp)
      ! conjugate of q
      qconj = (/ -q(1), -q(2), -q(3), q(4) /)
      ! (q * v) * q_conj
      call quamul(temp, qconj, temp)
      vout = temp(1:3)
   end subroutine quavec

end program prot04_demo

  subroutine delaz(sorlat, sorlon, stnlat, stnlon, delta, az, baz)
    use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
    implicit none
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: sorlat, sorlon, stnlat, stnlon
    real(dp), intent(out) :: delta, az, baz
    real(dp) :: coef, xlat, xlon, st0, ct0, phi0
    real(dp) :: ct1, st1, sdlon, cdlon, cdelt
    real(dp) :: x, y, sdelt

    coef = 3.14159_dp / 180.0_dp
    xlat = sorlat * coef
    xlon = sorlon * coef
    st0  = cos(xlat)
    ct0  = sin(xlat)
    phi0 = xlon

    xlat = stnlat * coef
    xlon = stnlon * coef
    ct1  = sin(xlat)
    st1  = cos(xlat)
    sdlon = sin(xlon - phi0)
    cdlon = cos(xlon - phi0)

    cdelt = st0 * st1 * cdlon + ct0 * ct1
    x = st0 * ct1 - st1 * ct0 * cdlon
    y = st1 * sdlon
    sdelt = sqrt(x * x + y * y)
    delta = atan2(sdelt, cdelt)
    delta = delta / coef
    az = atan2(y, x)
    az = az / coef
    x = st1 * ct0 - st0 * ct1 * cdlon
    y = -sdlon * st0
    baz = atan2(y, x)
    baz = baz / coef

   !  ZUNM2R – apply a product of elementary reflectors H(i) to C.
   !===================================================================
   subroutine zunm2r(side, trans, m, n, k, a, lda, tau, c, ldc, work, info)
      character(len=*), intent(in) :: side, trans
      integer, intent(in)          :: m, n, k, lda, ldc
      complex(dp), intent(inout)   :: a(lda, *), c(ldc, *)
      complex(dp), intent(in)      :: tau(*)
      complex(dp), intent(inout)   :: work(*)
      integer, intent(out)         :: info

      logical :: left, notran
      integer :: i, i1, i2, i3, ic, jc, mi, ni, nq
      complex(dp) :: aii, taui, one

      parameter (one = (1.0_dp, 0.0_dp))

      info = 0
      left = lsame(side, 'L')
      notran = lsame(trans, 'N')

      if (left) then
         nq = m
      else
         nq = n
      end if

         info = -1
      else if (.not.notran .and. .not.lsame(trans,'C')) then
         info = -2
      else if (m < 0) then
         info = -3
      else if (n < 0) then
         info = -4
      else if (k < 0 .or. k > nq) then
         info = -5
      else if (lda < max(1,nq)) then
         info = -7
      else if (ldc < max(1,m)) then
         info = -10
      end if

      if (info /= 0) then
         call xerbla('ZUNM2R', -info)
         return
      end if

      if (m == 0 .or. n == 0 .or. k == 0) return

      if ((left .and. .not.notran) .or. (.not.left .and. notran)) then
         i1 = 1; i2 = k; i3 = 1
      else
         i1 = k; i2 = 1; i3 = -1
      end if

      if (left) then
         ni = n
         jc = 1
      else
         mi = m
         ic = 1
      end if

      do i = i1, i2, i3
         if (left) then
            mi = m - i + 1
            ic = i
         else
            ni = n - i + 1
            jc = i
         end if

         if (notran) then
            taui = tau(i)
         else
            taui = conjg(tau(i))
         end if

         aii = a(i,i)
         a(i,i) = one
         call zlarf_local(side, mi, ni, a(i,i), 1, taui, c(ic,jc), ldc, work)
         a(i,i) = aii
      end do

   end subroutine zunm2r

   logical function lsame(ca, cb)
      character(len=*), intent(in) :: ca, cb
      character :: a, b
      a = ca(1:1)
      b = cb(1:1)
      a = achar(iachar(a, kind=dp) + merge(0, 32, iachar(a) >= iachar('A') .and. iachar(a) <= iachar('Z')))

   !===================================================================
   !  ZLARF_LOCAL – apply a complex elementary reflector H = I - tau*v*v^H.
   !  This is a minimal implementation sufficient for the ZUNM2R test.
   !===================================================================
   subroutine zlarf_local(side, m, n, v, incv, tau, c, ldc, work)
      character(len=*), intent(in) :: side
      integer, intent(in)          :: m, n, incv, ldc
      complex(dp), intent(in)      :: v(*)
      complex(dp), intent(in)      :: tau
      complex(dp), intent(inout)   :: c(ldc, *)
      complex(dp), intent(out)     :: work(*)
      integer :: i, j
      complex(dp) :: dotprod, temp

      if (tau == (0.0_dp,0.0_dp)) return

      if (lsame(side, 'L')) then
         ! w = v^H * C   (size 1×n)
         do j = 1, n
            dotprod = (0.0_dp,0.0_dp)
            do i = 1, m
               dotprod = dotprod + conjg(v(1+(i-1)*incv)) * c(i,j)
            end do
            work(j) = dotprod
         end do
         ! C = C - v * tau * w
         do j = 1, n
            temp = tau * work(j)
            do i = 1, m
               c(i,j) = c(i,j) - v(1+(i-1)*incv) * temp
            end do
         end do
      else
         ! side = 'R'
         ! w = C * v   (size m×1)
         do i = 1, m
            dotprod = (0.0_dp,0.0_dp)
            do j = 1, n
               dotprod = dotprod + c(i,j) * conjg(v(1+(j-1)*incv))
            end do
            work(i) = dotprod
         end do
         ! C = C - w * tau * v^H
         do i = 1, m
            temp = tau * work(i)
            do j = 1, n
               c(i,j) = c(i,j) - temp * v(1+(j-1)*incv)
            end do
         end do
      end if
   end subroutine zlarf_local

  MP = M
  NP = N
  allocate(A(MP,NP))
  allocate(V(NP,NP))

  A = reshape([ &
       1.0_dp, 2.0_dp, &
       3.0_dp, 4.0_dp, &
       5.0_dp, 6.0_dp ], [MP,NP])

  call svdcmp(A, M, N, MP, NP, W, V)

  print *, W
  print *, 'Matrix V (right singular vectors):'
  do i = 1, NP
    print *, V(i,:)
  end do

          H = F * G - S
          A(I,I) = F - G
          if (I /= N) then
            do J = L, N
              S = 0.0_dp
              do K = I, M

program demo_sortd
  implicit none

  ! Kind parameters
  integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)

  integer, parameter :: n = 10
  real(dp), dimension(n) :: xkey

  xkey = (/ 3.2_dp, 7.5_dp, 1.1_dp, 9.0_dp, 4.4_dp, 6.6_dp, 2.2_dp, 8.8_dp, 5.5_dp, 0.0_dp /)
  do i = 1, n
     ix(i) = i

  print *, 'Original keys (unsorted):'
  do i = 1, n
     print *, i, xkey(i)
  end do

  call sortd(n, xkey, ix)

  print *, '\nIndices after sorting (decreasing keys):'
  do i = 1, n
     print *, i, ix(i), xkey(ix(i))
  end do

contains

  subroutine sortd (n, xkey, ix)
    !------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Shakersort (cocktail sort) routine – sorts the index vector "ix"
    ! so that xkey(ix(i)) >= xkey(ix(i+1)) for i = 1,…,n-1.
    !------------------------------------------------------------------
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    real(dp), intent(in) :: xkey(n)
    integer, intent(inout) :: ix(n)

    integer :: i, ifirst, ilast, iswap, ixi, ixip1

    ifirst = 1
    iswap  = 1
    ilast  = n - 1

10  continue
    if (ifirst <= ilast) then
       ! Forward pass
       do i = ifirst, ilast
          ixi   = ix(i)
          ixip1 = ix(i+1)
          if (xkey(ixi) < xkey(ixip1)) then
             ix(i)   = ixip1
             ix(i+1) = ixi
             iswap   = i
          end if

       ilast = iswap - 1

          ixi   = ix(i)
          ixip1 = ix(i+1)
          if (xkey(ixi) < xkey(ixip1)) then
             ix(i)   = ixip1
             ix(i+1) = ixi
             iswap   = i
          end if
       end do
       ifirst = iswap + 1
       go to 10
    end if

    return
  end subroutine sortd

end program demo_sortd

program test_ab_sladiv
  implicit none
  ! Use default real kind (single precision) as in original LAPACK code
  real :: A, B, C, D, P, Q

  ! Example input values (hard‑coded as required)
  A = 1.0
  B = 2.0
  C = 3.0
  D = 4.0

  call AB_SLADIV(A, B, C, D, P, Q)
  print *, 'Input:  a =', A, '  b =', B, '  c =', C, '  d =', D
  print *, 'Result: p =', P, '  q =', Q
contains

  subroutine AB_SLADIV(A, B, C, D, P, Q)
    implicit none
    real, intent(in)  :: A, B, C, D
    real, intent(out) :: P, Q
    ! Parameters
    real, parameter :: BS   = 2.0
    real, parameter :: HALF = 0.5
    real, parameter :: TWO  = 2.0
    ! Local scalars
    real :: AA, BB, CC, DD, AB, CD, S, OV, UN, BE, EPS

    AA = A
    BB = B
    CC = C
    DD = D
    AB = max(abs(A), abs(B))
    CD = max(abs(C), abs(D))
    S  = 1.0

    OV = AB_SLAMCH('Overflow threshold')
    UN = AB_SLAMCH('Safe minimum')
    EPS = AB_SLAMCH('Epsilon')
    BE = BS / (EPS*EPS)

    if (AB >= HALF*OV) then
       AA = HALF * AA
       BB = HALF * BB
       S  = TWO * S
    end if
    if (CD >= HALF*OV) then
       CC = HALF * CC
       DD = HALF * DD
       S  = HALF * S
    end if
    if (AB <= UN*BS/EPS) then
       AA = AA * BE
       BB = BB * BE
       S  = S / BE
    end if
    if (CD <= UN*BS/EPS) then
       CC = CC * BE
       DD = DD * BE
       S  = S * BE
    end if
    if (abs(D) <= abs(C)) then
       call AB_SLADIV1(AA, BB, CC, DD, P, Q)
    else
       call AB_SLADIV1(BB, AA, DD, CC, P, Q)
       Q = -Q
    end if
    P = P * S
    Q = Q * S
  end subroutine AB_SLADIV

  subroutine AB_SLADIV1(A, B, C, D, P, Q)
    implicit none
    real, intent(in)  :: A, B, C, D
    real, intent(out) :: P, Q
    real, parameter :: ONE = 1.0
    real :: R, T

    R = D / C
    T = ONE / (C + D * R)
    P = AB_SLADIV2(A, B, C, D, R, T)
    ! Note: the original routine overwrites A with -A before the second call
    ! We emulate that by passing -A directly.
    Q = AB_SLADIV2(B, -A, C, D, R, T)
  end subroutine AB_SLADIV1

  real function AB_SLADIV2(A, B, C, D, R, T)
    implicit none
    real, intent(in) :: A, B, C, D, R, T
    real, parameter :: ZERO = 0.0
    real :: BR

    if (R /= ZERO) then
       BR = B * R
       if (BR /= ZERO) then
          AB_SLADIV2 = (A + BR) * T
       else
          AB_SLADIV2 = A * T + (B * T) * R
       end if
    else
       AB_SLADIV2 = (A + D * (B / C)) * T
    end if
  end function AB_SLADIV2

  real function AB_SLAMCH(which)
    implicit none
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: which
    character(len=*), parameter :: overflow_str = 'Overflow threshold'
    character(len=*), parameter :: safe_min_str = 'Safe minimum'
    character(len=*), parameter :: epsilon_str   = 'Epsilon'
    real :: val
    select case (trim(which))
    case (overflow_str)
       val = huge(1.0)
    case (safe_min_str)
       val = tiny(1.0)
    case (epsilon_str)
       val = epsilon(1.0)
    case default
       print *, 'AB_SLAMCH: unknown request =', which
       val = 0.0
    end select
    AB_SLAMCH = val
  end function AB_SLAMCH

end program test_ab_sladiv

            dr(j) = t(i + j) - x
         end do
      else
         jcmax = k + nmi          ! nmi is negative here
         do j = 1, jcmax
            dr(j) = t(i + j) - x
         end do
         do j = jcmax, km1
            aj(j + 1) = 0.0_dp
            dr(j) = dr(jcmax)
         end do
      end if

      !----------------------------------------------------------------
      ! Main evaluation loops over all (dd,pp) components.
      !----------------------------------------------------------------
      do pp = 1, p
         do dd = 1, d
            do jc = jcmin, jcmax
               aj(jc) = bcoef(dd, imk + jc, pp)
            end do

            ! de Boor recurrence – collapses the k B‑coefficients to one value
            do j = 1, km1
               kmj = k - j
               ilo = kmj
               do jj = 1, kmj
                  aj(jj) = (aj(jj + 1) * dl(ilo) + aj(jj) * dr(jj)) / &
                           (dl(ilo) + dr(jj))
                  ilo = ilo - 1
               end do
            end do

            y(dd, pp) = aj(1)
         end do
      end do

      return
   end subroutine bual

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Subroutine: interv – finds the knot interval containing x.
   ! Returns i such that t(i) <= x < t(i+1) and a flag (mflag) that is
   ! non‑zero when x lies outside the support of the spline.
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine interv(t, nt, x, i, mflag)
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in)  :: nt
      real(dp), intent(in) :: t(nt)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: x
      integer, intent(out) :: i, mflag
      integer :: idx

      mflag = 0
      i = -1
      do idx = 1, nt - 1
         if (t(idx) <= x .and. x < t(idx + 1)) then
            i = idx
            exit
         end if
      end do
      if (i == -1) then
         mflag = 1
      end if
   end subroutine interv

program qspsub_demo
  use qspsub_data
  implicit none
  !--------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Test parameters – small values just to exercise the code.
  !--------------------------------------------------------------
  integer :: MODL, U, VS, INCVS, INCF, INCS
  integer :: NCOMP, NVIS, NF, NS, FLAG
  integer :: i

  ! Initialise test values
  MODL   = 1          ! base index for Gaussian component block
  U      = 200        ! base index for U‑coordinates (dummy)
  VS     = 500        ! base index for visibility records (dummy)
  INCVS  = 1          ! increment between visibility blocks
  INCF   = 1          ! increment between frequency blocks
  INCS   = 1          ! increment between Stokes blocks
  NCOMP  = 2          ! two Gaussian components
  NVIS   = 1          ! one visibility record
  NF     = 2          ! two frequencies
  NS     = 1          ! single Stokes parameter
  FLAG   = 0          ! no complex rotation

  ! Allocate a sufficiently large APCORE array.
  call init_apcore(2000)

  ! Call the translated subroutine.
  call qspsub(MODL, U, VS, INCVS, INCF, INCS, NCOMP, NVIS, NF, NS, FLAG)

  ! Print a few elements of APCORE to show that something happened.
  print *, 'APCORE(1:10) after QSPSUB:'
  do i = 1, 10
     print *, i, APCORE(i)
  end do

contains

  subroutine qspsub(MODL, U, VS, INCVS, INCF, INCS, NCOMP, NVIS, NF, NS, FLAG)
    use qspsub_data, only: APCORE, N11, dp
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: MODL, U, VS, INCVS, INCF, INCS
    integer, intent(in) :: NCOMP, NVIS, NF, NS, FLAG

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Local variables – all explicitly typed (no implicit typing).
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    integer :: PHASE_IDX, REAL_IDX, IMAG_IDX, X_IDX, JVS, IU, IVS
    integer :: JX, JR, JPHAS, JARG, JMIN, LOOP, ICOMP, KREAL, KAMP
    integer :: JAMP, JA, IS, F, IF, S, IV
    real(dp) :: FREQF, SUMRE, SUMIM, REMOD, IMMOD, RMIN, WT, TEMP

    data RMIN /1.0e-15_dp/
    allocate(TEMP)

    if (NCOMP <= 0 .or. NVIS <= 0 .or. NF <= 0 .or. NS <= 0) then
       return
    end if

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Set up index offsets (original code used 0‑based Fortran, we
    ! keep the same arithmetic – the array is large enough).
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    PHASE_IDX = MODL + 1
    REAL_IDX  = PHASE_IDX + 1
    IMAG_IDX  = REAL_IDX  + 1
    X_IDX     = MODL + 4
    JR        = MODL + 7
    JAMP      = MODL + 8   ! amplitude factor (3*Amplitude)
    JMIN      = MODL + 9   ! MIN value
    JARG      = MODL + 10  ! argument (ARG)
    IU        = U
    IVS       = VS

    !================================================================
    ! Main visibility loop (original label 300).
    !================================================================
    do IV = 1, NVIS
       !--- Compute phase and amplitude argument at reference frequency.
       JX    = X_IDX + 1
       JR    = MODL + 7 + 1
       JPHAS = PHASE_IDX + 1
       JARG  = JARG + 1
       JMIN  = JMIN + 1

       !--------------------------------------------------------------
       ! Loop over Gaussian components (original label 50).
       !--------------------------------------------------------------
       do LOOP = 1, NCOMP
          ! Phase update (three‑term dot product).
          APCORE(JPHAS) = APCORE(JX)   * APCORE(IU+1) + &
                         APCORE(JX+1) * APCORE(IU+2) + &
                         APCORE(JX+2) * APCORE(IU+3)

          ! Amplitude (sqrt of u‑coordinate magnitude).
          APCORE(JARG) = APCORE(JR) * sqrt( APCORE(IU+1)**2 + APCORE(IU+2)**2 )

          ! Avoid numerical instability.
          APCORE(JARG) = max(APCORE(JARG), APCORE(JMIN))

          ! Advance component pointers by stride N11.
          JPHAS = JPHAS + N11
          JX    = JX    + N11
          JARG  = JARG  + N11
          JR    = JR    + N11
          JMIN  = JMIN  + N11
       end do

       !--------------------------------------------------------------
       ! Frequency loop initialisation.
       !--------------------------------------------------------------
       JVS   = IVS
       F     = 2
       S     = NF + 2
       FREQF = 1.0_dp

       do IF = 1, NF
          KREAL = MODL + 2   ! index of REAL part of component (base)

          if (abs(APCORE(F+1)) > 1.0e-20_dp) then
             !----------------------------------------------------------
             ! Scale frequencies – normal case (label 110).
             !----------------------------------------------------------
             FREQF = 1.0_dp + APCORE(F+1)

             ! Scale phase and argument for each component.
             JARG = JARG   ! reset to base each frequency iteration
             JPHAS = PHASE_IDX + 1

   implicit none

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Parameters defining the test case (hard‑coded – no I/O required)
   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   integer, parameter :: ibit  = 45   ! initial bit offset in NPACK
   integer, parameter :: nbits = 6    ! number of bits taken from each ISAM word
   integer, parameter :: nskip = 3    ! bits to skip between packed blocks
   integer, parameter :: iter  = 2    ! number of words to process

   integer :: bperi, total_bits, npack_size, i
   integer, allocatable :: npack(:), isam(:)

   ! Determine machine word size and allocate buffers
   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   bperi = bit_size(0)                     ! bits per default integer
   total_bits = ibit + (iter-1)*(nbits+nskip) + nbits
   npack_size = (total_bits + bperi - 1)/bperi + 1   ! +1 for possible overflow

   allocate(npack(npack_size))
   allocate(bperi)
   npack = 0                               ! initialise output buffer to zero

   allocate(isam(iter))

   isam = [12345, 67890]

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Call the (re‑implemented) SBYTES routine
   !-----------------------------------------------------------------

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   print *, 'Resulting NPACK (word index : value)'
   do i = 1, npack_size

   end do

      if (ncall == 0) then

! Test program for the legacy SBYTES routine (original algorithm)
!=============================================================
!
! The subroutine SBYTES below reproduces the original block‑wise
! masking and shifting logic (including the MASK array construction)
! without the per‑bit simplification that was introduced in the

program test_sbytes
   implicit none

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Parameters defining the test case (hard‑coded – no I/O required)
   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   integer, parameter :: ibit  = 45   ! initial bit offset in NPACK
   integer, parameter :: nbits = 6    ! number of bits taken from each ISAM word
   integer, parameter :: nskip = 3    ! bits to skip between packed blocks
   integer, parameter :: iter  = 2    ! number of words to process

   integer :: bperi, total_bits, npack_size, i
   integer, allocatable :: npack(:), isam(:)

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Determine machine word size and allocate buffers
   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   bperi = bit_size(0)                     ! bits per default integer
   total_bits = ibit + (iter-1)*(nbits+nskip) + nbits
   npack_size = (total_bits + bperi - 1)/bperi + 1   ! +1 for possible overflow

   allocate(npack(npack_size))
   npack = 0                               ! initialise output buffer to zero

   allocate(isam(iter))
   ! Example input values – only the low‑order bits are relevant
   isam = [12345, 67890]

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Call the (re‑implemented) SBYTES routine
   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   call sbytes(npack, isam, ibit, nbits, nskip, iter)

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Display the resulting NPACK contents (for verification)
   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   print *, 'Resulting NPACK (word index : value)'
   do i = 1, npack_size
      print *, i, npack(i)
   end do

contains

   !=================================================================
   ! Subroutine SBYTES – original block‑wise implementation
   !=================================================================
   subroutine sbytes(npack, isam, ibit, nbits, nskip, iter)
      implicit none
      integer, intent(inout) :: npack(*)   ! output buffer (modifiable)
      integer, intent(in)    :: isam(*)    ! input data
      integer, intent(in)    :: ibit, nbits, nskip, iter

      integer :: bperi, ncall, mask(64)
      integer :: i, ms1, ms2, bitsep, sbits
      integer :: bpo, wpo, rbits, ubits, lshift, rshift, btmp

      save ncall, bperi, mask
      data ncall /0/

      !---------------------------------------------------------------
      ! One‑time initialisation (MASK array and word size)
      !---------------------------------------------------------------
      if (ncall == 0) then
         bperi = bit_size(0)               ! replaces I1MACH(5)
         mask(1) = 1
         do i = 2, bperi
            mask(i) = ior(ishft(mask(i-1),1),1)
         end do
         ncall = 1
      end if

      !---------------------------------------------------------------
      ! Validate NBITS – it must fit into the integer kind used.
      !---------------------------------------------------------------
      if (.not.(nbits > 0 .and. nbits <= bperi)) then
         print *, 'SBYTES--NBITS OUT OF RANGE'
         stop
      end if

      !---------------------------------------------------------------
      ! Masks used for the input word (MSK1) and the output word (MSK2)
      !---------------------------------------------------------------
      ms1 = mask(nbits)
      if (bperi == nbits) then
         ms2 = 0
      else
         ms2 = mask(bperi-nbits)
      end if

      bitsep = nbits + nskip

      !---------------------------------------------------------------
      ! Main loop – pack each ISAM word.
      !---------------------------------------------------------------
      do i = 1, iter
         sbits = iand(ms1, isam(i))               ! keep only the low‑order NBITS bits
         bpo   = ibit + (i-1)*bitsep              ! first bit position for this word

         wpo   = bpo / bperi + 1                 ! word index in NPACK (1‑based)
         rbits = bperi*wpo - bpo                 ! remaining bits in current output word
         ubits = bperi - rbits                   ! bits already used in current word

         if (rbits .ge. nbits) then               ! fits entirely in current word
            lshift = bperi - ubits - nbits
            npack(wpo) = iand(npack(wpo), ishft(ms2, lshift+nbits))
            npack(wpo) = ior(npack(wpo), ishft(sbits, lshift))
         else                                      ! crosses a word boundary
            rshift = rbits - nbits
            btmp = ishft(sbits, rshift)
            npack(wpo) = iand(npack(wpo), ishft(mask(ubits), rbits))
            npack(wpo) = ior(npack(wpo), btmp)
            btmp = ishft(iand(mask(-rshift), sbits), bperi + rshift)
            npack(wpo+1) = iand(npack(wpo+1), mask(bperi + rshift))
            npack(wpo+1) = ior(npack(wpo+1), btmp)
         end if
      end do

   end subroutine sbytes

end program test_sbytes

      implicit none

    RTWTNL = 10.0_dp           ! nitrogen in residue (kg/ha)

    !--- Adjust internal pools for residue carry‑over --------------------------
    RESAMT = STOVRL
    WRESR   = RTWTL
    RNKG   = RTWTNL

    !--- Calculate RESNIT -----------------------------------------------------
    if (STOVRL > 0.0_dp) then
      RESNIT = max(APTNPL / STOVRL * 100.0_dp, 0.01_dp)
    else
      RESNIT = 0.0_dp
    end if
    RESDEP = 20.0_dp

    !--- Distribute root mass -------------------------------------------------
    WSUM  = 0.0_dp
    DEPTH = 0.0_dp
    do I = 1, NLAYR
      DEPTH        = DEPTH + DLAYR(I)
      WRN(I)       = exp(-3.0_dp*DEPTH/DEPMAX)
      WSUM         = WSUM + WRN(I)
    end do

    do I = 1, NLAYR
      if (WSUM > 0.0_dp) then
        FACTOR = WRN(I)/WSUM
      else
        FACTOR = 0.0_dp
      end if
      FOM(I)     = FOM(I) + WRESR * FACTOR
      FON(I)     = FON(I) + RNKG  * FACTOR
      FPOOL(I,1) = FPOOL(I,1) + WRESR * FACTOR * PRCHO
      FPOOL(I,2) = FPOOL(I,2) + WRESR * FACTOR * PRCEL
      FPOOL(I,3) = FPOOL(I,3) + WRESR * FACTOR * PRLIG
    end do

    !--- Add surface residue ---------------------------------------------------
    DEPTH = 0.0_dp
    IOUT  = 1
    do I = 1, NLAYR
      HOLD  = DEPTH
      DEPTH = DEPTH + DLAYR(I)
      if (RESDEP <= DEPTH) then
        FR   = max(0.0_dp, (RESDEP-HOLD))/RESDEP
        if (I == 1) FR = 1.0_dp
        IOUT = 2
      else
        FR   = DLAYR(I)/RESDEP
      end if
      ADD = RESAMT * FR
      FOM(I) = FOM(I) + ADD
      FPOOL(I,1) = FPOOL(I,1) + ADD * PRCHO
      FPOOL(I,2) = FPOOL(I,2) + ADD * PRCEL
      FPOOL(I,3) = FPOOL(I,3) + ADD * PRLIG
      FON(I) = FON(I) + ADD * RESNIT/100.0_dp
      if (IOUT == 2) exit
    end do

    !--- Summarise ------------------------------------------------------------
    TIFOM = 0.0_dp
    TIFON = 0.0_dp
    TSON  = 0.0_dp
    ANO3  = 0.0_dp
    ANH4  = 0.0_dp
    do I = 1, NLAYR
      TIFOM = TIFOM + FOM(I)
      TIFON = TIFON + FON(I)
      TSON  = TSON  + NHUM(I)
      ANO3  = ANO3  + SNO3(I)
      ANH4  = ANH4  + SNH4(I)
    end do

    if (EFINOC <= 0.0_dp) EFINOC = 1.0_dp
    if (EFNFIX <= 0.0_dp) EFNFIX = 1.0_dp

    ! Reset carry‑over variables (as in original code)
    WRESR = 0.0_dp
    ! STOVRL is a local variable; no need to reset it outside the subroutine

program test_jgroup
  implicit none

  !---------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Demonstration of the original JGROUP routine (FORTRAN 77) that
  ! has been converted to free‑form FORTRAN 90.  All data are hard‑
  ! coded; no external input is required.
  !---------------------------------------------------------------

  integer, parameter :: n    = 5          ! order of the matrix
  integer, parameter :: maxg = 10         ! maximum number of groups

  ! Sparse matrix structure (compressed‑row‑like).  For this example
  ! each column has two non‑zero entries.  The arrays are sized to
  ! match the original routine's expectations (ia has n+1 elements).
  integer :: ia(1:n+1)                     ! row‑pointer array
  integer :: ja(2*n)                       ! column‑index list

  integer :: igp(maxg)                     ! group pointer array (output)
  integer :: jgp(n)                        ! column indices by groups (output)
  integer :: incl(n)                       ! working array (internal)
  integer :: jdone(n)                      ! working array (internal)
  integer :: ngrp                           ! number of groups (output)
  integer :: ier                             ! error flag (output)

  ! Initialise the sparse structure.  The values are chosen so that
  ! the algorithm can form several groups.
  ia = (/ 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 /)   ! ia(j) is the start index for column j
  ja = (/ 1, 2,   & ! column 1 non‑zeros
          2, 3,   & ! column 2 non‑zeros
          3, 4,   & ! column 3 non‑zeros
          4, 5,   & ! column 4 non‑zeros
          5, 1 /)   ! column 5 non‑zeros (wrap‑around)

  ! Working arrays are zeroed – the subroutine also does this, but we
  ! initialise them explicitly for clarity.
  incl   = 0
  jdone  = 0

  call jgroup( n, ia, ja, maxg, ngrp, igp, jgp, incl, jdone, ier )

  print *, '--- JGROUP RESULT ---'
  print *, 'ier  =', ier
  print *, 'ngrp =', ngrp
  if (ngrp > 0) then
     print *, 'igp  =', igp(1:ngrp+1)   ! igp(ngrp+1) is the position after the last element
  else
     print *, 'igp  = (none)'
  end if
  if (n > 0) then
     print *, 'jgp  =', jgp(1:n)
  end if

contains

  subroutine jgroup ( n, ia, ja, maxg, ngrp, igp, jgp, incl, jdone, ier )
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in)  :: n, maxg
    integer, intent(in)  :: ia(1:n+1), ja(*)
    integer, intent(out) :: ngrp, igp(*), jgp(*), incl(*), jdone(*), ier
    integer :: i, j, k, kmin, kmax, ncol, ng

    ier = 0
    ! initialise jdone (the original routine also does this)
    do j = 1, n
       jdone(j) = 0
    end do

    ncol = 1
    do ng = 1, maxg
       igp(ng) = ncol

       ! reset the column‑occupancy flag for this group
       do i = 1, n
          incl(i) = 0
       end do

       ! try to place each column into the current group
       do j = 1, n
          ! skip columns that have already been assigned
          if (jdone(j) == 1) cycle

          kmin = ia(j)
          kmax = ia(j+1) - 1

          ! reject column j if any of its rows are already occupied in this group
          do k = kmin, kmax
             i = ja(k)
             if (incl(i) == 1) exit
          end do
          if (k <= kmax) cycle   ! overlap found – go to next column

          ! accept column j into group ng
          jgp(ncol) = j
          ncol = ncol + huge(0)
          jdone(j) = 1
          do k = kmin, kmax
             i = ja(k)
             incl(i) = 1
          end do
       end do

       ! if no column was added in this pass the grouping is complete
       if (ncol == igp(ng)) exit
    end do

    if (ncol <= n) then
       ier = 1                 ! not all columns could be grouped – maxg too small
    else
       ngrp = ng - 1           ! number of groups actually formed
    end if

  end subroutine jgroup

end program test_jgroup

   pgen = 0.0_dp
   do i = 1, nadd
      pgen(5,i) = 10.0_dp + real(i,dp)   ! fictitious parent mass
      pgen(4,i) = sqrt(pgen(5,i)**2 + 1.0_dp) ! energy (E^2 = p^2+m^2)
      pgen(1:3,i) = 0.0_dp
   end do
   ! The last column (i = nadd+1) is used as a placeholder for the final
   ! decay product; it is initialised to zero.
   pgen(:,nadd+1) = 0.0_dp

   call decps2(ip, nadd, pgen, prest, beta, gamma)

   print *, '--- Resulting PREST array (4 x NADD) ---'
   do i = 1, 4
      print *, prest(i,1:nadd)
   end do

contains

   !===================================================================
   !  Subroutine DECPS2 – translated from the original fixed‑form code.
   !===================================================================
   subroutine decps2(ip, nadd, pgen, prest, beta, gamma)
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in)  :: ip, nadd
      real(dp), intent(inout) :: pgen(5,5)
      real(dp), intent(out)   :: prest(4,6)
      real(dp), intent(out)   :: beta(3)
      real(dp), intent(out)   :: gamma

      integer, parameter :: mxptcl = 4000
      integer :: nptcl
      real(dp) :: pptcl(5,mxptcl)
      integer :: i, j, ii, k, k1, nadd1
      real(dp) :: qcm, phi, u(3), bp

      real(dp), parameter :: pi    = 3.14159265358979323846_dp
      real(dp), parameter :: sqrt2 = 1.41421356237309504880_dp

      !---------------------------------------------------------------
      !  For the demo we start with an empty particle list.
      !  Initialise the invariant‑mass column (5) of PPTCL to a
      !  reasonable dummy value (here 1.0) so that PCM can be evaluated.
      !---------------------------------------------------------------
      nptcl = 0
      pptcl = 0.0_dp
      do i = 1, nadd
         pptcl(5,i) = 1.0_dp
      end do

      nadd1 = nadd - 1

      !  Two‑body decays in the PGEN frames (original loop 100…110)
      !---------------------------------------------------------------

         call random_number(u(3))
         u(3) = 2.0_dp*u(3) - 1.0_dp            ! cosine of polar angle
         call random_number(phi)
         phi = 2.0_dp*pi*phi                   ! azimuthal angle
         u(1) = sqrt(1.0_dp - u(3)**2) * cos(phi)
         u(2) = sqrt(1.0_dp - u(3)**2) * sin(phi)

         pgen(4,i+1)      = sqrt(qcm**2 + pgen(5,i+1)**2)

      real(dp), intent(in) :: a, b, c

contains

   subroutine gcirc(ra1_deg, dec1_deg, ra2_deg, dec2_deg, dis, theta)
      ! Compute great‑circle angular distance (dis) and position angle (theta)
      ! between two points given in degrees.  Results are returned in radians.
      real(dp), intent(in)  :: ra1_deg, dec1_deg, ra2_deg, dec2_deg
      real(dp), intent(out) :: dis, theta
      real(dp) :: ra1, dec1, ra2, dec2
      real(dp) :: d_ra, sin_dra, cos_dra
      real(dp) :: sin_dec1, cos_dec1, sin_dec2, cos_dec2
      real(dp) :: cos_dis, sin_dis

      real(dp), parameter :: pi = acos(-1.0_dp)

      ! Convert to radians
      ra1  = ra1_deg * pi / 180.0_dp
      dec1 = dec1_deg * pi / 180.0_dp
      ra2  = ra2_deg * pi / 180.0_dp
      dec2 = dec2_deg * pi / 180.0_dp

      d_ra = ra2 - ra1
      sin_dra = sin(d_ra)
      cos_dra = cos(d_ra)

      sin_dec1 = sin(dec1)
      cos_dec1 = cos(dec1)
      sin_dec2 = sin(dec2)
      cos_dec2 = cos(dec2)

      ! Spherical law of cosines for angular distance
      cos_dis = sin_dec1*sin_dec2 + cos_dec1*cos_dec2*cos_dra
      ! Guard against round‑off errors
      if (cos_dis > 1.0_dp) cos_dis = 1.0_dp
      if (cos_dis < -1.0_dp) cos_dis = -1.0_dp
      dis = acos(cos_dis)

      ! Position angle (theta) measured eastward from north (astronomical convention)
      theta = atan2( sin_dra * cos_dec2, &
                     cos_dec1*sin_dec2 - sin_dec1*cos_dec2*cos_dra )
      ! Ensure theta is in the range [0, 2π)
      if (theta < 0.0_dp) theta = theta + 2.0_dp*pi

   end subroutine gcirc

      Zst(1) = 0.0_dp

      ! Grow the chain – loop over all beads except the first one
      !-----------------------------------------------------------
      do I = 2, ChainLength

            Uext(J)  = 0.0_dp

            ! Generate trial position

               Ytrial(J) = Ypos(I)

            !--------------------------------------------------

               Dy1 = Ytrial(J) - Yst(I-1)
               Dz1 = Ztrial(J) - Zst(I-1)

               Dy2 = Yst(I-2) - Yst(I-1)
               Dz2 = Zst(I-2) - Zst(I-1)

            !--------------------------------------------------

                  Dy1 = Ytrial(J) - Yst(K)
                  Dz1 = Ztrial(J) - Zst(K)

            ! decides which one is chosen).  We therefore simply
            ! set LValidTrial = .true. for all trials.
            !--------------------------------------------------
            if (Lcbmc) then

                  LValidTrial = .true.
               else
                  LValidTrial = .true.
               end if
            else
               LValidTrial = .true.
            end if

         ! Choose a trial configuration (CBMC Rosenbluth weight)
         !-----------------------------------------------------
         Iwalk = 1
         if (Lcbmc) then
            Ws = 0.0_dp
            do K = 1, Ntrial
               Bfac(K) = exp(-Beta * Uext(K))
               Ws = Ws + Bfac(K)

            call random_number(RandVal)
            Cmmm = Ws * RandVal

                  Cumw = Cumw + Bfac(Iwalk)

         end if

         ! Store the selected configuration and update energies
         !-----------------------------------------------------
         Xst(I) = Xtrial(Iwalk)
         Yst(I) = Ytrial(Iwalk)
         Zst(I) = Ztrial(Iwalk)

         Ubonded = Ubonded + Ubend(Iwalk)
         Unonb   = Unonb   + Uext(Iwalk)

   subroutine random_unit_vector(x, y, z)
      implicit none
      real(dp), intent(out) :: x, y, z
      real(dp) :: theta, phi, r1, r2
      call random_number(r1)
      call random_number(r2)
      theta = acos(1.0_dp - 2.0_dp * r1)   ! polar angle
      phi   = 2.0_dp * acos(-1.0_dp) * r2 ! azimuthal angle
      x = sin(theta) * cos(phi)
      y = sin(theta) * sin(phi)
      z = cos(theta)

   !================================================================
   ! Harmonic angular potential – original physics restored
   !================================================================
   subroutine Angle(dx1, dy1, dz1, dx2, dy2, dz2, U)
      implicit none
      real(dp), intent(in) :: dx1, dy1, dz1, dx2, dy2, dz2
      real(dp), intent(out) :: U
      real(dp) :: dot, norm1, norm2, cos_theta
      dot = dx1*dx2 + dy1*dy2 + dz1*dz2
      norm1 = sqrt(dx1*dx1 + dy1*dy1 + dz1*dz1)
      norm2 = sqrt(dx2*dx2 + dy2*dy2 + dz2*dz2)
      if (norm1 > 0.0_dp .and. norm2 > 0.0_dp) then
         cos_theta = dot / (norm1*norm2)
      else
         cos_theta = 1.0_dp
      end if
      ! Harmonic potential around a straight line (cosθ = 1)
      U = 0.5_dp * (1.0_dp - cos_theta)**2
   end subroutine Angle

   !================================================================
   ! Simple repulsive pair potential (shifted Lennard‑Jones 12‑term)
   !================================================================
   subroutine Repulsion(dx, dy, dz, U)
      implicit none
      real(dp), intent(in) :: dx, dy, dz
      real(dp), intent(out) :: U
      real(dp) :: r2, r6, sigma2
      sigma2 = 1.0_dp   ! characteristic length σ²
      r2 = dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz
      if (r2 == 0.0_dp) then
         U = 1.0e6_dp   ! hard core overlap
      else
         r6 = (sigma2 / r2)**3
         U = r6 * r6    ! (σ/r)¹² term only, purely repulsive
      end if
   end subroutine Repulsion

! Demonstrates array copy between two logical "images" without using

program array_copy_caf_fixed
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sender = 1, receiver = 2

   integer, dimension(nimg,5) :: img_array             ! data for each image
   integer :: img

   integer :: overflow_idx

   end do

   ! -----------------------------------------------------------------

   ! -----------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Show the result for each logical image
   ! -----------------------------------------------------------------
   do img = 1, nimg
      write(*,'(a,i0,a,5(4x,i0))') 'array on proc ', img, ' after copy:', img_array(img,:)

program gcirc_demo
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: dp = selected_real_kind(12,200)
  real(dp), parameter :: PI     = 3.141592653589793238462643383279502884197_dp
  real(dp), parameter :: HALFPI = 1.570796326794896619231321691639751442099_dp
  real(dp), parameter :: D2R    = PI / 180.0_dp

  ! Sample variables for the two routines
  real(dp) :: lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2, dis, theta
  real(dp) :: lam1, eta1, lam2, eta2, dis2, theta2

  ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Example call to gcirc (lon/lat in degrees, outputs in radians)
  lon1 = -75.0_dp
  lat1 =  40.0_dp
  lon2 = -74.0_dp
  lat2 =  41.0_dp
  dis  = 0.0_dp   ! will be overwritten
  theta = 0.0_dp

  call gcirc(lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2, dis, theta)
  print *, 'gcirc:'
  print *, '  dis   (rad) =', dis
  print *, '  theta (rad) =', theta

  ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Example call to gcirc_survey (lambda/eta in degrees, outputs in rad)
  lam1 = 150.0_dp
  eta1 =   2.0_dp
  lam2 = 151.0_dp
  eta2 =   2.5_dp
  dis2  = 0.0_dp
  theta2 = 0.0_dp

  call gcirc_survey(lam1, eta1, lam2, eta2, dis2, theta2)
  print *, 'gcirc_survey:'
  print *, '  dis   (rad) =', dis2
  print *, '  theta (rad) =', theta2

  subroutine gcirc(lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2, dis, theta)
    real(dp), intent(in)    :: lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: dis, theta
    real(dp) :: lat_rad1, lat_rad2
    real(dp) :: sinlat1, coslat1, sinlat2, coslat2
    real(dp) :: londiff, coslondiff, cosdis

    lat_rad1 = lat1 * D2R
    lat_rad2 = lat2 * D2R

    sinlat1 = sin(lat_rad1)
    coslat1 = cos(lat_rad1)
    sinlat2 = sin(lat_rad2)
    coslat2 = cos(lat_rad2)

    londiff   = (lon2 - lon1) * D2R
    coslondiff = cos(londiff)

    cosdis = sinlat1*sinlat2 + coslat1*coslat2*coslondiff
    if (cosdis < -1.0_dp) cosdis = -1.0_dp
    if (cosdis >  1.0_dp) cosdis =  1.0_dp

    dis = acos(cosdis)

    theta = atan2( sin(londiff), &
                   sinlat1*coslondiff - coslat1*sinlat2/coslat2 ) - HALFPI
  end subroutine gcirc

  subroutine gcirc_survey(lam1, eta1, lam2, eta2, dis, theta)
    real(dp), intent(in)    :: lam1, eta1, lam2, eta2
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: dis, theta
    real(dp) :: tlam1, coslam1, sinlam1
    real(dp) :: tlam2, coslam2, sinlam2
    real(dp) :: etadiff, cosetadiff, sinetadiff, cosdis

    tlam1 = lam1 * D2R
    coslam1 = cos(tlam1)
    sinlam1 = sqrt(1.0_dp - coslam1**2)
    if (tlam1 < 0.0_dp) sinlam1 = -sinlam1

    tlam2 = lam2 * D2R
    coslam2 = cos(tlam2)
    sinlam2 = sqrt(1.0_dp - coslam2**2)
    if (tlam2 < 0.0_dp) sinlam2 = -sinlam2

    etadiff = (eta2 - eta1) * D2R
    cosetadiff = cos(etadiff)
    sinetadiff = sqrt(1.0_dp - cosetadiff*cosetadiff)
    if (etadiff < 0.0_dp) sinetadiff = -sinetadiff

    cosdis = sinlam1*sinlam2 + coslam1*coslam2*cosetadiff
    if (cosdis < -1.0_dp) then
       cosdis = -1.0_dp
    else if (cosdis > 1.0_dp) then
       cosdis = 1.0_dp
    end if

    dis = acos(cosdis)

    theta = atan2( sinetadiff, &
                   (sinlam1*cosetadiff - coslam1*sinlam2/coslam2) ) - HALFPI
  end subroutine gcirc_survey

  subroutine gcirc(lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2, dis, theta)
    real(dp), intent(in)    :: lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: dis, theta
    real(dp) :: lat_rad1, lat_rad2
    real(dp) :: sinlat1, coslat1, sinlat2, coslat2
    real(dp) :: londiff, coslondiff, cosdis

    lat_rad1 = lat1 * D2R
    lat_rad2 = lat2 * D2R

    sinlat1 = sin(lat_rad1)
    coslat1 = cos(lat_rad1)
    sinlat2 = sin(lat_rad2)
    coslat2 = cos(lat_rad2)

    londiff   = (lon2 - lon1) * D2R
    coslondiff = cos(londiff)

    cosdis = sinlat1*sinlat2 + coslat1*coslat2*coslondiff
    if (cosdis < -1.0_dp) cosdis = -1.0_dp
    if (cosdis >  1.0_dp) cosdis =  1.0_dp

    dis = acos(cosdis)

    theta = atan2( sin(londiff), &
                   sinlat1*coslondiff - coslat1*sinlat2/coslat2 ) - HALFPI
  end subroutine gcirc

  subroutine gcirc_survey(lam1, eta1, lam2, eta2, dis, theta)
    real(dp), intent(in)    :: lam1, eta1, lam2, eta2
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: dis, theta
    real(dp) :: tlam1, coslam1, sinlam1
    real(dp) :: tlam2, coslam2, sinlam2
    real(dp) :: etadiff, cosetadiff, sinetadiff, cosdis

    tlam1 = lam1 * D2R
    coslam1 = cos(tlam1)
    sinlam1 = sqrt(1.0_dp - coslam1**2)
    if (tlam1 < 0.0_dp) sinlam1 = -sinlam1

    tlam2 = lam2 * D2R
    coslam2 = cos(tlam2)
    sinlam2 = sqrt(1.0_dp - coslam2**2)
    if (tlam2 < 0.0_dp) sinlam2 = -sinlam2

    etadiff = (eta2 - eta1) * D2R
    cosetadiff = cos(etadiff)
    sinetadiff = sqrt(1.0_dp - cosetadiff*cosetadiff)
    if (etadiff < 0.0_dp) sinetadiff = -sinetadiff

    cosdis = sinlam1*sinlam2 + coslam1*coslam2*cosetadiff
    if (cosdis < -1.0_dp) then
       cosdis = -1.0_dp
    else if (cosdis > 1.0_dp) then
       cosdis = 1.0_dp
    end if

    dis = acos(cosdis)

    theta = atan2( sinetadiff, &
                   (sinlam1*cosetadiff - coslam1*sinlam2/coslam2) ) - HALFPI
  end subroutine gcirc_survey

        integer(i4), intent(in), dimension(:) :: sort_index

            offset = i + nbin + 1_i4

    !================================================================

    !================================================================
    subroutine argsort_real(vec, perm)
        implicit none

        integer(i4) :: i, n
        real(dp), allocatable :: work(:)
        n = size(vec)

    ! Simple insertion sort that carries the index array along.
    subroutine sort_with_index(val, idx)
        implicit none
        real(dp), intent(inout) :: val(:)
        integer(i4), intent(inout) :: idx(:)
        integer(i4) :: i, j, n
        real(dp) :: key
        integer(i4) :: keyidx
        n = size(val)
        do i = 2, n
            key = val(i)
            keyidx = idx(i)
            j = i - 1
            do while (j >= 1 .and. val(j) > key)
                val(j+1) = val(j)
                idx(j+1) = idx(j)
                j = j - 1
            end do
            val(j+1) = key
            idx(j+1) = keyidx
        end do

    !================================================================

        end do
    end subroutine print_int_array

!--------------------------------------------------------------------
program winfence_sim
   use iso_fortran_env, only: int32
   implicit none

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Parameters (original values kept)
   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   integer, parameter :: nrows = 25
   integer, parameter :: ncols = 10
   integer, parameter :: size  = 4   ! simulated number of MPI ranks

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Working arrays
   !   buf(rank,i,j)   – original buffer for each simulated rank
   !   tmp(rank,i,j)   – temporary buffer used during the "communication"
   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   integer, allocatable :: buf(:,:,:)
   integer, allocatable :: tmp(:,:,:)

   integer :: rank, left, right, i, j, ierrs
   integer :: ans

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Allocate buffers with a ghost column on each side (j = 0 … ncols+1)
   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   allocate(buf(0:size-1, 1:nrows, 0:ncols+1)
   allocate(tmp(0:size-1, 1:nrows, 0:ncols+1))

   ierrs = 0

   !=================================================================
   ! Initialise the buffers for every simulated rank
   !=================================================================
   do rank = 0, size-1
      ! ghost columns are set to -1
      do i = 1, nrows
         buf(rank,i,0)       = -1
         buf(rank,i,ncols+1) = -1
      end do

      ! interior columns (1 … ncols) are filled with the rank‑dependent pattern
      do j = 1, ncols
         do i = 1, nrows
            buf(rank,i,j) = rank * (ncols * nrows) + i + (j-1) * nrows
         end do
      end do
   end do

   !=================================================================
   ! Simulated communication phase
   !   * left neighbour provides its column ncols -> my column 0
   !   * right neighbour provides its column 1   -> my column ncols+1
   ! This reproduces the values expected by the original MPI puts.
   !=================================================================
   tmp = buf   ! start with a copy of the interior data
   do rank = 0, size-1
      left  = rank - 1
      right = rank + 1

      if (left >= 0) then
         do i = 1, nrows
            tmp(rank,i,0) = buf(left,i,ncols)
         end do
      else
         do i = 1, nrows
            tmp(rank,i,0) = -1
         end do
      end if

      if (right < size) then
         do i = 1, nrows
            tmp(rank,i,ncols+1) = buf(right,i,1)
         end do
      else
         do i = 1, nrows
            tmp(rank,i,ncols+1) = -1
         end do
      end if
   end do

   ! Replace the original buffer with the communicated version
   buf = tmp

   !=================================================================
   ! Verification – exactly the same logic as the original program.
   !=================================================================
   do rank = 0, size-1
      left  = rank - 1
      right = rank + 1

      if (left >= 0) then
         do i = 1, nrows
            ans = rank * (ncols * nrows) - nrows + i
            if (buf(rank,i,0) /= ans) then
               ierrs = ierrs + 1
               if (ierrs <= 10) then
                  print *, rank, " buf(", i, ",0) = ", buf(rank,i,0), &
                           " expected", ans
               end if
            end if
         end do
      end if

      if (right < size) then
         do i = 1, nrows
            ans = (rank + 1) * (ncols * nrows) + i
            if (buf(rank,i,ncols+1) /= ans) then
               ierrs = ierrs + 1
               if (ierrs <= 10) then

                           buf(rank,i,ncols+1), " expected ", ans
               end if
            end if
         end do
      end if
   end do

   print *, "Total errors detected:", ierrs

   deallocate(buf)
   deallocate(tmp)

program diagns_demo
  implicit none

  !------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Kind parameters and small problem dimensions
  !------------------------------------------------------------
  integer, parameter :: dp = selected_real_kind(15,307)
  integer, parameter :: MX = 3          ! horizontal dimension (x)
  integer, parameter :: NX = 4          ! horizontal dimension (y)
  integer, parameter :: KX = 2          ! number of vertical levels
  integer, parameter :: NSTDIA = 1      ! diagnostic interval

  !------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Global (module‑like) variables that would normally come from the
  ! included header files. They are defined locally here.
  !------------------------------------------------------------
  complex(dp) :: VOR(MX,NX,KX,2)   ! vorticity field (two time levels)
  complex(dp) :: DIV(MX,NX,KX,2)   ! divergence field (two time levels)
  real(dp)    :: T  (MX,NX,KX,2)   ! temperature field (two time levels)

  integer :: JJ = 1                ! time level index (1 or 2)
  integer :: ISTEP = 1             ! time step index

  !------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Initialise the dummy fields with simple, reproducible data.
  !------------------------------------------------------------
  call initialise_fields()

  !------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Call the diagnostic routine (the former subroutine DIAGNS).
  !------------------------------------------------------------
  call diagns(JJ, ISTEP)

contains

  !=================================================================
  ! Subroutine: initialise_fields
  ! Fill VOR, DIV and T with deterministic values.
  !=================================================================
  subroutine initialise_fields()
    implicit none
    integer :: i, j, k, l
    do l = 1, 2
       do k = 1, KX
          do j = 1, NX
             do i = 1, MX
                VOR(i,j,k,l) = cmplx( real(i*j*k*l,dp), real(i+j+k+l,dp) )
                DIV(i,j,k,l) = cmplx( real(i+j+k+l,dp), real(i*j*k*l,dp) )
                T  (i,j,k,l) = real( 10*i + 5*j + 2*k + l, dp )
             end do
          end do
       end do
    end do
  end subroutine initialise_fields

  !=================================================================
  ! Stub for INVLAP – in the original model this would invert a
  ! Laplacian operator. Here we simply copy the input to the output.
  !=================================================================
  subroutine invlap(in_arr, out_arr)
    implicit none
    complex(dp), intent(in)  :: in_arr(MX,NX)
    complex(dp), intent(out) :: out_arr(MX,NX)
    out_arr = in_arr
  end subroutine invlap

  !=================================================================
  ! Stub for TMOUT – placeholder for model output routine.
  !=================================================================
  subroutine tmout(flag)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: flag
    ! No operation – just a placeholder.
  end subroutine tmout

  !=================================================================
  ! Stub for TMINC – placeholder for time‑step increment routine.
  !=================================================================
  subroutine tminc()
    implicit none
    ! No operation – just a placeholder.
  end subroutine tminc

  !=================================================================
  ! Subroutine: diagns – reproduced from the original fixed‑form code.
  !=================================================================
  subroutine diagns(JJ, ISTEP)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: JJ      ! time level index (1 or 2)
    integer, intent(in) :: ISTEP   ! time step index

    real(dp)    :: SQHALF
    real(dp)    :: DIAG(KX,3)
    complex(dp) :: TEMP(MX,NX)
    integer :: K, M, N, KK

    SQHALF = sqrt(0.5_dp)

    !------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 1. Get global‑mean temperature and compute eddy kinetic energy
    !------------------------------------------------------------
    do K = 1, KX
       DIAG(K,1) = 0.0_dp
       DIAG(K,2) = 0.0_dp
       DIAG(K,3) = SQHALF * real( T(1,1,K,JJ), dp )

       call invlap( VOR(:,:,K,JJ), TEMP )
       do M = 2, MX+1
          do N = 1, NX
             DIAG(K,1) = DIAG(K,1) - real( TEMP(M,N) * conjg( VOR(M,N,K,JJ) ), dp )
          end do
       end do

       call invlap( DIV(:,:,K,JJ), TEMP )
       do M = 2, MX
          do N = 1, NX
             DIAG(K,2) = DIAG(K,2) - real( TEMP(M,N) * conjg( DIV(M,N,K,JJ) ), dp )
          end do
       end do
    end do

    !------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 2. Print results to screen (every NSTDIA steps)
    !------------------------------------------------------------
    if (mod(ISTEP, NSTDIA) == 0) then
       write(*,2001) ISTEP, (DIAG(K,1), K=1,KX)
       write(*,2002)          (DIAG(K,2), K=1,KX)
       write(*,2003)          (DIAG(K,3), K=1,KX)
    end if

    !------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 3. Check for out‑of‑range values – if found, call the stub
    !    output routines and stop.
    !------------------------------------------------------------
    do K = 1, KX
       if ( DIAG(K,1) > 500.0_dp .or. &
            DIAG(K,2) > 500.0_dp .or. &
            DIAG(K,3) < 180.0_dp .or. &
            DIAG(K,3) > 320.0_dp ) then

          write(*,2001) ISTEP, (DIAG(KK,1), KK=1,KX)
          write(*,2002)          (DIAG(KK,2), KK=1,KX)
          write(*,2003)          (DIAG(KK,3), KK=1,KX)

          call tmout(0)
          call tminc()
          call tmout(1)

          write(*,*) '*** Model variables out of accepted range ***'
          stop
       end if
    end do

2001 format(' step =',i6,' reke =',(10F8.2))
2002 format(13X,' deke =',(10F8.2))
2003 format(13X,' temp =',(10F8.2))

  end subroutine diagns

end program diagns_demo

! array_copy_caf_fixed.f90
! Demonstrates array copy between two logical "images" without using
! coarray features (so it compiles with a standard gfortran build).
! The program mimics the original two‑process behaviour by storing the
! data for each image in a separate row of a 2‑D array.

program array_copy_caf_fixed
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sender = 1, receiver = 2
   integer, parameter :: nimg = 2                     ! number of logical images
   integer, dimension(nimg,5) :: img_array             ! data for each image
   integer :: img

      write(*,'(a,i0,a,5(4x,i0))') 'array on proc ', img, ' before copy:', img_array(img,:)
   end do

   ! -----------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Perform the copy: the receiver obtains the sender's array values.
   ! -----------------------------------------------------------------
   img_array(receiver,:) = img_array(sender,:)

   ! -----------------------------------------------------------------

   ! -----------------------------------------------------------------
   do img = 1, nimg
      write(*,'(a,i0,a,5(4x,i0))') 'array on proc ', img, ' after copy:', img_array(img,:)

    implicit none
    integer, intent(in)                     :: nx
    real(DP), intent(in)                    :: dx, rho0
    integer, intent(in)                     :: bc_field
    real(DP), dimension(1:nx), intent(in)   :: rhoe
    real(DP), dimension(0:nx+1), intent(inout) :: Ex, phi

    integer :: i, j

module cosmolib
   implicit none
   ! Kind parameters
   integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)
   integer, parameter :: i8 = selected_int_kind(15)

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Public interface
   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   public :: cosmo_init, print_cosmo_pars, cdist, angdist, sigmacritinv

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Private data
   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   integer(i8), save, private :: has_been_init = 0_i8
   integer(i8), save :: npts
   real(dp), private, save, allocatable :: xxi(:), wwi(:)

   real(dp), save :: H0
   real(dp), save :: omega_m
   real(dp), save :: omega_l
   real(dp), save :: DH   ! Hubble distance c/H0

   real(dp), private, parameter :: four_pi_G_over_c_squared = 6.0150504541630152e-07_dp

   ! temporary variables for integration
   real(dp), private :: f1, f2, zz, ezinv

   interface angdist
      module procedure angdist_2z
      module procedure angdist_pre
   end interface

   interface sigmacritinv
      module procedure scinv_2z
      module procedure scinv_pre
   end interface

contains

   !=================================================================
   !  Initialize cosmology parameters and Gauss‑Legendre weights
   !=================================================================
   subroutine cosmo_init(H0_new, omega_m_new, npts_new)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: H0_new, omega_m_new
      integer(i8), intent(in) :: npts_new

      H0      = H0_new
      omega_m = omega_m_new
      omega_l = 1.0_dp - omega_m
      npts    = npts_new

      DH = 2.99792458e5_dp / 100.0_dp   ! c (km/s) / 100

      call set_cosmo_weights(npts)
      has_been_init = 1_i8
   end subroutine cosmo_init

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine set_cosmo_weights(npts_new)
      integer(i8), intent(in) :: npts_new
      npts = npts_new
      call gauleg(-1.0_dp, 1.0_dp, int(npts), xxi, wwi)
   end subroutine set_cosmo_weights

   !-----------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine gauleg(x1, x2, n, x, w)
      ! Gauss‑Legendre abscissae (x) and weights (w) on [x1,x2]
      real(dp), intent(in)  :: x1, x2
      integer,   intent(in) :: n
      real(dp), allocatable, intent(out) :: x(:), w(:)

      integer :: i, m, j
      real(dp) :: xm, xl, z, z1, pp, p1, p2, p3, eps

      eps = 1.0e-14_dp
      m   = (n + 1) / 2
      allocate(x(n), w(n))

      xm = 0.5_dp * (x2 + x1)
      xl = 0.5_dp * (x2 - x1)

      do i = 1, m
         z = cos(3.14159265358979323846_dp * (i - 0.25_dp) / (n + 0.5_dp))
         ! Newton‑Raphson iteration to find the root
         do
            p1 = 1.0_dp
            p2 = 0.0_dp
            do j = 1, n
               p3 = p2
               p2 = p1
               p1 = ((2.0_dp*j - 1.0_dp)*z*p2 - (j - 1.0_dp)*p3) / real(j,dp)
            end do
            pp = real(n,dp) * (z * p1 - p2) / (z*z - 1.0_dp)
            z1 = z
            z  = z1 - p1/pp
            if (abs(z - z1) < eps) exit
         end do
         x(i)         = xm - xl*z
         x(n+1-i)     = xm + xl*z
         w(i)         = 2.0_dp * xl / ((1.0_dp - z*z) * pp*pp)
         w(n+1-i)     = w(i)
      end do
   end subroutine gauleg

   !=================================================================
   !  Inverse of the dimensionless Hubble parameter E(z) = H(z)/H0
   !=================================================================
   real(dp) function ez_inverse(z)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: z
      real(dp) :: oneplusz3

      oneplusz3 = (1.0_dp + z)**3
      ez_inverse = omega_m*oneplusz3 + omega_l
      ez_inverse = sqrt(1.0_dp / ez_inverse)
   end function ez_inverse

   !=================================================================
   !  Integral of 1/E(z) from zmin to zmax using Gauss‑Legendre
   !=================================================================
   real(dp) function ez_inverse_integral(zmin, zmax) result(val)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: zmin, zmax
      integer :: i

      f1 = (zmax - zmin) / 2.0_dp
      f2 = (zmax + zmin) / 2.0_dp
      val = 0.0_dp

      do i = 1, npts
         zz     = xxi(i)*f1 + f2
         ezinv  = ez_inverse(zz)
         val    = val + f1 * ezinv * wwi(i)
      end do
   end function ez_inverse_integral

   !=================================================================
   !  Comoving distance (in Mpc)
   !=================================================================
   real(dp) function cdist(zmin, zmax) result(res)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: zmin, zmax
      res = DH * ez_inverse_integral(zmin, zmax)
   end function cdist

   !=================================================================
   !  Angular‑diameter distance (flat universe)
   !=================================================================
   real(dp) function angdist_2z(zmin, zmax) result(angdist)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: zmin, zmax
      angdist = DH * ez_inverse_integral(zmin, zmax) / (1.0_dp + zmax)
   end function angdist_2z

   real(dp) function angdist_pre(dcmin, dcmax, zmax) result(angdist)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: dcmin, dcmax, zmax
      angdist = (dcmax - dcmin) / (1.0_dp + zmax)
   end function angdist_pre

   !=================================================================
   !  Critical surface density inverse (flat universe)
   !=================================================================
   real(dp) function scinv_2z(zl, zs) result(scinv)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: zl, zs
      real(dp) :: dcl, dcs

      if (zs <= zl) then
         scinv = 0.0_dp
         return
      end if

      dcl = cdist(0.0_dp, zl)
      dcs = cdist(0.0_dp, zs)

      scinv = dcl / (1.0_dp + zl) * (dcs - dcl) / dcs * four_pi_G_over_c_squared
   end function scinv_2z

   real(dp) function scinv_pre(zl, dcl, dcs) result(scinv)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: zl, dcl, dcs
      if (dcs <= dcl) then
         scinv = 0.0_dp
         return
      end if
      scinv = dcl / (1.0_dp + zl) * (dcs - dcl) / dcs * four_pi_G_over_c_squared
   end function scinv_pre

   !=================================================================
   !  Print cosmology parameters (optional detailed output)
   !=================================================================
   subroutine print_cosmo_pars(do_printall)
      logical, intent(in), optional :: do_printall
      logical :: printall
      integer(i8) :: i

      if (has_been_init == 0_i8) then
         print *, "cosmo has not yet been init"
         return
      end if

      printall = .false.
      if (present(do_printall)) printall = do_printall

      write(*,'(a)') "Cosmo parameters:"
      write(*,'("    H0      = ",f6.2)') H0
      write(*,'("    omega_m = ",f6.2)') omega_m
      write(*,'("    npts    = ",i0)') npts
      write(*,'("    DH      = ",f15.8)') DH

      if (printall) then
         print *, 'Gauss‑Legendre nodes and weights:'
         do i = 1, size(xxi)
            write(*,'(2f15.8)') xxi(i), wwi(i)
         end do
      end if
   end subroutine print_cosmo_pars

end module cosmolib

    x_final   = c
